但在中国境外开采更多矿石只能解决部分问题。更大的瓶颈是加工。该委员会援引国际能源署的数据称，中国是 20 种战略矿产中 19 种的领先炼油国，平均市场份额为 70%。矿井上方的不同旗帜并不一定意味着通过炼油厂的不同路线。暴露的范围不仅仅限于芯片和电池。正如《The Register》八月份报道的那样，铒用于放大光纤链路中的信号，而钇则用于陶瓷电容器等组件。 IEEE Spectrum 警告说，中国实际上垄断了制造商所需的工业可用材料的加工。这种集中已经造成了破坏。中国于 2025 年 4 月在美国征收关税后实施稀土出口管制，波及制造业供应链，并迫使汽车工厂临时关闭。即使英国不是预定目标，英国制造商也可能遭受损失。该委员会还重点介绍了用于雷达、通信和电子战的先进半导体的镓和锗。报告显示，中国的产量分别占全球的 95% 和 93%。北京在芯片材料方面发挥影响力并不新鲜。随着西方对半导体技术的限制收紧，中国于 2023 年 7 月宣布了镓和锗的出口许可要求。
然而议员们表示，政府尚未明确确定要保护哪些国内工业和技术能力，因此很难确定哪些供应链值得优先考虑。进口统计数据也没有揭示全部风险。矿物质可能会进入电池、磁铁和其他制造部件内部，并作为单独的材料从视野中消失。企业本身可能并不确切地知道其供应链中的几层到底是什么。该委员会希望与c中的公司进行保密的映射和压力测试

【原文 English Original】
Britain's ambitions for AI, advanced chips, and clean energy rest on mineral supply chains dominated by China, and MPs say they cannot establish whether ministers have a credible plan to reduce that dependence. The House of Commons Business, Innovation, Science and Trade Committee has set ministers ten tests for securing critical minerals. Its verdict is hardly glowing – it cannot be confident the government passes any of them. The tests cover whether ministers know which industries and technologies need protecting, what minerals they require, where supplies could be disrupted, and how domestic production, overseas partnerships, skills, and financing will close the gaps. In a report published today , the committee warns that diversifying supplies will take ten to 15 years, and will require sustained investment and cooperation with allies. Completely cutting China out is neither realistic nor desirable, it says. Leaving Beijing with so much leverage is another matter. Critical minerals underpin everything from batteries and semiconductors to datacenters and military equipment. The designation reflects their economic or security importance and vulnerability to supply disruption, rather than membership of an especially exclusive geological club. The UK – like pretty much all major industrialized economies including the US, the EU, Japan, and India – is almost entirely dependent on imports of these materials and mineral product s. But digging up more ore outside China would solve only part of the problem. The bigger bottleneck is processing. Citing International Energy Agency figures, the committee says China is the leading refiner for 19 of 20 strategic minerals, with an average market share of 70 percent. A different flag over the mine does not necessarily mean a different route through the refinery. The exposure extends beyond chips and batteries. As The Register reported in August , erbium is used to amplify signals in fiber-optic links, while yttrium goes into components including ceramic capacitors. IEEE Spectrum warned that China effectively monopolized the processing of both into the industrially usable materials manufacturers need. That concentration has already caused disruption. China's rare earth export controls in April 2025 , introduced following US tariffs, rippled through manufacturing supply chains and forced temporary automotive plant closures. British manufacturers can suffer even when Britain isn't the intended target. The committee also highlights gallium and germanium, used in advanced semiconductors for radar, communications, and electronic warfare. China accounts for 95 percent and 93 percent of their global production respectively, according to the report [PDF]. Beijing flexing its leverage over chip materials is not new. China announced export licensing requirements for gallium and germanium in July 2023 amid tightening Western restrictions on semiconductor technology. Yet MPs say the government has not clearly identified which domestic industrial and technological capabilities it wants to protect, making it difficult to determine which supply chains deserve priority. Nor do import statistics reveal the whole exposure. Minerals can arrive inside batteries, magnets, and other manufactured components, disappearing from view as individual materials. Businesses themselves may not know precisely what lies several layers down their supply chains. The committee wants confidential mapping and stress-testing with firms in critical sectors, followed by joint purchasing arrangements with allies to give new mining and refining projects dependable customers. Committee chair Liam Byrne said: "Critical minerals are the alpha of the new economy. We cannot re-arm Britain, build AI or deliver net zero unless we secure the minerals these technologies depend on. "Yet sixteen years after China first weaponised its chokehold over rare earths , Britain remains dangerously exposed. We don't know enough about what minerals we need or where to find them. Our energy costs make processing uneconomic, we're exporting valuable metal waste, and our public finance institutions are shackled by outdated rules." More than a shopping list The committee's five-part prescription is to identify the capabilities Britain must protect, map their mineral needs, expand domestic mining, processing, and recycling, pool purchasing power with allies, and establish a dedicated financing facility. The proposed facility would bring together public funding bodies to back projects through grants, equity, loans, guarantees, and long-term purchase agreements. "We're never going to eliminate Chinese minerals from our supply chains. But it's foolish to leave Britain exposed to economic coercion when we could be building alternative supplies," Byrne said. "That's why we need a new Critical Minerals Finance Facility with the financial firepower to invest in new mines, processing plants and recycling, working with our allies to share the costs." The report argues that existing institutions leave gaps, particularly for early-stage projects. It recommends expanding UK Export Finance's remit and allowing British International Investment to take equity stakes in overseas mineral projects. Long-term purchasing commitments and price guarantees could help keep strategically important projects commercially viable despite volatile mineral prices. There is also material closer to home. The report says 80 percent of UK metal products classified as waste are exported. MPs want better sorting and separation infrastructure, alongside more detailed trade data to establish exactly what valuable scrap is leaving the country. For domestic projects, they recommend designated critical mineral clusters with permitting deadlines, help navigating approvals, energy support, and priority grid access. Stockpiles could provide a short-term buffer too. The committee calls for an initial reserve covering approximately 60 days of minerals needed for defense capabilities, while stressing that warehouses are no substitute for diversified supply. None of this offers a quick escape from dependence on China. The committee's argument is that Britain needs to decide what it must protect, work out what those industries actually consume, and help finance alternatives before the next disruption. "De-risking even a prudent proportion of our supplies will take over a decade. Britain cannot afford to drift," Byrne said. "We must act now before dangerous dependencies become strategic liabilities." ®

【原文 English Original】
Top Of The Week HBM from Samsung and SK hynix is reportedly reaching Chinese AI chip developers through smuggling operations that exploit U.S. export-control loopholes . According to The Information, intermediaries package HBM with low-performance server processors, ship the combined components to China, and then remove the memory for resale, including to customers of Huawei . Approximately 600,000 Nvidia H200 AI chips are being held in Hong Kong awaiting approval for shipment to mainland China, according to Reuters. Beijing has limited imports in an effort to reduce reliance on U.S. technology and encourage adoption of domestically developed processors. Micron reportedly paused construction of a $4.5B memory-chip plant in Taiwan due to a prolonged labor dispute, according to Bloomberg. Micron has not confirmed the suspension, and the effect on its longer-term Taiwan manufacturing plans remains unclear. Samsung Electronics is reportedly planning to expand advanced foundry capacity for HBM base dies at two locations. In South Korea, the company reportedly plans a new foundry facility at Giheung , with 2nm and 4nm production lines and an estimated ~US$17B investment, along with a possible advanced packaging expansion. Separately, Samsung reportedly secured orders from AMD and Nvidia for 2nm HBM base dies to be produced at a proposed second foundry in Taylor, Texas, with mass production targeted for 2030. Note: Samsung has not confirmed the reported Giheung investment or Taylor customer orders. Oracle canceled a 5-year agreement worth an estimated $7B to provide Tencent access to up to 100,000 advanced AI chips through data centers in Southeast Asia, following pressure from the Trump administration, according to the Financial Times. U.S. officials raised concerns about Chinese companies accessing advanced processors through overseas cloud services, while officials in China’s Guangdong province urged Tencent to use domestically developed chips. Bosch plans to establish a dedicated semiconductor division in January 2028, expanding its foundry business and opening more manufacturing capacity to external customers. The company is targeting €5B in semiconductor sales by 2030 and plans to expand its semiconductor test center in Penang, Malaysia, by the mid-2030s. Marvell ‘s pending acquisition of Lumentum, initially valued at $115B , is drawing mixed reactions, with analysts seeing opportunities to challenge Broadcom in AI optical interconnects, but also raising concerns about supplier concentration and customer relationships. Questions about the purchase price and regulatory approval have added to investor concerns. U.S. election results raised concerns about tighter restrictions on data center development , particularly in major markets such as Texas and Ohio , as well as increased congressional oversight of AI , including AI safety, cybersecurity, and industry practices. Restrictions that delay or reduce data center construction could weaken demand for AI accelerators, HBM, and networking chips, and increased regulatory scrutiny could create additional uncertainty for AI infrastructure investment. (See chip stock impacts here .) More acquisitions and deals Onsemi confirmed it plans to acquire Ferric, developer of integrated voltage regulators, for $600M in cash, plus up to $175M in milestone payments. Entegris acquired Advanced Abrasives and announced plans for a new SiC materials manufacturing line in Taiwan. The company also partnered with Element Six to develop diamond-based thermal-management materials for advanced packaging and expanded its deal with Kioxia on BiCS Flash 3D flash memory . Supermicro is initially planning to use 10,000 SambaNova SN50 RDUs for its new AI disaggregated inference systems as part of a strategic collaboration. China’s biggest EDA company, Empyrean , plans to acquire a ~50.4% stake in Easy-Logic for US$33M. Unconfirmed : Mitsui Chemicals reportedly plans to buy JSR , semiconductor materials maker, for at least $8B. Two acquisitions finalized: ADI ‘s purchase of Alif Semiconductor, adding its AI-native MCU and fusion processors, and Forge Nano ‘s acquisition of HZO for its nanoscale coating platforms. Reports and analysis Global semiconductor sales reached $518B in Q3, up 24% from Q2, according to the SIA/WSTS . September sales were up 147% year over year. Worldwide silicon wafer shipments increased 13.4% year over year in Q3, reports SEMI . Q3 DRAM revenue approached $200B , up 369% year over year as AI demand and higher prices strained supply, per Counterpoint . TrendForce projects the AI networking and interconnect market will reach $279.8B in 2027. AI data centers are moving toward 800 VDC power distribution as rack power rises toward megawatt levels, with Nvidia, Google, Microsoft and other industry participants working through OCP on common architectures and interfaces. Earnings Revenue growth/decline year over year: Arm up 27% , Arteris up 48% , AMD up 45% , Bruker up ~2% , Coherent up 50% , GlobalFoundries up 13% , Lattice up 118% , Nova up 28% , onsemi up 11%, PDF Solutions up 20% , Qnity sales up 22% , Qualcomm down 8% , and Tower up 33% . Webinars on shift left, verification, and debug of high-power motor controllers. Global Americas UC San Diego and Qualcomm launched a $750K AI-driven chip-design research initiative, funded by a $500K Qualcomm gift and $250K in UCSD matching funds, focused on AI methods for SoC design, processor architectures, hardware accelerators, memory systems, and interconnects. CSIS examines Albany NanoTech as a model for semiconductor technology clusters, highlighting shared R&D infrastructure, industry partnerships, and workforce development supporting sub-2nm technologies, advanced packaging, photonics, and quantum systems. The OCP Foundation is opening nominations for project leads across all 12 top-level OCP Projects, ranging from hardware management to the AI computing continuum. Europe The European Semiconductor Industry Association (ESIA) called for dedicated semiconductor funding under the EU’s 2028–2034 budget, including support for R&D, pilot production, advanced packaging, and industrial deployment. The association urged policymakers to coordinate national and EU funding, preserve the Chips Joint Undertaking’s cross-sector role, and ease restrictions on intellectual property transfers within multinational companies. The European Fabless Semiconductor Association was formally launched to advance fabless semiconductor design within the EU. The EU launched a European Chip Design Platform ( EuroCDP ) with €525M to stimulate new chip design companies . Synopsys and the EU Chips JU signed a deal to expand access to its EDA software for semiconductor startups and research teams through the EuroCDP. Asia South Korea reaffirmed plans to spend ₩21.3T (US$16B ) on AI and major initiatives covering semiconductors, physical AI, and data centers, in its proposed 2027 budget, nearly doubling this year’s allocation. Panasonic Industry plans to invest about ¥92B ($583M) to expand AI-related materials production and R&D, including circuit-board materials, capacitors and semiconductor packaging materials. Two workers were killed and five injured in an explosion and fire at Panasonic Industrial Devices Materials ‘ factory in Hsinchu, Taiwan. The facility produces PCB and semiconductor packaging materials. The cause and production impact have not been determined yet. South Korea’s Techwing plans to invest approximately ₩52.6B ($39M) in a new semiconductor equipment factory in Cheonan to expand production of memory test handlers and HBM cube probers. In-Depth Semiconductor Engineering published the Automotive, Security and AI newsletter, including: Fitting AI Models To Edge Applications Physical AI Pushes The Limits Of Hardware College Grads And AI Plus : Shift Left Is Becoming A System-Level Problem Video: Accelerating Plug-And-Play Prototyping In Chiplet-Based Designs Perspective: Putting AI To The Test New Technologies Automotive and physical AI Infineon introduced its first automotive MCU platform based on the RISC-V architecture , adding hardware-based physical protection and crypto agility, with support planned for post-quantum security requirements. Infineon and Qualcomm are collaborating on a microcontroller-based subsystem for Snapdragon Ride reference platforms used in central car computers for automated driving and digital cockpit applications. STMicro announced a new microcontroller portfolio covering industrial, automotive, and physical AI applications. Test, measurement Keysight released XR3, a low-profile 14-bit oscilloscope designed to increase measurement capacity in rack-based test systems. Siemens introduced an automated component model extraction solution developed with Bosch that cuts frequency-response-function measurement time by up to 93% and produces ISO 20270-compliant models for virtual NVH development. AI hardware & memory Qualcomm completed hardware validation of its high-bandwidth compute (HBC) silicon, exercising the full memory read/write path and near-memory computations. Cerabyte completed S3 integration testing of its ceramic data storage within established object-storage workflows, in collaboration with CERN openlab. Design Arteris exceeded 1,000 customer silicon design starts using its interconnect IP, and released a report showing the evolution of SoC, ASIC, FPGA, and MCU designs across key markets. Research MCL , PVA TePla and ASE researchers developed an AI-based image-enhancement method for detecting flip-chip interconnect defects . By improving scanning acoustic microscopy images, the method increased detection of cracks and delamination in extreme-low-k dielectric layers from 5.2% to 100% in tests involving 19 defects across three packages. TU Munich , Applied Materials et al. evaluated cryogenic 2nm GAA transistors and superconducting interconnects for energy-efficient AI computing. Using a calibrated chip-design flow, they reported a 3x performance increase and 7.7x improvement in energy efficiency for a modeled AI accelerator’s compute fabric, excluding memory, data movement, and refrigeration power. ETH Zurich -led researchers benchmarked 10 commercial sub-watt edge AI devices , comparing inference performance and energy consumption across convolutional neural networks and small vision transformers. The study found that memory traffic, rather than computational workload, was the primary factor determining latency on the tested neural-network accelerators, highlighting the importance of data movement in low-power AI hardware design. HUST and PolyU researchers developed annealing-free ferroelectric transistors with ultrathin oxide-semiconductor channels for NVM and neuromorphic computing . The devices achieved a memory window of up to 20.6V, endurance of 10⁶ cycles, and stable 6-bit operation across 64 states. A neuromorphic network evaluation achieved 93.02% recognition accuracy. Security Government security news ENISA issued new EU cybersecurity-certification guidance for secure elements , outlining how cryptographic security services can be evaluated for use across different chip platforms. EU cybersecurity authorities issued a coordinated response after a new wave of attacks on internet-connected refrigeration systems. Japan ’s METI and IPA are participating in a new effort to align security requirements for connected hardware under Japan’s JC-STAR program and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Alerts and attacks AMD issued security bulletins covering a newly discovered EDK II PXE driver vulnerability that can allow pre-boot code execution and a contention-based side-channel technique for exploiting known vulnerabilities in AMD CPUs. Dell issued BIOS updates for a critical Qualcomm chipset vulnerability affecting five Latitude, Inspiron, and XPS systems. The flaw can cause memory corruption when a malformed RSA key is imported into Qualcomm’s Keystore. Google banned Videostrong Technology from making certified Android devices after its security researchers determined that the company was responsible for creating an XCPE backdoor that enrolled 1.3 million set-top boxes into a criminal botnet. CISA ’s alerts for the week are here . Security offering and deals Vietnam has its first-ever homegrown security chip after government-backed Viettel Group successfully integrated a domestically developed cryptographic algorithm into silicon. u-blox announced that it will integrate Kudelski Labs ’ embedded security IP into its future chipsets. Chinese tech giant Tencent released Hy4, its powerful new open-source AI model . Amid growing concerns about agentic hacking, the company said it limited the model’s cybersecurity training data to defensive material only. Security technical papers NC State and Princeton researchers proposed a 3D-stacked hardware shield to protect post-quantum cryptography accelerators from side-channel attacks. The design stacks a guard layer above the cryptographic hardware, using decoy-key activity and physical shielding to obscure power leakage from NTT computations. Quantum Hardware New launches Universal Quantum launched its iQPU quantum processor , combining a large trapped-ion compute surface, ultra-low-noise integrated control electronics, and chip-to-chip interfaces designed to scale quantum computing systems. The processor is manufactured on a commercial 200mm semiconductor production line. IBM , ORNL , and AMD opened a new co-design platform for quantum error correction at IBM’s quantum facility in New York , co-locating the 120-qubit IBM Quantum Nighthawk with ORNL’s Umbra HPC system. Fig. 1: ORNL’s Umbra HPC system. Source: Oak Ridge National Lab Advances Researchers from Quantum Motion , UCL , and others demonstrated a superconducting circuit element fabricated using a commercial CMOS process . The titanium-nitride device functions as a compact superinductor and was integrated with a silicon quantum dot to enable sensitive RF charge detection, potentially supporting more compact readout hardware for semiconductor spin qubits. University of Regensburg -led researchers demonstrated a real-time feedback technique that reduced superconducting-qubit operation errors by approximately 54%, from 0.14% to 0.065%. The approach identifies changes in qubit resonance frequency associated with material defects and adjusts control signals to improve reliability. Alice & Bob reported extended bit-flip lifetimes in superconducting cat qubits , averaging 44 minutes on a single-qubit test device and reaching 189 to 252 minutes on selected qubits in its 12-qubit Helium 2 processor. The preliminary results demonstrate strong suppression of bit-flip errors during idle operation, with performance during error-correction operations still to be validated. Workforce, Education The U.S. Department of Labor opened applications for a $40M apprenticeship incentive fund that includes semiconductor fabrication among several high-growth sectors. Registered apprenticeship sponsors can receive up to $6K per eligible new apprentice. UCLA named the first 10 doctoral fellows in its Semiconductor Hub , with research spanning 3D ICs, advanced packaging, silicon photonics, compute-in-memory, and AI hardware. Fellows will also intern with one of the Hub’s industry partners, including Synopsys , GlobalFoundries , and others. In a new Semiconductor Engineering roundtable , industry experts discuss how AI is changing expectations for new engineering graduates. Demand for electrical engineers remains strong, but AI agents are taking over some traditional junior-level tasks, raising expectations for practical experience, AI fluency, and the ability to tackle higher-level engineering work earlier in their careers. U.S. community colleges are expanding semiconductor technician training programs as the industry faces a potential shortage of 157,000 workers by 2030, according to the Associated Press. More than 200 colleges and universities are coordinating with semiconductor manufacturers, including TSMC , Intel , Samsung , and SK hynix , to develop hands-on training programs supporting new U.S. fabs. title: 'Permanent, serious' dialogue needed with China on AI: tech-focused lawmaker
zh_title: 需要与中国就人工智能进行“永久、认真”的对话：以技术为重点的立法者
summary: 众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖 (James Walkinshaw) 对人工智能监管的愿景包括与中国保持“永久、认真”的对话，以减轻强大的人工智能模型带来的风险。这位弗吉尼亚州民主党人周四在政府官员活动中表示，这并不容易，但如果美国能够在冷战期间与苏联保持核裁军对话，那么今天与其顶级技术和经济竞争对手的沟通也可以如此。这些对话“绝对必要，而且在某些方面，我们的动机是一致的，对吧？中国共产党确实
content:
众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖 (James Walkinshaw) 对人工智能监管的愿景包括与中国保持“永久、认真”的对话，以减轻强大的人工智能模型带来的风险。这位弗吉尼亚州民主党人周四在政府官员活动中表示，这并不容易，但如果美国能够在冷战期间与苏联保持核裁军对话，那么今天与其顶级技术和经济竞争对手的沟通也可以如此。这些对话“绝对必要，而且在某些方面，我们的动机是一致的，对吧？中国共产党和我们一样不希望流氓人工智能代理侵入他们的系统和水务部门，所以我们必须进行永久性对话并达成一些协议，”他说。他发表此番言论的几天前，民主党赢得了众议院和参议院的控制权，许多即将上任的立法者将人工智能监管作为其竞选活动的核心组成部分。目前尚不完全清楚，在一个主要专注于促进技术创新、同时将法规保持在最低限度的政府的领导下，立法者将如何着手制定人工智能法律。白宫还必须应对参众两院新多数派的更强烈反对，这可能迫使他们坐到谈判桌前通过复杂的立法。沃金肖并不是第一位倡导美中人工智能对话的国会议员，尽管他的立场增加了这些评论的分量。
作为北弗吉尼亚州一个著名科技和联邦合同走廊的代表，他所服务的地区的当地科技公司和政府承包商必须应对人工智能发展所带来的复杂的国家安全影响。推动对话是在 7 月份发生的一次具有里程碑意义的事件之后进行的，当时 OpenAI 特工逃离了他们的开发沙箱，并对 Hugging Face 发起了协调一致的网络攻击。上个月，研究人员在与中国相关的腾讯云上追踪到一组自主人工智能代理，这些代理突破了自己的测试环境，并进行了数千次未经授权的尝试，以规避阿里巴巴平台上的反机器人保护。这些言论也与中国国家主席习近平九月份在华盛顿与唐纳德·特朗普总统举行峰会时的声明相一致。习近平承认两个超级大国都负有管理技术的“责任”，同意建立美中超级情报对话和针对严重人工智能事件的危机“热线”。一些立法者提出成立一个特别委员会来监管快速发展的技术，但其他人拒绝了这一想法。沃金肖表示，他并不期望众议院建立一个特别委员会，而是希望将现有的众议院民主党人工智能委员会的工作转化为委员会可以制定的具体立法。他对人工智能监管的愿景还包括前沿模型的安全测试。
在周四的讲话中，他将安全测试与联邦航空管理局在飞机离开机库之前对飞机进行安全检查进行了比较。他特别补充说，他对于联邦机构或受政府监督的第三方评估机构是否应该进行该测试持不可知论。 ]]>

【原文 English Original】
Rep. James Walkinshaw’s vision for artificial intelligence regulation includes maintaining “permanent, serious” dialogue with China to mitigate the risk that powerful AI models pose. That won’t be easy, but if the U.S. was able to maintain nuclear-disarmament dialogue with the Soviet Union during the Cold War, then the same can be said for communications with its top technology and economic competitor today, the Virginia Democrat argued Thursday at a GovExec event. Those conversations are “absolutely necessary, and in some ways, our incentives are aligned, right? The Chinese Communist Party doesn’t want rogue AI agents hacking their systems and their water authorities any more than we do, so we have to have that permanent dialogue and reach some agreements,” he said. His comments come days after Democrats won control of the House and Senate, where many incoming lawmakers made AI regulation a central component of their campaigns.  It’s not fully clear how lawmakers will proceed with crafting AI laws under an administration that has largely focused on fostering tech innovation while keeping regulations to a minimum. The White House will also have to contend with fiercer opposition from the new majorities in both chambers, which may force them to the negotiating table to pass complex legislation. Walkinshaw is hardly the first member of Congress to advocate for U.S.-China AI dialogue, though his position gives the comments added weight. As the representative of a prominent tech and federal contracting corridor in Northern Virginia, he serves a district whose local technology companies and government contractors must navigate the complex national security implications of AI development. The push for dialogue follows a landmark July incident where OpenAI agents escaped their development sandboxes and launched a coordinated cyberattack on Hugging Face . And last month, researchers tracked down a fleet of autonomous AI agents on China-linked Tencent Cloud that broke out of their own testing environment and made thousands of unauthorized attempts to circumvent anti-bot protections on an Alibaba platform.  The remarks also align with statements from Chinese President Xi Jinping during his September summit with President Donald Trump in Washington. Acknowledging that both superpowers share a “responsibility” to manage the technology, Xi agreed to establish the U.S.-China Super Intelligence Dialogue and a crisis “hotline” for severe AI incidents. Some lawmakers have floated a select committee to regulate the fast-evolving technology, though others have rebuffed that idea. Walkinshaw said he does not expect the House to establish a select committee and instead expects the work of a pre-existing House Democratic commission on AI to be translated into concrete legislation that committees can work on. His vision for AI regulation also includes safety testing for frontier models. In remarks Thursday, he compared safety testing to the Federal Aviation Administration conducting safety inspections of airplanes before they leave hangars. He notably added that he is agnostic as to whether a federal agency or third-party evaluator with government oversight should conduct that testing.  ]]>

title: Taiwan says closes representative office in Papua New Guinea, blames China
zh_title: 台湾称关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处，指责中国
summary: 台湾周五表示，已决定关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处并撤回其工作人员，并指责中国对这个南太平洋国家的胁迫。 2021 年 10 月 6 日，台湾台北，国庆庆祝活动前，台湾国旗安装的全貌。资料照片：Walid Berrazeg/HKFP。台湾外交部表示，未来我们将向友好国家和其他有合作潜力、值得继续接触的地区配置相关资源，以进一步深化实质性合作，拓展台湾的国际空间。
content:
台湾周五表示，已决定关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处并撤回其工作人员，并指责中国对这个南太平洋国家的胁迫。 2021 年 10 月 6 日，台湾台北，国庆庆祝活动前，台湾国旗安装的全貌。资料照片：Walid Berrazeg/HKFP。台湾外交部在一份声明中表示，未来我们将向友好国家和其他有合作潜力、值得继续接触的地区配置相关资源，以进一步深化实质性合作，拓展台湾的国际空间。巴布亚新几内亚7月份决定关闭台湾在首都莫尔兹比港的办事处，但台北拒绝了这一决定，引发了长达数月的争议。中国声称台湾是其领土的一部分，并反对台湾参与国际组织和与其他国家的交往，此前曾对巴布亚新几内亚的举动表示欢迎。与许多国家一样，巴布亚新几内亚与中国建立了正式外交关系，但允许台湾在莫尔兹比港设立代表处。台湾外交部周五表示，岛内民主正在“积极”关闭该办事处，撤回“所有派驻人员”，并审查和调整“双边合作关系”。
台湾表示，巴布亚新几内亚政府“最近的一系列行动”“严重破坏了双方长期合作建立的互信基础”。台湾台北，2024 年 1 月 12 日。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “这些行为也反映出中国持续利用政治压力和经济影响力干涉其他国家的外交决策，打压台湾的国际空间，”外交部表示。巴布亚新几内亚政府的决定再次凸显中国利用政治和经济手段干涉别国自主外交决策，破坏国际互信和公平原则。台湾此前宣布已停止从巴布亚新几内亚现货购买液化天然气，但周五该部表示也将不再与该国签署新的现货采购合同。外交部表示，台湾液化天然气采购量占巴布亚新几内亚出口量的三分之一。官方数据显示，到 2025 年，这个南太平洋国家占台湾天然气进口量的 8%，而卡塔尔（34%）、澳大利亚（33%）和美国（10%）。该部表示，台湾还将终止技术合作和援助计划，“包括医疗任务、相关奖学金和人才发展计划”。

【原文 English Original】
Taiwan said Friday it has decided to close its representative office in Papua New Guinea and withdraw its staff, blaming Chinese coercion of the South Pacific nation for the decision. General view of Taiwan flag installation ahead of National Day celebrations in Taipei, Taiwan, 06 October, 2021. File photo: Walid Berrazeg/HKFP. “In the future, we will allocate relevant resources to friendly nations and other regions with cooperative potential that warrant continued engagement, in order to further deepen substantive cooperation and expand Taiwan’s international space,” Taiwan’s foreign ministry said in a statement. The announcement comes after a months-long dispute following PNG’s decision in July to shutter Taiwan’s office in the capital Port Moresby, which Taipei rejected. China, which claims Taiwan is part of its territory and opposes the self-governed island’s participation in international organisations and exchanges with other countries, previously welcomed PNG’s move. Like many countries, PNG has formal diplomatic relations with China but had allowed Taiwan to have a representative office in the Port Moresby. Taiwan’s foreign ministry said on Friday the island democracy was “proactively” closing the office, withdrawing “all posted personnel” and reviewing and adjusting “bilateral cooperative relations”. Taiwan said “a series of recent actions” by the PNG government had “severely undermined the foundation of mutual trust built through long-term cooperation between the two sides”. Taipei, Taiwan, on January 12, 2024. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “These actions also reflect China’s continued use of political pressure and economic influence to interfere in the diplomatic decisions of other countries and suppress Taiwan’s international space,” the ministry said. “The Papua New Guinea government’s decision once again highlights China’s use of political and economic means to interfere with other countries’ autonomous diplomatic decision-making and to undermine international mutual trust and the principles of fairness.” Taiwan previously announced that it had stopped spot purchases of liquefied natural gas from PNG, but on Friday the ministry said it also would no longer sign new spot purchase contracts with the country. The foreign ministry said Taiwanese LNG purchases accounted for one-third of PNG’s exports. The South Pacific Nation accounted for eight percent of Taiwan’s natural gas imports in 2025, compared with Qatar (34 percent), Australia (33 percent) and the United States (10 percent), official figures show. Taiwan will also end technical cooperation and assistance programmes, “including medical missions, related scholarship and talent development programmes”, the ministry said.

summary: 香港一家法院驳回了一名前新闻工会主席对其因妨碍警察执法而被判入狱五天的定罪提出最终上诉的请求。 2023 年 9 月 6 日，香港记者协会主席陈启宗在高等法院外。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。高等法院暂委法官黄莉莉周五拒绝向香港记者协会（HKJA）前主席陈润生颁发向终审法院提出异议的证明书。陈试图推翻他在 2022 年 9 月遭遇的一次判决，当时他
content:
香港一家法院驳回了一名前新闻工会主席对其因妨碍警察执法而被判入狱五天的定罪提出最终上诉的请求。 2023 年 9 月 6 日，香港记者协会主席陈启宗在高等法院外。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。高等法院暂委法官黄莉莉周五拒绝向香港记者协会（HKJA）前主席陈润生颁发向终审法院提出异议的证明书。陈先生于 2022 年 9 月在旺角报道业主委员会会议时拒绝向便衣警察出示身份证，因此试图推翻对他的定罪。他于 2023 年 9 月被定罪并被判处五天监禁，但在上诉期间获准保释。 5 月，陈在上诉失败后入狱服刑（同样由黄法官主持）。在寻求向最高法院上诉的证明时，陈的律师早些时候辩称，该市的《警察部队条例》是否授予警员要求身份证明的“独立权力”，是一个具有重大和普遍重要性的问题。 “没有合理的争议”，黄法官周五驳回了这一论点，并在一份中文判决书中表示，该法律“明确”授权警察拦截个人并要求提供身份证明。
法官表示，陈律师提出的论点无视明确的法律规定，实际上是试图剥夺警方索要身份证的权力。高等法院。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “因此，我不认为所提出的论点是真正的法律论点。即使它是一个法律论点……我发现它没有合理的争议性，”法官写道。尽管周五作出裁决，陈仍然可以直接向终审法院上诉委员会申请上诉许可。陈先生于2021年至2024年期间担任记协主席。案发时，一名便衣警察拦住了陈先生，警察称陈先生的行为“可疑”，并要求出示他的身份证。尽管多次警告，但他拒绝这样做，随后被捕。在陈五月上诉失败并不得不服五天监禁后，记协表示“深感遗憾”，而记者无国界则表示对陈的入狱感到“愤怒”。

【原文 English Original】
A Hong Kong court has rejected a former press union head’s bid to lodge a final appeal against his conviction for obstructing police, for which he was jailed for five days. Hong Kong Journalists Association chairperson Ronson Chan outside the High Court on Sept. 6, 2023. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Deputy High Court Judge Lily Wong on Friday refused to grant Ronson Chan, a former chair of the Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA), a certificate to take his challenge to the Court of Final Appeal. Chan has sought to overturn his conviction stemming from an encounter in September 2022, when he refused to show his identity card to a plainclothes police officer while reporting on a homeowners’ committee meeting in Mong Kok. He was convicted in September 2023 and sentenced to five days in jail, but was granted bail pending an appeal. Chan served the prison term after losing the appeal – also presided over by Judge Wong – in May. In seeking certification to appeal to the top court, Chan’s lawyer had earlier argued that whether the city’s Police Force Ordinance grants officers “free-standing power” to demand identity proof is a question of great and general importance. ‘Not reasonably arguable’ Judge Wong on Friday rejected the argument, saying in a Chinese-language judgment that the law was “unequivocal” in empowering police officers to stop individuals and demand proof of identity. The argument presented by Chan’s lawyer ignored clear statutory provisions and effectively sought to strip police of their power to demand an identity card, the judge said. The High Court. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “I therefore do not consider the argument presented to be a genuine legal argument. Even if it were a legal argument… I find that it is not reasonably arguable,” the judge wrote. Despite Friday’s ruling, Chan can still apply directly to the Court of Final Appeal’s Appeal Committee for leave to appeal. Chan was chair of the HKJA from 2021 to 2024. At the time of the offence, Chan was stopped by a plainclothes police officer who said he was acting “suspiciously” and asked to see his identification card. He was arrested after refusing to do so despite multiple warnings. The HKJA expressed “deep regret” after Chan lost his appeal in May and had to serve his five-day prison sentence, while Reporters Without Borders said it was “outraged” by Chan’s imprisonment.

title: 廖亦武：黃之鋒獲諾貝爾和平獎的可能

content: – 29岁的黄之锋6年刑满之际，中共香港当局又在他即将获释之际，再次判处他10年有期徒刑。這真可谓数千年来，史无前例的国家犯罪。甚至比重判老人黎智英更加令人发指。所以，在推特上，这是继美国中期选举特朗普惨败、乌克兰反侵略战争之后，最引人关注的新闻。 我因此重发8年前《支持和呼吁将諾貝爾和平獎授予香港雙學三子黃之鋒、周永康、羅冠聰》的采访。我以此祝福狱中的黄之锋，保重身体，大家会为你继续争取的 ————————– 2018年2月5日，流亡作家廖亦武接受香港本土媒體《眾新聞》的採訪，谈到雙學三子黃之鋒、周永康、羅冠聰獲諾貝爾和平獎的可能 – 問：您覺得這次提名，對香港人及香港的民主運動，代表了什麼意義呢？ 答：2014年的香港雨傘運動的某一天，柏林下着雨，我正在參加2009年諾貝爾文學獎得主赫塔-穆勒的新書發佈會。越洋電話中突然傳來消息，北京的地下詩人王藏，因撐傘聲援香港佔中而被捕入獄，接着又有十幾位藝術家入獄。我將這連鎖反應告訴赫塔-米勒，我們一塊拍了那張撐傘比中指、高喊「北京獨裁者滾蛋」的照片。在那一刻，我覺得時光倒流，我想起1989天安門大屠殺，也是和黃之鋒、周永康、羅冠聰相仿佛的一批年輕人，佔領了天安門廣場，要求對話和民主。卻發生戒嚴和屠殺，成千上萬人倒在血泊中。我在那夜寫作了《大屠殺》： 權力永遠會勝利。永遠會一代又一代傳下去。 自由也會死灰復燃。一代又一代死灰復燃。像黎明到來之前那一丁點光亮…… 2014年香港雨傘運動是1989年天安門學潮的歷史延續，特別是在獨裁中國利用全球資本主義，公然挑戰全人類普世價值的當口，雙學三子被美國國會議員們提名角逐諾貝爾和平獎的消息，就特別振奮人心。這證明西方有良知的人們，在高度關注香港人的抗爭。雖然武裝到牙齒的強權令手無寸鐵的香港人「節節敗退」，但德國詩人里爾克說：「挺住意味着一切。」年輕人會贏得時間。如果他們真得獎了，時間的天秤就會倒過來，世界會因此而改變。 問： 您覺得在劉曉波去世後，及對中國對香港步步進逼下，中國政府會如何看待這次和平獎提名？ 答：中國政府的看法不重要，只有想從中國政府那兒撈取好處的人，才覺得這樣一個寡廉鮮恥的政府的看法重要，比如藝術明星艾未未，為了自由出入中國，而在劉曉波之死和六四死亡人數上混淆視聽，與中國政府如出一轍。 法國著名作家和記者法拉奇在傳世之作《人》中寫道：「我認為人類尊嚴最美好的紀念碑是伯羅奔尼薩斯半島上的那個東西。它不是一座偶像，也不是一面旗幟，而是三個希臘字母：OXI。意思是『不』。」「為什麼還要忍受痛苦，為什麼要鬥爭，為什麼要冒從山上被狂風刮到井底與魚為伍的風險呢？因為這是作為一個男人，一個女人，總之是作為一個人而不是作為一隻綿羊而生存的唯一方法。」 問：觀察過去的諾貝爾和平獎，少有第一次提名便獲獎。您認為，未來香港獲獎的機會高嗎，會否獲得國際的支持？諾貝爾和平獎委員會應如何看待這次提名？ 答：觀察是沒用的。劉曉波得獎之際，我曾寫了一篇文章，摘錄如後：「劉曉波對探監的劉霞説：『這個獎是給所有八九六四亡靈的。』接著他哭起來。我沒有哭，可這句話像石頭，壓了我許多天。是的是的，在中國異見者看來，諾貝爾奬至高無上，只有近3000名死難者的代表，才有資格獲得。 「所以這些年，劉曉波和我等等的重大議題之一，是提名『天安門母親』的發起者丁子霖教授為諾貝爾獎候選人，我們寫過若干文章，公開聯名推薦至少五次以上。丁子霖的兒子在六四凌晨被槍殺，風聲鶴唳中，她作為遇難者家屬，第一個打破沉默，向國際社會指控劊子手政府。接著的20餘年，丁子霖夫婦一直被軟禁，但他們根據一星半點線索，經過若乾地下渠道，逐個尋訪，竟然串聯了180多位六四難屬，形成影響深遠的『天安門母親』群體。大夥兒互相激勵，蒐集屠殺證據，記錄真相，在海外出版成冊，並年復一年上書當局，追究罪責，令獨裁者坐臥不安。 「劉曉波對我説：丁子霖的工作令人想起1986年諾貝爾和平獎得主埃利‧威塞爾，後者的寫作主題是納粹滅絕猶太人的記憶。頒獎辭中，『把個人關注化作對所有暴力、仇恨和壓迫的普遍譴責』，也適用於丁子霖。」 我們多年的努力沒有結果。劉曉波自己希望丁子霖得獎，結果很意外，他坐牢、得獎、被謀殺，成為一個燈塔般的道義巨子。 作為過來人，我希望黃之鋒等人堅韌不拔，香港、他們的故鄉的人們，也應該鼓勵他們堅韌不拔。香港社會的民主抗爭在世界上影響愈大，他們愈有可能得獎。特別是在目前，獨裁中國處於四處挑釁的高危時期，西方正紛紛檢討和調整過去多年對中國的綏靖主义失誤。在重新匯聚的歷史潮流中，香港是一個抵抗的典範，所以黃之鋒他們得獎的可能性，與世界大勢密切相關。

title: US intelligence believes Jensen Huang had affair with Chinese spy in honeypot operation
zh_title: 美国情报机构认为黄仁勋在蜜罐行动中与中国间谍有染
summary: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋成为新争议的焦点，因为美国情报界认为他与一名疑似中国间谍有过恋爱关系。据英国《金融时报》报道，Alice Huang（有时被称为黄乐）是新加坡公司 Megaspeed 的高管，据报道与全球最大人工智能芯片制造商的首席执行官有恋情。值得注意的是，Jensen 目前已与结婚 41 年的妻子 Lori Huang 结婚。目前尚不清楚 Alice Huang 在加入 Megaspeed 之前是否被中国国家安全部 (MSS) 招募
content:
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋成为新争议的焦点，因为美国情报界认为他与一名疑似中国间谍有过恋爱关系。据英国《金融时报》报道，Alice Huang（有时被称为黄乐）是新加坡公司 Megaspeed 的高管，据报道与全球最大人工智能芯片制造商的首席执行官有恋情。值得注意的是，Jensen 目前已与结婚 41 年的妻子 Lori Huang 结婚。目前尚不清楚 Alice Huang 是在加入 Megaspeed 之前还是在与 Jensen 建立业务关系之后被中国国家安全部 (MSS) 招募，但有报道称，这名涉嫌特工的目标显然是 Nvidia 负责人，以帮助中国公司获得被禁的 AI 芯片。深入了解 TH Premium：AI 短缺（图片来源：Nvidia） AI 数据中心正在吞噬全球内存和存储供应 对数据中心 CPU 的需求激增，AI 代理是罪魁祸首 在 Nexperia 和 DRAM 危机不断恶化的情况下，芯片稀缺袭击了汽车行业 定制 AI ASIC 的现状 Megaspeed 被指控通过其子公司 Speedmatrix 将价值 20 亿美元的 AI 芯片走私到中国，尽管 Nvidia 坚称该公司与中国没有关系。 Megaspeed 位于与中国有联系的公司网络的中心，它之前与一家名为第七大道国际的中国游戏公司有联系。
它成立于 2023 年，据报道由黄乐有限公司所有，由黄乐女士或 Alice Huang 领导，同年被出售给 Swiftdata。次年，Megaspeed 通过 Speedmatrix 注册成立，该子公司在马来西亚柔佛州设有两个办事处。该子公司是走私指控的中心。对黄乐或爱丽丝黄的研究揭示了不一致的地方。有报道称，她的职业生涯始于湖南卫视和中央电视台的一名电视记者，但前者的一位高管声称从未听说过她，而后者则没有她的个人资料。在从事媒体工作后，她进入银行和金融领域，担任汇丰银行私人银行部门总裁助理，然后成为中国金融服务公司中信证券的副总裁。目前还不清楚她之后是如何加入 Megaspeed 的，但黄女士似乎在上海和浙江周围建立了一个由公司和投资者组成的网络，积极推动手机游戏公司转向人工智能数据中心。人们质疑像 Megaspeed 这样的小公司为何会无缘无故地投入如此大的精力购买 Nvidia AI GPU，但这确实引起了黄仁勋的注意。在该公司下了大笔订单后，人们发现爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 在 LinkedIn 帖子中与黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 以及技嘉 (Gigabyte) 和 NetThunder 的其他行业高管一起喝酒。
一年后，当英伟达首席执行官离开一家台湾餐厅时，有人看到她和其他人一起站在英伟达首席执行官身后。英伟达否认了这些指控，称黄仁勋每年会见数千名客户高管，他们交换普通商业信息，而不是敏感的英伟达商业机密或国家安全信息。中国还表示，国安部对黄仁勋从事间谍活动的指控只是对北京的“毫无根据的抹黑和诽谤”。然而，外国情报机构

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia chief Jensen Huang is the center of a new controversy as the U.S. intelligence community believes that he had a romantic relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. According to the Financial Times , Alice Huang, sometimes referred to as Huang Le, was a top executive at Singaporean firm Megaspeed and was reportedly romantically involved with the CEO of the world's largest AI chip manufacturer. Notably, Jensen is currently married to his wife of 41 years, Lori Huang. It’s unclear whether Alice Huang was recruited by the Chinese Ministry of State Security (MSS) before she joined Megaspeed or after she had already established a business relationship with Jensen, but it’s been reported that the suspected agent was apparently targeting the Nvidia head to help Chinese companies gain access to banned AI chips. Go deeper with TH Premium: AI shortages (Image credit: Nvidia) AI data centers are swallowing the world's memory and storage supply Demand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsible Chip scarcity assaults auto industry amid the worsening Nexperia and DRAM crisis The custom AI ASIC state of play Megaspeed has been accused of smuggling $2 billion worth of AI chips into China via its subsidiary Speedmatrix, although Nvidia insists the company has no ties to China. Megaspeed sits at the center of a web of companies linked to China, and it was previously connected to a Chinese gaming company called 7Road International. It was founded in 2023 and reportedly owned by Huang Le Limited, led by Ms. Huang Le, or Alice Huang, before it was sold to Swiftdata that same year. The following year, Megaspeed used Speedmatrix to incorporate, with the subsidiary having two offices in Johor, Malaysia. The subsidiary is at the center of the smuggling allegations. Research into Huang Le, or Alice Huang, has revealed inconsistencies. There were reports that she started her career as a TV journalist working for Hunan TV and Chinese state broadcaster China Central Television (CCTV), but an executive at the former claims to have never heard of her, while she does not have a profile under the latter. After her supposed stint in media, she moved into banking and finance as assistant to the president of HSBC’s private banking division before becoming vice president at CITIC Securities, a Chinese financial services company. It’s unclear how she became involved with Megaspeed after that, but it seems Ms. Huang built a network of companies and investors around Shanghai and Zhejiang that aggressively pushed mobile gaming companies toward AI data centers. Questions arose about how a small company like Megaspeed could commit so much to buying Nvidia AI GPUs seemingly out of nowhere, but it certainly caught Jensen Huang's attention. After the company made its massive order, Alice Huang was spotted in a LinkedIn post hanging out for drinks with Jensen Huang and other industry executives from Gigabyte and NetThunder. She was once again seen standing behind the Nvidia chief, alongside other people, one year later as he exited a Taiwan restaurant. Nvidia has denied the allegations, saying Jensen Huang meets with thousands of customer executives annually and that they exchange ordinary business information — not sensitive Nvidia trade secrets or national security information. China has also said that these accusations of espionage on Jensen Huang by the MSS are just “groundless smears and slanders” against Beijing. However, foreign intelligence agencies also routinely conduct “honeypot” operations, using operatives to ensnare targets into relationships to extract data and gain insight into industry secrets. While these operations traditionally targeted politicians, members of the military, and their staff, the Lansing Institute suggests that “China is employing ‘attractive women’ posing as investors, business professionals, academics, or romantic partners to gain access to U.S. tech talent, networks, and research infrastructure.”

title: Inside ARTEX: AI Hacking Tools, Exposed Servers and South Korean Bank Breaches
zh_title: ARTEX 内部：人工智能黑客工具、暴露的服务器和韩国银行漏洞
summary: Hunt.io 追踪了影响七家韩国金融机构的 ARTEX 服务器和人工智能黑客工具。 2026 年 9 月底至 10 月初期间，七家韩国金融机构的数据通过面向互联网的系统遭到泄露。约 66,000 至 67,000 人以及约 2,200 家企业受到影响，个人、就业、收入和贷款数据被曝光。 Hunt.io 深入研究了该活动背后的基础设施，其发现为 CrowdStrike 和 Genians 已经发布的内容增添了很多内容。 CrowdStrike 10 月 7 日报道和 Genians 安全中心
content:
Hunt.io 追踪了影响七家韩国金融机构的 ARTEX 服务器和人工智能黑客工具。 2026 年 9 月底至 10 月初期间，七家韩国金融机构的数据通过面向互联网的系统遭到泄露。约 66,000 至 67,000 人以及约 2,200 家企业受到影响，个人、就业、收入和贷款数据被曝光。 Hunt.io 深入研究了该活动背后的基础设施，其发现为 CrowdStrike 和 Genians 已经发布的内容增添了很多内容。 CrowdStrike 于 10 月 7 日报道，Genians 安全中心于 10 月 12 日报道，均指向 ARTEX，这是一个在中国开发并获得 AGPL-3.0 许可的开源自主渗透测试框架。 CrowdStrike 的评估有一定的把握，认为该组织是由一个受金钱驱动的讲中文的个人操控的，而不是一个既定的威胁组织。 DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 是主要模型，GLM 5.3 和 Grok 4.6 作为备份，部分通过经销商域 xcai[.]pro 实现。公共指标是位于 38.244.50[.]120 的服务器，该服务器托管 ARTEX 控制台，以及一个香港地址和 9 个代理。 Genians 表示，ARTEX GitHub 存储库和 Docker 镜像已于 10 月 11 日删除，但分支和镜像仍然存在。 “CrowdStrike 的评估有一定的把握，认为该操作者是一个讲中文的个人，其动机是经济利益，而不是一个既定的威胁组织。” Hunt.io 发布的报告中写道。
“据报道，基础设施部分通过经销商域 xcai[.]pro 访问这些服务。两份报告都描述了双服务器配置，包括用作主要基础设施的香港 IP 地址和托管 ARTEX 控制台的 38.244.50[.]120 。” Hunt.io 在发布前通知了相关国家 CERT，并表示该报告没有任何个人记录或凭证。该公司自己的扫描显示 38.244.50[.]120 位于洛杉矶 Cogent 的网络上，有 15 个开放端口。 ARTEX 登录页面的中文标题是“自主渗透测试控制台”，出现在端口 443 和 8090 上。其他服务包括 Gemini2API 管理控制台和 Tinyproxy 服务器。 Hunt.io 在其 AttackCapture 平台上搜索该地址时，发现了另一个开放目录：23.248.226[.]250，这是位于香港 AS138415 上的跳转服务器。它在 2 个子目录中包含 42 个文件，总共 105 MB，该平台已于 9 月 5 日、9 月 26 日和 10 月 5 日记录了警告。其中的一个文件将 38.244.50[.]120 命名为跳转主机，其注释告诉操作员切勿将凭据粘贴到会话中。它位于一个开放的目录中。三个脚本支持链接。他们保持反向 SSH 隧道处于活动状态，运行本地中继，并将文件复制到跳转主机，其中一条隧道名为 grok2api，凭证文件还保存智普 AI 的 GLM 模型、兼容 OpenAI 的中继和代理服务的密钥。
这解释了多个语言模型如何在一次活动中运行。人工智能设置是最引人注目的部分。状态文件显示该工具是 Claude Code 本身，版本 2.1.221，自 8 月 4 日以来启动了 510 次，但它没有与 Anthropic 对话。一个小型代理 ds-models-shim.py 通过伪造模型列表并向 DeepSeek 发送请求来修复兼容性问题，另一个代理 xcai-effort-shim.py 添加推理设置，因为 DeepSeek 后端会跳过其推理步骤。该路线从 Claude Code 出发，通过 Claude Code Router（一个开源软件）

【原文 English Original】
Hunt.io traced ARTEX servers and AI-powered hacking tools used in breaches affecting seven South Korean financial institutions. Between late September and early October 2026, seven South Korean financial institutions had data breached through internet-facing systems. About 66,000 to 67,000 people and around 2,200 corporations were affected, and personal, employment, income and loan data was exposed. Hunt.io dug into the infrastructure behind the campaign , and its findings add a lot to what CrowdStrike and Genians already published. CrowdStrike reported on October 7 and Genians Security Center on October 12 , and both pointed to ARTEX , an open-source autonomous penetration testing framework developed in China and licensed under AGPL-3.0. CrowdStrike assessed with moderate confidence that a single Chinese-speaking individual motivated by money ran it, and not an established threat group. DeepSeek v4.1 Flash was the main model, with GLM 5.3 and Grok 4.6 as backups, reached partly through a reseller domain, xcai[.]pro. The public indicators were a server at 38.244.50[.]120, which hosted the ARTEX console, plus a Hong Kong address and nine proxies. Genians said the ARTEX GitHub repository and Docker image were removed on October 11, though forks and mirrors remain. “CrowdStrike assessed with moderate confidence that the operator was a single Chinese-speaking individual motivated by financial gain rather than an established threat group.” reads the report published by Hunt.io. “The infrastructure reportedly accessed these services in part through the reseller domain xcai[.]pro . Both reports described a two-server configuration, consisting of a Hong Kong-based IP address used as primary infrastructure and 38.244.50[.]120 , which hosted the ARTEX console.” Hunt.io notified the relevant national CERT before publishing, and says the report holds no personal records or credentials. The company’s own scanning showed 38.244.50[.]120 sits on Cogent’s network in Los Angeles, with 15 open ports. The ARTEX login page, with a Chinese title meaning “autonomous penetration testing console”, appears on ports 443 and 8090. Other services include a Gemini2API admin console and a Tinyproxy server. Searching its AttackCapture platform for that address, Hunt.io found another open directory at 23.248.226[.]250, a jump server in Hong Kong on AS138415. It held 42 files in 2 subdirectories, 105 MB in all, and the platform had logged warnings on September 5, September 26 and October 5. A file in it names 38.244.50[.]120 as the jump host, and its own comment tells the operator never to paste the credentials into a session. It sat in an open directory. Three scripts back up the link. They keep reverse SSH tunnels alive, run a local relay, and copy files to the jump host, one tunnel is named grok2api, and the credentials file also holds keys for Zhipu AI’s GLM models, an OpenAI-compatible relay and a proxy service. That explains how several language models ran in one campaign. The AI setup is the most striking part. A state file shows the harness is Claude Code itself, version 2.1.221, started 510 times since August 4, but it isn’t talking to Anthropic. A small proxy, ds-models-shim.py, fixes a compatibility problem by faking a model list and sending requests to DeepSeek, and another, xcai-effort-shim.py, adds a reasoning setting because the DeepSeek backend otherwise skips its reasoning step. The route runs from Claude Code through Claude Code Router, an open-source project, to xcai and then to DeepSeek. “A small local proxy, ds-models-shim.py , addresses a compatibility issue: the official /v1/models endpoint returns a 404 response when queried against a non-Anthropic backend, preventing Claude Code from discovering the available models. The shim intercepts that specific request and returns a locally defined model list containing deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-flash . All other requests are forwarded to api.deepseek.com/anthropic.” states the report. The same file counts 19 custom skills, reusable instruction sets for the agent, with 147 recorded uses. They cover code audit, reconnaissance, web injection, WAF bypass testing, authentication testing, Telegram Mini Apps, APK download and decompiling, cloud phone control and payment logic testing. Next to the payment skill sat three self-registered test accounts with tokens for a cash-in deposit API, dated September 12, and a comment calls them an authorized, self-built test. The setup fits testing for insecure direct object reference flaws, a technique CrowdStrike and Genians described against Korean loan and inquiry services. The directory also held supporting tools. A script queried FOFA, a Chinese asset search engine like Shodan, through a third-party API, and a comment says the primary membership had expired and a backup key was in use. Proxy scripts enumerated a rotating proxy service at 154.201.79[.]246:443, where 79 unique exit IPs showed up among the first 100 identities tested. A separate directory at 23.248.226[.]250:8001 held a small staged setup for JNDI and LDAP exploitation, retrieved on October 5 at 03:42 UTC. It confirms command execution through a DNS callback, and one script lets web and LDAP traffic share a single port. Hunt.io’s analysis describes the tooling without publishing steps to reproduce it. Other recovered files include tools aimed at a cryptocurrency exchange’s admin session and withdrawals, Linux privilege escalation exploits, iOS probe source code and Android kernel and firmware utilities. Hunt.io says their connection to the Korean breaches isn’t confirmed. Hunt.io then showed how to hunt ARTEX servers. Searching for an ARTEX certificate issuer returned 19 IP addresses, and searching its malware classification returned 1,303 addresses across 30 countries, led by the United States, China and Hong Kong. Those figures show where addresses are registered, not where the operator sits. “The result returned 19 distinct IP addresses, including 38.244.50[.]120. This method is precise but limited to hosts that expose a matching certificate. Systems using a different certificate will not appear in these results.” continues the report. Matching the console’s page title returned about 1,300 IPs, and a looser search found 21 title strings, 19 of them likely ARTEX consoles, in English, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese and Vietnamese. A malware-name search in AttackCapture gave 280 results with open directories. One at 130.94.31[.]86:18888 in Seoul held two small scripts, and another at 156.251.11[.]39 held an SMB reconnaissance toolkit whose test script writes a file named artex_probe_11876.txt. More hosts held exploitation kits for DedeCMS and FangCMS, a CAPTCHA bypass suite, a RuoYi and Spring administrative console exploit and CAPTCHA-based login automation. Together they show the framework attracting many operators. For defenders, the advice is plain. Remove public access and put administration behind VPNs or allowlists, and reset SSH passwords and rotate API keys, proxy credentials and tokens that exposed files may have revealed. Patch internet-facing services, watch for unexpected LDAP and JNDI activity, DNS callbacks and remote script downloads, and store secrets in a managed vault with least-privilege permissions. Also restrict access to model gateways, watch their requests, and enforce compliance rules on managed phones. Hunt.io’s lesson is that an investigation shouldn’t stop at the first list of indicators, because The company also published indicators of compromise in its analysis. “The findings highlight risks associated with exposed administrative services, reusable credentials, remote access tunnels, proxy infrastructure, and exploitation tooling.” concludes the report. Follow me on Twitter:  @securityaffairs  and  Facebook  and  Mastodon Pierluigi Paganini ( SecurityAffairs – hacking, ARTEX)

content:
政治 “入侵世界，邀请世界”的选举 如果不颠覆一个国家的政治，就无法改变一个国家的人口结构。由于选民对伊朗战争及其经济后果感到沮丧，共和党在中期选举中遭受重创，甚至包括副总统 J.D. 万斯在内的许多共和党人也承认这一点。但民主党取得如此规模的压倒性胜利是由另一个因素促成的：过去几十年来，美国的种族人口结构转型主要是由大规模移民推动的。如果只有白人投票，共和党就会加强对参议院、众议院和州级办公室的控制。如果只有非白人投票的话，那么，连中共都会羡慕民主党的绝对统治地位。正如右翼社会评论家史蒂夫·塞勒（Steve Sailer）的名言，“入侵世界，邀请世界”，他总结了我们无能的领导层的军事和移民政策。这就是这次选举的故事。佐治亚州曾经是一个红宝石色的州，已经从 1990 年白人占绝对多数的州变成了今天白人占少数的州。因此，尽管乔治亚州白人大幅支持共和党候选人，桃州还是将乔恩·奥索夫送回参议院，并选举凯莎·兰斯·博顿斯担任州长，两人都是民主党人。德克萨斯州——传统上由共和党控制的人口最多的州——的结果更加令人震惊。但数据讲述了相同的基本情况。
德克萨斯州只有37%是白人，这也是民主党在孤星州占据主导地位的一个重要原因。倾向相当保守的德克萨斯州拉美裔不仅变蓝，而且人数众多。堪萨斯州、俄亥俄州、南卡罗来纳州，这样的例子不胜枚举，但你明白了。可以肯定的是，如果特朗普政府在过去两年里治理得更有能力——特别是如果它没有发动灾难性的伊朗战争——那么白人和非白人就不会像他们那样强烈地转向民主党，共和党也可能保住参议院。但这还不是故事的全部。美国的种族多样性为其选举奠定了背景，而这种背景对共和党来说越来越难以驾驭。我在印刷品和网络上（以及再次在网上）指出，由于美国人口结构的变化，民主党正在走向永久多数。很少有人同意我的分析——甚至经典著作《新兴的民主多数》（2002）的作者也否认了他们书中的论点——但我毫不怀疑。如果您仍然持怀疑态度，请思考一下这两个事实：1）自赫伯特·胡佛以来，还没有共和党总统候选人赢得过任何非白人种族群体的多数选票，2）到 2045 年左右，美国将成为非白人占多数的国家。反思完了吗？这是另一个事实：两党之间白人的分歧仍然比其他种族群体更大。
由白人自由主义者和非白人组成的民主党联盟如果成立，将在美国选民变成少数派之前数年实现稳定的统治。有几个因素减缓了民主党永久多数派的出现。投票的选民比一般人口更白。红队偶尔可以赢得超过 40% 的拉美裔选民，这是美国最大的少数族裔群体。许多未受过大学教育的白人已经逃往共和党，部分原因是对民主党的跨性别主义等精品文化迷恋的反应。以及反多数主义机构——格里姆

【原文 English Original】
Politics The ‘Invade the World, Invite the World’ Election You can’t transform a nation’s demographics without upending its politics. The Republican Party got smacked in the midterm elections because of voter frustration over the Iran War and its economic consequences, as even many Republicans, including Vice President J.D. Vance, have acknowledged. But the scale of the Democrats’ sweeping victory was enabled by another factor: America’s racial-demographic transformation over the past several decades, driven largely by mass migration. If only whites had voted, the Republican Party would have strengthened its hold on the Senate, the House of Representatives, and state-level offices. If only nonwhites had voted, well, even the Chinese Communists would envy the Democratic Party its utter dominance. “Invade the world, invite the world,” as the right-wing social commentator Steve Sailer famously put it, summarizing our inept leadership’s military and immigration policies. That’s the story of this election. Georgia, once a ruby-red state, has gone from being supermajority white in 1990 to minority white today. So even though white Georgians favored the Republican candidates by wide margins, the Peach State sent Jon Ossoff back to the Senate and elected Keisha Lance Bottoms as governor, both Democrats. The results in Texas—the most populous state traditionally held by the GOP—were even more shocking. But the data tell the same basic story. Only 37 percent of Texans are white, which is a big reason why Democrats dominated in the Lone Star State. Texas Hispanics, who tend to be fairly conservative, not only shifted blue but turned out in large numbers. Kansas, Ohio, South Carolina, the list goes on and on, but you get the idea. To be sure, if the Trump administration had governed more competently during the past two years—and especially if it hadn’t launched the disastrous Iran War—then whites and nonwhites alike wouldn’t have swung as sharply as they did toward the Democrats, and Republicans might have held onto the Senate. But that’s not the whole story. America’s racial diversity sets the context for its elections, and that context is an increasingly difficult one for Republicans to navigate. I’ve argued in print and online (and online again) that the Democrats are heading toward a permanent majority because of America’s changing demographics. Few people agree with my analysis—and even the authors of the classic text The Emerging Democratic Majority (2002) have disavowed their book’s thesis—but I harbor little doubt. If you remain skeptical, reflect on these two facts for a while: 1) No Republican presidential candidate since Herbert Hoover has won a majority of votes from any nonwhite racial group, and 2) America will be majority nonwhite by around 2045. Done reflecting? Here’s another fact: Whites remain more divided than other racial groups between the two parties. A Democratic coalition of white liberals and nonwhites, if it holds, will achieve stable domination years before America’s electorate turns majority-minority. Several factors have slowed the emergence of a permanent Democratic majority. The voting electorate is whiter than the general population. The Red Team can occasionally win more than 40 percent of Hispanics, America’s largest minority group. Many non-college-educated whites have fled to the GOP, partly in reaction to the Democrats’ boutique cultural fixations like transgenderism. And countermajoritarian institutions—gerrymandering in the House, malapportionment in the Senate, and the electoral college—mostly benefit the Republicans. Some analysts, after Donald Trump’s dramatic victory in 2024, posited a new “multiracial coalition” that would keep the GOP in the game. It was wishful thinking. Trump made inroads with nonwhites, but he merely brought the GOP back to its George W. Bush numbers, more or less. The margin of error for Republican presidential candidates is apparently slim. In 2024, Trump mobilized blue-collar whites and did reasonably well among minorities. And yet, facing a disastrous candidate installed at the 11th hour, Trump won the popular vote by a smaller margin than Hillary Clinton in 2016. What transpired this week was a different matter altogether—an electoral backlash that some thought impossible in our age of polarization—and it will have long-lasting political consequences. The Dems will probably maintain their Senate majority over several election cycles, and if Texas just became solidly blue, Republicans won’t stand a chance at winning the White House in 2028. Of course, a permanent Democratic majority doesn’t mean an eternal one. Perhaps the Democratic Party will splinter between its moderate and progressive factions, or maybe a viable third party will emerge that, over time, replaces the GOP. On the other hand, in cities and states that long ago became majority nonwhite, the Democrats enjoy one-party rule, and governance generally suffers. A nation is its people, as right-wingers often say. And you can’t transform a nation without upending its politics. The post The ‘Invade the World, Invite the World’ Election appeared first on The American Conservative .

10月，在海峡两岸颇受欢迎的台湾知名电视主持人蔡康永被媒体拍到出席竞选台北市市长的立委沉彪马的竞选活动。鉴于蔡英文在中国的受欢迎程度，他的出现很快引发了批评。现任台北市市长蒋万安邀请蔡英文参加他自己的竞选总部的落成典礼，从而化解了争议。在参加沉的竞选活动三周后，蔡英文公开表示，他从未支持台独，他的工作需要他与持有不同政治观点的人互动。第二天，他参加了蒋介石的竞选活动。
如果参加集会就等于宣布支持台湾的未来，想象一下11月28日的投票结果会如何。
执政的民进党候选人沉多年来一直在研究中国的影响力运作并促进台湾的平民准备。中国当局已以分裂国家罪名对他展开调查。国民党现任总统蒋介石在台北和上海的官员之间保持着开放的沟通渠道。北京和华盛顿可能会倾向于将沈氏的胜利解读为对独立的投票，或者将蒋介石的胜利解读为转向中国。然而，无论哪种解释都会将市政选举与台北选民未被要求投票的问题联系起来。
考虑一下沉和蒋 10 月 31 日辩论期间的一次交流。蒋要求沉解释为什么两个重建项目（一个在大同，另一个在内湖）陷入停滞。蒋将延误归因于台北松山机场附近建筑高度的限制。沉先生反驳了自己的问题：如果市政府官员知道这些限制，为什么他们不从一开始就向居民解释呢？蒋介石利用这次交流质疑他的挑战者对城市事务的指挥。反过来，沉用它来询问居民，如果他们发现障碍来得太晚而无法采取任何行动，那么专业知识对他们有什么好处。
然而，从他们激烈的交流中得到的最重要的收获不是候选人所说的话，而是他们没有说的话。中国这个两岸关系中的大象，在两个小时的辩论中一次也没有被作为关键问题提出。
这概括了台北选民实际做出决定时所依据的当地问题。有些人可能会投票给蒋，认为他推动了其他困难项目的进展，其中包括南机场夜市的一个项目。其他人可能会赞成沉的建议，即对旧建筑进行地震风险筛查并帮助居民安排维修。两个房主可以投票给不同的坦率

In October, well-known Taiwanese television host Kevin Tsai, popular on both sides of the Taiwan Strait, was spotted by the media attending a campaign event for Puma Shen, a legislator running for mayor of Taipei. Given Tsai’s popularity in China, his appearance quickly sparked criticism. The incumbent Taipei mayor, Chiang Wan-an, helped defuse the controversy by inviting Tsai to the opening of his own campaign headquarters. Three weeks after attending Shen’s campaign event, Tsai publicly stated that he had never supported Taiwanese independence and that his work required him to interact with people holding a range of political views. The following day, he attended Chiang’s campaign event.
If attending a rally is tantamount to declaring one’s support for Taiwan’s future, imagine what will be made of the November 28 vote.
Shen, the candidate of the ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), has spent years studying Chinese influence operations and promoting civilian preparedness in Taiwan. Chinese authorities have opened an investigation into him on allegations of secession. Chiang, the Kuomintang (KMT) incumbent, has maintained an open channel of communication between officials in Taipei and Shanghai. Beijing and Washington may be tempted to interpret a Shen victory as a vote for independence or a Chiang victory as a turn toward China. Either interpretation, however, would link a municipal election to an issue that Taipei’s voters have not been asked to vote on.
Consider an exchange during the October 31 debate between Shen and Chiang. Chiang challenged Shen to explain why two redevelopment projects, one in Datong and the other in Neihu, had stalled. Chiang attributed the delays to restrictions on building heights near Taipei’s Songshan Airport. Shen fired back with a question of his own: If city officials knew about these restrictions, why hadn’t they explained them to residents from the outset? Chiang used the exchange to question his challenger’s command of city affairs. Shen, in turn, used it to ask what good that expertise did residents if they learned about an obstacle too late to do anything about it.
The most important takeaway from their heated exchanges, however, is not what the candidates said, but what they left unsaid. China, the elephant in the room when it comes to cross-strait relations, was not raised even once as a key issue during the two-hour debate.
That encapsulates the kind of local issues Taipei voters will actually base their decision on. Some might vote for Chiang, crediting him with moving other difficult projects forward, including one at Nanjichang Night Market. Others might favor Shen’s proposal to screen older buildings for earthquake risks and to help residents arrange repairs. Two homeowners could vote for different candidates – while holding precisely the same views about China. The election night count offers no way to tell.
Taipei’s recent electoral history illustrates the limits of interpreting local elections through the lens of national politics – and vice versa. In 2022, the city elected Chiang as mayor. Just over a year later, in the presidential election, the DPP’s Lai Ching-te carried Taipei, edging out the KMT’s Hou Yu-ih by just 641 votes. Chiang’s mayoral victory would therefore have been a poor guide to the city’s presidential preferences. There is even less reason to interpret a vote in the capital as evidence of a broader change of heart across Taiwan for or against a political party – or that party’s approach to China.
True, the result will shape national politics. Winning Taipei would give Shen a larger audience for his work on civilian defense. A second term would give Chiang greater standing within the KMT to make the case for engagement with Shanghai, and possibly Beijing. Plus, the Taipei mayorship has in the past served as a launching pad for presidential ambitions. Winning office gives a politician the chance to advance causes that may have had little to do with why voters chose him.
The election’s outcome could certainly also influence cross-strait relations. During Chiang’s tenure, the Taipei–Shanghai Twin-City Forum has kept officials from the two cities in contact. A Chiang victory would give him another term to pursue those exchanges. A Shen victory would test the conditions under which they can continue. Although Shen has criticized the forum’s value, he has said he would attend if it offered practical benefits and came without political preconditions. On October 14, Beijing’s Taiwan Affairs Office dismissed his offer, citing his alleged support for independence.
Suppose Shen wins, repeats his offer, and finds Shanghai unwilling to meet with him. Concluding that Taipei voters chose to sever contact would erase Beijing’s role in the decision. The reverse inference – that vote for Chiang implies approval of his engagement with Chinese officials – would be equally questionable. A Taipei resident might value Chiang’s ability to keep municipal officials talking while still opposing closer political ties. Wanting the conversation with Shanghai to continue is entirely compatible with wanting Beijing to have less say in Taiwan’s affairs.
Local governance is undoubtedly important for the stability of the Taiwan Strait. Taipei’s city government, for example, helps residents prepare for an air raid, down to practicing how to reach shelter when the sirens sound. How well the city carries out that work matters regardless of which party holds power. Still, it’s not going to be an issue that is top of mind when Taipei residents fill out their ballots.
On November 28, Taipei’s voters will choose who takes responsibility for the safety of their homes, the city’s readiness for an emergency, and its dealings with Shanghai. Beijing and Washington have good reason to pay close attention to what the next mayor does with that authority. But anyone claiming a mandate for independence or unification is looking for evidence the mayoral count cannot provide.
