title: Australian miners rail against looming tax changes
zh_title: 澳大利亚矿商强烈反对即将到来的税收改革
summary: 澳大利亚矿业高管和行业团体正在加大对联邦政府的压力，要求联邦政府免除矿产勘探者计划中的资本利得税（CGT）改革，他们警告称，这可能会损害投资并削弱该国的全球竞争力。财长吉姆·查尔默斯 (Jim Chalmers) 在 2026 年 5 月的联邦预算中宣布的改革将以成本基础指数化取代长期存在的 50% 企业所得税折扣，并对 2027 年 7 月 1 日起产生的收益征收 30% 的最低税。政府向科技初创企业提供豁免，但在 9 月确认勘探公司不会取消
content:
澳大利亚矿业高管和行业团体正在加大对联邦政府的压力，要求联邦政府免除矿产勘探者计划中的资本利得税（CGT）改革，他们警告称，这可能会损害投资并削弱该国的全球竞争力。财政部长吉姆·查尔默斯 (Jim Chalmers) 在 2026 年 5 月的联邦预算中宣布的改革将用成本基础指数化取代长期存在的 50% 资本利得税折扣，并对自 2027 年 7 月 1 日起产生的收益征收 30% 的最低税。政府向科技初创企业提供豁免，但在 9 月确认勘探公司不会获得同样的待遇。 “资本利得税太可怕了，”Evolution Mining (ASX: EVN) 创始人兼董事长 Jake Klein 在悉尼举行的国际矿业和资源大会 (IMARC) 上表示。这场争端发生之际，澳大利亚面临着绿地勘探不断减少和全球矿业资本竞争日益激烈的局面。行业领袖认为，改革将阻止投资者支持早期发现，可能会削弱支持未来矿产生产所需的项目管道。勘探面临风险 澳大利亚矿产委员会首席经济学家罗斯·兰比表示，改革未能认识到与矿产勘探相关的高风险和低成功率。 “探索绝对至关重要。我们必须做更多的事情，”他告诉 IMARC 小组。
兰比表示，投资者接受了勘探企业亏损的可能性，因为成功的发现可以带来丰厚的回报。拟议的税收安排将减少这些潜在的回报。 “所以，这是糟糕的政策。我们已经要求政府像对待创新型初创企业一样对待初级探险家，并考虑到该行业的独特特征，给予该行业让步，但到目前为止，这一要求被置若罔闻。”西澳大利亚州矿产和能源商会首席执行官亚伦·莫雷表示，这些变化也与澳大利亚发展其关键矿产行业的雄心相冲突。莫雷指出，安东尼·阿尔巴内塞总理访问白宫，与美国官员的讨论重点是推进矿产项目。 “这项政策从根本上违背了这一愿景，”他说。采矿和勘探公司协会也对改革提出了挑战。尽管政府已就该立法展开新一轮磋商，但该协会警告称，如果不进行实质性修改，这一过程将毫无意义。行业影响 此前曾批评澳大利亚政府政策的克莱因表示，税收改革是该行业面临的几项政策阻力之一。他说：“像我 30 年前那样，今天开始职业生涯的人，没有理由表现得比我差 25%，这完全没有道理。”
Westgold Resources (ASX/TSX: WGX)董事总经理Wayne Bramwell将拟议的改革描述为“自己的目标”，会损害澳大利亚的勘探行业。“联邦关于资本利得税的决定——以不同于初创企业的方式对待澳大利亚的勘探——绝对会给这个国家带来糟糕的结果，”他在IMARC间隙表示。布拉姆韦尔表示，这种影响已经在西澳大利亚州显现出来，西澳大利亚州是该国最大的勘探支出目的地。 “这个国家最大的勘探资金目的地已经开始枯竭，因为现在从事高风险工作的人都没有工作。

【原文 English Original】
Australian mining executives and industry groups are intensifying pressure on the federal government to exempt mineral explorers from planned capital gains tax (CGT) changes they warn could undermine investment and weaken the country’s global competitiveness. The reforms, announced by Treasurer Jim Chalmers in the May 2026 federal budget, would replace the longstanding 50% CGT discount with cost base indexation and a 30% minimum tax on gains accruing from July 1, 2027. The government granted exemptions to technology start-ups but confirmed in September that exploration companies would not receive the same treatment. “The capital gains tax is terrible,” Evolution Mining (ASX: EVN) founder and chairman Jake Klein said during the International Mining and Resources Convention (IMARC) in Sydney. The dispute comes as Australia faces declining greenfields exploration and growing competition for global mining capital. Industry leaders argue the reforms would discourage investors from backing early-stage discoveries, potentially weakening the pipeline of projects needed to support future mineral production. Exploration at risk Minerals Council of Australia chief economist Ross Lambie said the reforms failed to recognize the high risks and low success rates associated with mineral exploration. “Exploration is absolutely critical. We’ve got to be doing more of it,” he told an IMARC panel. Lambie said investors accepted the possibility of losing money on exploration ventures because successful discoveries could deliver substantial returns. The proposed tax arrangements would diminish those potential rewards. “So, this is bad policy. We have asked the government to treat junior explorers the same as what they want to treat innovative start-ups and give the industry a concession, given the unique characteristics it has, but so far, that’s fallen on deaf ears.” Chamber of Minerals and Energy of Western Australia CEO Aaron Morey said the changes also conflicted with Australia’s ambitions to develop its critical minerals industry. Morey pointed to Prime Minister Anthony Albanese’s visit to the White House , where discussions with US officials focused on advancing minerals projects. “That is a policy that is fundamentally at odds with that vision,” he said. The Association of Mining and Exploration Companies has also challenged the reforms. Although the government has opened another round of consultation on the legislation, the association warned the process would be meaningless without substantive changes. Industry fallout Klein, who has previously criticized Australian government policy , said the tax overhaul was among several policy headwinds confronting the sector. “There is no reason why someone starting their career today, as I did 30 years ago, is going to do 25% worse than I did – that just makes no sense at all,” he said. Westgold Resources (ASX/TSX: WGX) managing director Wayne Bramwell described the proposed changes as an “own goal” that would damage Australia’s exploration industry. “Federal decisions around capital gains tax – treating exploration in Australia differently than start-ups – absolutely leads to a bad outcome for this country,” he said on the sidelines of IMARC. Bramwell said the effects were already emerging in Western Australia, the country’s largest destination for exploration spending. “The largest destination for exploration dollars in this country has started to dry up because the people doing the high-risk work now are not being rewarded for that,” he said. He warned that the consequences could extend well beyond the immediate investment cycle, potentially damaging the exploration ecosystem for years. “That’s a real concern for me, thinking that our ecosystem has been damaged long-term by that decision. It can be reversed because we absolutely need the explorers to explore.” The latest consultation gives the government another opportunity to reconsider the treatment of junior explorers before the reforms take effect in July 2027. Whether it grants the sector relief could influence Australia’s ability to attract the risk capital needed to discover its next generation of mines.

title: 华人区成大选关键，各党派启用小红书；澳通胀目标超他国遭质疑；拍卖市场疲软，清盘率不足六成；大卫琼斯或重启，客流回升引买家关注。
summary: 1.维大选华人区成关键，各党派开小红书！ 2.澳通胀目标远超其他国，专家提出质疑！ 3.澳首府拍卖市场疲软，清盘率低于六成！ 4.大卫琼斯复活有望？客流增加买家有意！ 5.澳咖啡再涨价，一杯均价超5刀！ 维大选华人区成关键，各党派开小红书！ 维州大选进入冲刺阶段，两党领导人Ben Carroll和Jess Wilson正通过中文社交媒体，争取华人选民的支持。 民调机构认为，聚集了大量华人选民的Glen Waverley、Box Hill、Ashwood和Ringwood等选区
content: 1.维大选华人区成关键，各党派开小红书！ 2.澳通胀目标远超其他国，专家提出质疑！ 3.澳首府拍卖市场疲软，清盘率低于六成！ 4.大卫琼斯复活有望？客流增加买家有意！ 5.澳咖啡再涨价，一杯均价超5刀！ 维大选华人区成关键，各党派开小红书！ 维州大选进入冲刺阶段，两党领导人Ben Carroll和Jess Wilson正通过中文社交媒体，争取华人选民的支持。 民调机构认为，聚集了大量华人选民的Glen Waverley、Box Hill、Ashwood和Ringwood等选区，可能会决定谁能赢得11月28日的维州大选。 维州反对党党魁Jess Wilson、维州州长Ben Carroll和绿党党魁Ellen Sandell近期都频繁使用中文社交平台小红书。 维州州长Carroll于9月开设小红书账号后，几乎每天都在这个中文社交平台上发帖，希望巩固华人社区的支持，帮助工党第四次赢得执政任期。 维州联盟党党魁Jess Wilson也很活跃，她在1月注册了账号。绿党党魁Ellen Sandell则从2025年年中开始使用该平台，而一国党在小红书上几乎没有存在感。这些帖子一边发布配有普通话字幕的政策消息，一边加入专门面向华人选民的轻松内容。 竞选承诺也陆续登场。联盟党承诺投入160万澳元，建设一所普通话幼教中心，并每年拨款15万澳元支持Box Hill中国新年节庆活动。 专家表示，政界人士已经进入“对华加码”阶段。Box Hill居民中，超过四分之一有华裔背景，而邻近的Glen Waverley近30%的居民在家中说中文，是全州比例最高的地区。 澳通胀目标远超其他国，专家提出质疑！ 上周在参议院预算审查听证会上，自由党参议员Jane Hume向澳联储行长Michele Bullock提问：澳洲第三季度的基础通胀率达到3.7%，是否高于多数其他发达经济体？ Bullock回答说，澳洲的通胀目标比多数国家更高。其他国家的目标大多是2%，澳洲则是2.5%。如果比较各自通胀率偏离目标的幅度，澳洲“并没有太大不同”。 但在20家主要央行中，澳洲的超标幅度排名第二高。经济学家Justin Fabo说：“她要么错了，要么看到了我没见过的数据。” 澳洲基础通胀率已从2025年年中的2.7%升至第三季度的3.7%。这促使澳联储今年5次上调官方利率。最近一次加息后，官方利率达到4.85%的18年高位。 Bullock回应Hume时，希望对方关注澳洲通胀率与澳联储2.5%目标之间的差距，而不是只看各国通胀率的简单排名，大多数国家的通胀率都比目标高出约1个百分点。 然而，澳洲高出目标1.2个百分点，仍是美国（1.1个）、新西兰（0.9个）、英国（0.5个）和加拿大（-0.2个）之中最高的。 Fabo表示：“我有点想不明白，她到底在看哪些数据。关键在于你想表达什么，而她想表达大多数国家都处在相近水平这一点，是错的。” 澳首府拍卖市场疲软，清盘率低于六成！ 澳洲各首府城市的整体清盘率已连续逾半年低于60%。买卖双方逐步离场，生活成本压力不断加重，上周加息后，房市预计还会面临更大压力。 Cotality研究显示，截至11月8日的一周，首府城市初步清盘率为51.5%。虽然较前一周创下的六年最低点47.2%回升4.3个百分点，但这已经是清盘率连续第27周低于60%。 初步清盘率上一次达到或超过60%，是在5月初。当时联邦政府还未公布预算案，也未宣布一系列影响房市的税务改革。 首府城市共举行1734场拍卖，比去年同期少43.5%，也比2025年水平低逾40%。过去四周中，有三周的情况都是如此。拍卖表现疲弱之际，澳联储周二把官方利率上调25个基点至4.85%，创下18年来最高水平。 Cotality研究显示，墨尔本举行了612场拍卖，初步清盘率为59.1%，是八周以来的最高水平。悉尼共有709套房屋进行拍卖，初步清盘率为52.3%。 布里斯班举行了178场拍卖，清盘率为31.2%；阿德莱德有149套房屋进行拍卖，初步清盘率为43.2%。首都领地举行了68场拍卖，47.2%的房屋售出；珀斯举行了17场拍卖，初步清盘率为36.4%；塔州仅举行了1场拍卖。 大卫琼斯复活有望？客流增加买家有意！ David Jones倒闭后，已有可信的澳洲本地及海外竞标者表达收购兴趣，管理人McGrath Nicol对这家百货公司的挽救前景持乐观态度。据悉，前来询问的包括零售业人士和金融投资者，其中可能有其他私募股权公司。 David Jones的母公司Anchorage Capital也收到外界对这家倒闭百货公司的关注，但目前尚未决定是否参与重组程序、重新掌控David Jones。 与此同时，David Jones全澳门店的客流和销售额显著增加，旗舰店的升幅尤其明显，其中一家门店的营业额更达到去年同期的两倍。 随着David Jones继续营业，其他门店的访客数量也大幅增加，周末的升幅尤其突出。不过，这波人潮也可能只是David Jones礼券持有者赶着套现。 这家拥有188年历史的百货公司周四倒闭，影响遍及澳洲。要确保David Jones继续存续，唯一办法是找到买家。 重组合伙人Matthew Hutton表示：“已有来自一批信誉极高的业内人士和金融投资者的非同寻常兴趣，希望买下这个标志性的澳洲品牌和企业。” “除了管理人正在进行的接触程序外，他们还在积极联系澳洲及海外各方，这些方面都有扭转经营状况、运营成功零售百货公司的经验。” 澳咖啡再涨价，一杯均价超5刀！ 一杯小杯Flat White如今平均卖5.17澳元。4月时，同样一杯咖啡的平均价格是5.01澳元。到了9月，也就是澳联储一项备受争议的规定生效前，平均价格已升至5.11澳元。 过去半年咖啡价格一路上涨。随着商家不得再向顾客收取刷卡付款附加费，人们也在关注，这项成本最终会由商家自行消化，还是会转嫁到菜单价格上。 一项分析显示，10月约有五分之一的咖啡馆上调了价格。这项数据来自Small Flat White的创建者Chris Drake。这个网站已成为追踪澳洲各地咖啡价格的非官方工具。 约70%的咖啡馆以整数价格出售咖啡。因此，涨价时，价格通常会调到下一个以50澳分为单位的价位，或直接升到下一个整澳元价位。 一次上涨50澳分，通常约相当于一杯咖啡价格的10%。“但这不一定是因为刷卡附加费才涨价，其他成本也都在增加。”所有涨价中，近40%是上涨50澳分，其次是上涨20澳分，占13%。另有9%的涨价幅度为30澳分或1澳元。 过去6个月，首都领地的咖啡价格涨幅最大，达到4.2%。昆州、新州和维州上涨4%；南澳上涨3%；塔州和西澳的涨幅分别为2.3%和2.1%。

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits to having an affair with suspected Chinese spy
zh_title: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与疑似中国间谍有染
summary: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一名据称是中国间谍的女子有染。他在写给 Nvidia 员工的一封信中表达了歉意，您可以在下面阅读该信的全文。英伟达董事会周日晚间发表声明，回应美国情报部门认为黄与中国间谍有染的爆炸性报道。该委员会表示，没有理由相信敏感的公司信息或美国国家安全受到损害，但该公司打算检查所有可用信息以确定发生了什么。董事会声称对 Je 充满信心
content:
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一名据称是中国间谍的女子有染。他在写给 Nvidia 员工的一封信中表达了歉意，您可以在下面阅读该信的全文。英伟达董事会周日晚间发表声明，回应美国情报部门认为黄与中国间谍有染的爆炸性报道。该委员会表示，没有理由相信敏感的公司信息或美国国家安全受到损害，但该公司打算检查所有可用信息以确定发生了什么。董事会声称对黄仁勋及其领导团队充满信心。与妻子 Lori Huang 结婚 41 年的黄表示，他完全支持调查。英伟达董事会在一份声明中写道：“一个由独立董事组成的委员会将在外部独立顾问的协助下监督调查。” “董事会优先考虑美国国家和经济安全，这对 Nvidia 及其股东的利益至关重要。[……] Jensen 完全支持此次审查，并承诺与其合作。”周五，第一份报道称，美国情报机构认为黄与爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang，又名黄乐）有恋爱关系，黄乐是新加坡 Megaspeed 的前高管，据称被中国国家安全部 (MSS) 招募来收集信息并帮助中国公司获取受限制的人工智能 GPU。
至少从 2025 年起，该公司就因向中国走私受限制的硬件而受到关注：Megaspeed 被指控通过其子公司 Speedmatrix 向中国走私价值 20 亿美元的 AI 芯片。对于 NVIDIA 的同事，我欠我的家人和你们所有人一个道歉。英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋坚决否认有关不当交易的指控，称其首席执行官定期会见数千名客户，并且这些互动不涉及敏感的公司信息或国家安全机密。中国官员也驳斥了间谍指控，称其毫无根据。涉嫌针对詹森的中国情报行动尚未得到独立证实。据称，这种关系遵循典型的“蜜罐”策略，即外国情报机构利用特工诱骗目标建立恋爱关系，以窃取信息并影响他们的决策。黄仁勋一直直言不讳地批评那些反对限制向中国供应人工智能 GPU 的人。黄最近表示，“对华鹰”的标签不是美国人应该佩戴的荣誉徽章，而是应该佩戴的。这确实是“耻辱的徽章”。黄还表示，“不一定是我们或他们所有人。也可以是我们和​​他们”，这引起了政府和其他科技公司其他人的批评，其中包括 Palantir 的首席执行官。 “我欠我的家人和你们所有人一个道歉，”黄写道。 “我对我的妻子不忠。
我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。在我的一生中，我的家人给予了我爱和支持。他们值得我的诚实和忠诚。相反，我让他们失望了，破坏了我们共同建立的生活。我对我的所作所为和造成的伤害承担全部责任，并接受随之而来的批评。致我的妻子和家人：我爱你们。我知道道歉无法挽回我所做的一切。我希望我们的家庭能够痊愈，随着时间的推移，我能够赢回你们的信任。”2018 年 6 月，英特尔首席执行官布莱恩·科赞 (Brian Krzan)

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to having an affair with a woman who is allegedly a Chinese spy. His apology came in a letter to Nvidia staff, which you can read in full below. Nvidia's board of directors released a statement late on Sunday to address the bombshell report that U.S. intelligence believes Huang had an affair with a Chinese spy . The board says it has no reason to believe sensitive corporate information or U.S. national security was compromised, but the company intends to examine all available information to determine what happened. The BoD claims it is fully confident in Jensen Huang and his leadership team. Huang, who has been married to his wife, Lori Huang, for 41 years, says he fully supports the investigation. "A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation," a statement by Nvidia's BoD reads. "The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of Nvidia and its shareholders. […] Jensen fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it." On Friday, the first reporting emerged claiming U.S. intelligence agencies believe Huang had a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed who was allegedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security (MSS) to gather information and help Chinese companies obtain restricted AI GPUs. The company has been on the radar for smuggling restricted hardware to China since at least 2025: Megaspeed has been accused of smuggling $2 billion worth of AI chips into China via its subsidiary Speedmatrix. To my colleagues at NVIDIA, I owe my family and all of you an apology. Jensen Huang, Nvidia CEO Nvidia has strenuously rejected suggestions of improper dealings, saying that its CEO regularly meets thousands of customers and that these interactions do not involve sensitive corporate information or national security secrets. Chinese officials have also dismissed the espionage allegations as unfounded. The suspected Chinese intelligence operation targeting Jensen has not been independently confirmed as a fact. The relationship is alleged to follow the typical "honeypot" strategy, wherein foreign intelligence agencies use operatives to ensnare targets into romantic relationships to steal information and influence their decision-making. Huang has been an outspoken critic of those opposed to limiting the supply of AI GPUs to China. Huang recently expressed his opinion that the label 'China hawk' is not a badge of honor Americans should wear; it is really 'a badge of shame.' Huang also said it "doesn’t have to be all us or them. It could be us and them," drawing fire from others in the administration and other tech companies, including the CEO of Palantir . "I owe my family and all of you an apology," Huang wrote . "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry. Throughout my life, my family has given me love and support. They deserve my honesty and loyalty. Instead, I let them down and damaged the life we built together. I take full responsibility for what I did and the hurt I caused, and I accept the criticism that comes with it. To my wife and family: I love you. I know an apology cannot undo what I have done. I hope our family will heal and that, over time, I can earn back your trust." In June 2018, Intel chief executive Brian Krzanich resigned after an internal investigation, assisted by external legal counsel, confirmed that he had engaged in a consensual romantic relationship with an Intel employee, which violated the company's non-fraternization policy applicable to all managers. Krzanich, who had led Intel since 2013, also stepped down from the company's board, while then-chief financial officer Robert Swan took over as interim CEO. For now, it remains unclear if Jensen will meet a similar fate and lose control of the company he founded. Jensen's full letter to staff reads as follows: To my colleagues at NVIDIA, I owe my family and all of you an apology. I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry. Throughout my life, my family has given me love and support. They deserve my honesty and loyalty. Instead, I let them down and damaged the life we built together. I take full responsibility for what I did and the hurt I caused, and I accept the criticism that comes with it. To my wife and family: I love you. I know an apology cannot undo what I have done. I hope our family will heal and that, over time, I can earn back your trust. To my colleagues at NVIDIA, including those I have worked alongside for decades, and to our board, partners, and shareholders around the world: you deserve better from me. Leading NVIDIA is the privilege of my life. My responsibility is to serve you and be worthy of your trust. I have fallen short of that responsibility. I am fully committed to NVIDIA and will work to earn back your confidence. Regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports, NVIDIA’s Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting NVIDIA and supporting America’s national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American. My family bears no responsibility for my choices. I do. Please give them privacy. Jensen The whole statement from Nvidia's Board of Directors reads as follows: The Nvidia Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation. The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders. While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information. Jensen fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it. The Board has confidence in Jensen and his leadership team and will provide further updates as appropriate.

title: Two Chinese companies cleared to buy banned Nvidia AI chips have empty offices and unknown addresses
zh_title: 两家获准购买被禁英伟达人工智能芯片的中国公司办公室空荡荡，地址未知
summary: 调查发现，两家获准购买Nvidia H200芯片的中国公司的地址导致办公室空荡荡，而且大楼的接待员也不熟悉这些地址。据《纽约时报》报道，这些公司不仅拥有空置的办公室，而且还拥有空置的办公室。他们的高管经常与因与中国军方合作并向中国军方提供先进技术而受到美国制裁的其他公司有联系。这一消息揭示了人们的担忧，即美国商务部只是简单地在 GPU 出口许可证申请上盖上橡皮图章，而不是仔细审查每一项申请的有效性。
content:
调查发现，两家获准购买Nvidia H200芯片的中国公司的地址导致办公室空荡荡，而且大楼的接待员也不熟悉这些地址。据《纽约时报》报道，这些公司不仅拥有空置的办公室，而且还拥有空置的办公室。他们的高管经常与因与中国军方合作并向中国军方提供先进技术而受到美国制裁的其他公司有联系。这一消息揭示了人们的担忧，即美国商务部只是简单地在 GPU 出口许可证申请上盖上橡皮图章，而不是仔细审查每一份申请是否与北京存在潜在联系。白宫国家安全委员会前中国事务主任丽莎·托宾 (Liza Tobin) 对该刊物表示：“我非常担心商务部或英伟达都没有进行必要的尽职调查，以确保许可条款得到遵守。”其中许多获得批准的公司包括百度、比亚迪、特斯拉上海等知名实体，以及此前被美国市场列入黑名单的中兴通讯、阿里巴巴、腾讯和字节跳动。然而，该机构的调查还显示，两家相对不知名的公司获得了批准：New Matrix 和 Maginfra。两家公司的办公室都是空的，只有一些办公家具，附近工作的人表示，他们从未听说过这家公司，也没有见过有人去过这些废弃的地方。
据报道，New Matrix 网站也没有包含任何有关其所有者或历史的信息，尽管上市公司记录显示该网站是由李斌创立的，李斌和其他两位主要所有者与 Wise Road 有联系，Wise Road 是一家因帮助北京获取敏感芯片技术而受到美国制裁的中国私募股权公司。此外，李先生还担任清华紫光集团（一家由中国政府部分持股的科技集团）的董事长，并拥有新华三半导体技术公司（New H3C Semiconductor Technologies），该公司也因与中国军方合作而被列入美国商务部的实体清单。另一方面，Maginfra 被怀疑与浪潮有联系，自 2023 年以来，华盛顿因支持中国人民解放军而将浪潮列入黑名单，两家公司共享人员、专利和类似的政府所有权结构。不过，这两家公司并未被列为英伟达人工智能芯片的最终用户。相反，他们应该将它们组装成人工智能服务器，然后将其转发给最终用户，尽管尚不清楚他们的客户是谁。除了这些可疑的非实体之外，另一家获得 H200 GPU 购买许可的公司也存在一些可疑链接。据报道，浙江银盾云科技的高管与睿智智能计算技术集团的创始人有关系，该集团是一家数据中心运营商，已向中国军事承包商出售计算能力。
据报道，它的部分运营也是在 Range 数据中心进行的。唐纳德·特朗普总统于 2025 年 4 月禁止出口 Nvidia AI GPU，即使是那些为满足华盛顿为 AI 处理器设定的性能上限而定制的 GPU。去年年底，总统推翻了这一决定，以换取销量减少 25%，但第一批 H200 仍需要八个多月的时间才抵达中国。今年头几个月，北京方面拒绝为中国科技公司购买芯片开绿灯，导致了延误。但一旦中国取消了对英伟达芯片的进口禁令，几家中国公司就申请了许可证

【原文 English Original】
An investigation has found that addresses for two Chinese companies approved to purchase Nvidia H200 chips led to empty offices, and the receptionists at the buildings were unfamiliar with them. According to The New York Times , these companies didn’t just have empty offices; their executives are often linked to other firms sanctioned by the United States for working with and providing advanced technology to the Chinese military. This news has revealed concerns that the U.S. Department of Commerce is simply rubber-stamping GPU export license applications instead of scrutinizing each one for potential links to Beijing. “I have a ton of concerns that neither the Commerce Department or Nvidia is doing the due diligence needed to ensure that the licensing terms are being followed,” former China director for the White House National Security Council Liza Tobin told the publication. Many of these approved companies include well-known entities like Baidu, BYD, Tesla Shanghai, as well as ZTE , which has previously been blacklisted from the U.S. market, Alibaba, Tencent, and ByteDance. However, the outfit’s investigation also revealed approval for two relatively unknown firms: New Matrix and Maginfra. The offices for both companies were empty shells with some office furniture, and people working nearby said they’d never heard of the company or seen anyone go to the deserted spaces. The New Matrix website also reportedly did not contain any information about its owners or its history, although public company records reveal that it was founded by Li Bin, who, along with two other primary owners, are connected to Wise Road, a Chinese private equity firm sanctioned by the U.S. for helping Beijing acquire sensitive chip technologies. Furthermore, Mr. Li chairs Tsinghua Unigroup, a tech conglomerate partly owned by the Chinese government, and owns New H3C Semiconductor Technologies, which has also been added to the Commerce Department’s Entity List for cooperating with the Chinese military. Maginfra, on the other hand, is suspected of being linked to Inspur, which Washington has b lacklisted since 2023 for supporting the People’s Liberation Army, with both companies sharing personnel, patents, and a similar government ownership structure. These two firms aren’t listed as the final users of Nvidia’s AI chips, though. Instead, they’re supposed to assemble them into AI servers, which would then be forwarded to a final user, although it’s unclear who their customers are. Aside from these questionable non-entities, another company that received a license to purchase H200 GPUs has some suspicious links. Zhejiang Yindun Cloud Technology’s executives are reportedly related to the founder of Range Intelligent Computing Technology Group, a data center operator that has sold compute capacity to Chinese military contractors. It’s also reportedly partly operating out of a Range data center. President Donald Trump banned the export of Nvidia AI GPUs in April 2025 , even those customized to meet the performance ceiling Washington set for AI processors. The president reversed the decision late last year in exchange for a 25% cut of the sale, but it still took more than eight months for the first H200 shipments to arrive in China . Beijing’s refusal to give Chinese tech companies the green light to buy the chips for the first few months of the year caused the delay. But once China lifted its import ban on Nvidia chips, several Chinese companies applied for licenses to buy them, and The New York Times reported that around two dozen firms have already received approval, including these questionable ones.

title: Alex Eala suffers season-ending stunner as Liu dominates Hong Kong final
zh_title: 亚历克斯·伊拉 (Alex Eala) 遭遇季末重创，刘翔在香港决赛中称霸
source: Rappler 菲律宾（调查/南海/选举）
summary: 菲律宾马尼拉——11月8日周日，菲律宾网球巨星亚历克斯·埃拉(Alex Eala)在香港公开赛上的表现令人失望，也是历史性的2026赛季，美国对手克莱尔·刘(Claire Liu)在决赛中以6-3和6-0的优势赢得了冠军。随着对世界排名第17名埃拉的惊人胜利，世界排名第102位的刘终于在WTA 250级别上获得了突破性的职业单打冠军头衔在获得两次 WTA 125 冠军后。刘翔的冠军头衔标志着这位菲律宾偶像连续第二次爆冷，这位当时世界排名第 305 的 26 岁选手击败了排名前 50 的埃拉 (Eala)。
content:
菲律宾马尼拉——11月8日周日，菲律宾网球巨星亚历克斯·埃拉(Alex Eala)在香港公开赛上的表现令人失望，也是历史性的2026赛季，美国对手克莱尔·刘(Claire Liu)在决赛中以6-3和6-0的优势赢得了冠军。随着对世界排名第17名埃拉的惊人胜利，世界排名第102位的刘终于在WTA 250级别上获得了突破性的职业单打冠军头衔在获得两次 WTA 125 冠军后。刘翔的冠军头衔标志着这位菲律宾偶像连续第二次爆冷，这位当时世界排名第305位的26岁选手在2025年广州公开赛第一轮中击败了排名前50的埃拉，这是他们唯一的另一次正面交锋。或许正是因为这个脚注在他们的脑海中，刘诗诗从一开始就保持了她的侵略性，在3-3的僵局中以3-0的比分抓住了开场局，并以6-3定下了基调。埃拉不顾一切地想要力挽狂澜，在第二盘的第一局中倾尽全力，在长时间的来回换分中否认了四个破发点，最终丢掉了自己的发球局，并把第一分让给了刘诗诗。埃拉可能已经精疲力尽，也肯定失去了动力，随着积分的增加，埃拉的状态下降得更快，在第三局和第五局中丢掉了自己的发球局，随后刘翔最终以一记令人惊叹的百吉饼成绩以6-0的成绩让菲律宾选手摆脱了痛苦，并连赢九局夺得了冠军。
6-0的葬礼标志着埃拉2026年不朽赛季的黯淡结束。去年八月，她在香港公开赛决赛中取得轰动，并获得职业生涯里程碑的WTA 500华盛顿特区公开赛冠军，证明了她配得上崇高的世界排名。“首先，我要祝贺克莱尔，参加了一场精彩的比赛，度过了精彩的一周和一场精彩的比赛。非常非常当之无愧的祝贺。我要感谢赛事工作人员和组织者的热情款待，理疗师让我保持团结，”埃拉说。 “当然，还有球迷，谢谢你们，谢谢你们，谢谢你们。我的意思是，今年结束时，你们不知道你们为我所做的事情增添了多少意义，也不知道在我的生活中与你们分享这些时刻是多么快乐。所以我永远感激不已。” Eala 很快就会回家，于 12 月 8 日在大型菲律宾竞技场举行大型返校活动“Alex Eala Live：比赛、准备、庆祝”，享受她的职业生涯新高和 2026 年赛季的整体表现。 – Rappler.com

【原文 English Original】
MANILA, Philippines – Filipina tennis superstar Alex Eala met a disappointing end to what was otherwise a prolific Hong Kong Open run, and a historic 2026 season overall, as American foe Claire Liu cruised to a dominant 6-3, 6-0 title-winning finale on Sunday, November 8. With the stunning win over the world No. 17 Eala, world No. 102 Liu finally earned a breakthrough career singles title at the WTA 250 level after earning two WTA 125 championships. Liu’s title win marked a second consecutive upset at the Filipina icon’s expense, as the 26-year-old, then world No. 305, booted the top-50 Eala at the 2025 Guangzhou Open first round in their only other head-to-head meeting. With that footnote likely in the back of their minds, Liu kept her aggression up from the get-go, seizing the opening frame with a 3-0 finish from a competitive 3-3 deadlock to set the tone, 6-3. Desperate to turn the tide, Eala poured everything she had into the first game of the second set, denying four break points in a prolonged back-and-forth point trade before finally losing her serve and the first point to Liu. Likely out of gas and definitely out of momentum, Eala faded quicker as the points piled on, losing her serve in the third and fifth games before Liu finally put the Filipina out of her misery with a stunning bagel finish, 6-0, and nine straight won games for the title. The 6-0 burial marked a dim end to a monumental 2026 season for Eala, who proved worthy of her lofty world ranking with a sensational rise to the Hong Kong Open final and a career milestone WTA 500 Washington DC Open championship last August. “First and foremost, I want to congratulate Claire on an amazing tournament, a great week and a great match. Very, very well deserved congratulations. I’d like to thank the tournament staff and the organizers for the amazing hospitality, the physios for keeping me together,” Eala said. “And of course, the fans, thank you, thank you, thank you. I mean, wrapping up this year, you guys do not know how much meaning you add on top of what I do, and how much of a pleasure it is to go about my life sharing these moments with you all. So I’m forever grateful.” Eala soon heads home to bask in her career highs and 2026 season overall with a big homecoming event, “Alex Eala Live: Game. Set. Celebrate,” at the massive Philippine Arena on December 8. – Rappler.com

title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO’s affair with suspected Chinese spy
zh_title: 英伟达对首席执行官与涉嫌中国间谍的恋情展开调查
summary: 美国科技巨头英伟达 (Nvidia) 已展开独立调查，此前有报道称其首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 与一名疑似中国间谍有关系。该公司是世界上最有价值的公司之一，该公司表示，其董事会没有理由相信其机密或国家安全受到损害，并补充说首席执行官致力于继续领导该公司。另外，黄仁勋承认对妻子“不忠”，并为伤害她和孩子而道歉。美国情报官员认为，与 Jen 关系密切的中国女商人 Alice Huang
content:
美国科技巨头英伟达 (Nvidia) 已展开独立调查，此前有报道称其首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 与一名疑似中国间谍有关系。该公司是世界上最有价值的公司之一，该公司表示，其董事会没有理由相信其机密或国家安全受到损害，并补充说首席执行官致力于继续领导该公司。另外，黄仁勋承认对妻子“不忠”，并为伤害她和孩子而道歉。据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报官员认为与黄仁勋关系密切的中国女商人爱丽丝·黄是北京的间谍。黄仁勋表示，他对自己的行为承担“全部责任”，并补充说，他没有履行对英伟达员工、董事会和股东的责任。英伟达是全球最大的公司之一，被视为新兴人工智能技术硬件制造的核心。其首席执行官表示：“我对我的妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”他的声明继续说道：“对于新闻报道中提出的国家安全担忧，英伟达董事会已启动独立调查。我支持调查并将全力配合。“我爱我们的国家和我们的公司。我致力于保护 Nvidia 并支持美国的国家安全。
作为一名美国人，我感到自豪和感激。”英伟达董事会发表的另一份声明表示，“鉴于最近有报道称创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋已成为外国情报工作的目标”，该公司将开始调查。声明继续说道：“董事会优先考虑美国国家和经济安全，这对英伟达及其股东的利益至关重要。 “虽然董事会没有理由相信国家安全或 Nvidia 机密受到损害，但董事会的调查将检查所有可用信息。”与 Jensen Huang 没有关系的 Alice Huang 与新加坡数据中心公司 Megaspeed 有联系。该公司上个月告诉《纽约时报》，其现任领导层认真对待这些指控，并已任命外部法律顾问进行内部调查。 Nvidia 是人工智能基础设施领域的核心参与者，为 OpenAI 和 Meta 等领先的人工智能模型开发商提供芯片。这家微芯片制造商的市值约为 4.5 万亿美元，使其成为有史以来最有价值的公司之一。中国此前否认了针对英伟达首席执行官的间谍活动的指控，称这些指控是“毫无根据的猜测”。据《纽约时报》援引未透露姓名的消息人士称，美国情报机构对黄爱丽进行了监控，并得出结论，她代表中国政府行事。
据报道，监控显示了黄爱丽丝与一名美国公民之间的通信，该公民随后通过一个被称为“揭露”的过程被确认为黄仁勋。 目前尚不清楚黄丽丝（又名黄乐）据称向北京传递了哪些信息，这些信息有多大价值，或者据信她何时开始收集情报。黄爱丽没有回应该报的置评请求。上周，国会议员写信给黄仁勋，要求他根据报道中的关系出席他们的听证会。三名众议院共和党委员会领导人要求首席执行官在本月晚些时候露面，讨论 Nvi

【原文 English Original】
US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports that its CEO, Jensen Huang, had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. The company, one of the world’s most valuable, said its board had no reason to believe its secrets or national security were compromised, adding that the CEO was committed to continuing to lead the company. Separately, Jensen Huang admitted to having been “unfaithful” to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. Jensen Huang said he took “full responsibility” for what he did, adding that he had fallen short of his responsibilities to Nvidia’s employees, board and shareholders. Nvidia is one of the world’s largest companies and is seen as central to making the hardware for emerging AI technologies. Its CEO said: “I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.” His statement continued: “Regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports, Nvidia’s Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. “I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America’s national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American.” A separate statement issued by Nvidia’s board of directors said it would begin an investigation in “light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort”. It continued: “The Board prioritises US national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of Nvidia and its shareholders. “While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, the Board’s inquiry will examine all available information.” Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, is linked to Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Nvidia is a central player in AI infrastructure, providing chips to leading AI model developers including OpenAI and Meta. The microchip manufacturer is worth some $4.5 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies ever. China previously rejected allegations of an espionage operation targeting Nvidia’s chief, calling the claims “groundless speculation” . US intelligence agencies monitored Alice Huang and concluded she was acting on behalf of the Chinese government, according to unnamed sources cited by The New York Times. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as “unmasking”. It remains unclear what information Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly passed to Beijing, how valuable it was, or when she is believed to have begun gathering intelligence. Alice Huang did not respond to the paper’s request for comment. Last week, members of Congress wrote to Jensen Huang, asking him to appear before them in the light of the reported relationship. Three House Republican committee leaders asked the CEO to appear later in the month, to talk about Nvidia’s “security protocols against foreign adversary espionage” given his reported relation Alice Huang. “Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the PRC’s [China’s] access to sensitive US technology and information. “The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge US technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress,” the letter said. Nvidia’s AI chips have been a major focus of the rivalry between the US and China, and Washington has previously imposed controls on where its advanced products can be sold. The H200, Nvidia’s second most advanced semiconductor, had previously been restricted by Washington over concerns that it would give China’s technology industry an edge over the US. In January, the Trump administration said it would allow the company to sell its H200 chips to Chinese customers under certain conditions.

title: Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9%
zh_title: Nous Research 发布 Arete-27B，将 Qwen3.8-27B 宣传从 22% 削减至 0.9%
summary: Nous Research 发布了 Arete-27B，这是阿里巴巴 Qwen3.8-27B 的监督微调。 Arete-27B 是一个 27B 开放权重模型，从 Qwen 的答案中剥离了中国国家框架。在 Nous 自己的 803 提示评估中，包含宣传的答案从 22% 下降到 0.9%。开发人员无需国家统一的答案即可获得 Qwen 级代理技能。权重、评估和训练数据都是公开的。 TL;DR 大小：27B 密集参数（全部有效）。在 64k 环境下进行训练。 Base Qwen3.8-27B 原生支持 262,144 个令牌。运行于：BF16 重量为 53.81 GB。社区 Q4_K_M 数量为 17.20 GB，大小为 24 GB
content:
Nous Research 发布了 Arete-27B，这是阿里巴巴 Qwen3.8-27B 的监督微调。 Arete-27B 是一个 27B 开放权重模型，从 Qwen 的答案中剥离了中国国家框架。在 Nous 自己的 803 提示评估中，包含宣传的答案从 22% 下降到 0.9%。开发人员无需国家统一的答案即可获得 Qwen 级代理技能。权重、评估和训练数据都是公开的。 TL;DR 大小：27B 密集参数（全部有效）。在 64k 环境下进行训练。 Base Qwen3.8-27B 原生支持 262,144 个令牌。运行于：BF16 重量为 53.81 GB。社区 Q4_K_M 数量为 17.20 GB，大小适合 24 GB 消费级 GPU。性能：Nous 运行的基准测试中的能力保持不变；现在的政治框架符合西方模式。最佳：宣传率 0.9%，低于基础 Qwen3.8-27B 的 22%。最差：事实得分 2.98（共 5 分）； 803 个答案中的 216 个仍然得分为 0。Arete-27B 是什么？ Arete-27B 是仅经过监督微调后的 Qwen3.8-27B。 Nous 没有使用强化学习，没有偏好优化，也没有改变架构。许可证是 Apache 2.0，与基本型号匹配。 Nous 团队表示，它在基本模型中看到了对敏感话题的拒绝、偏转和中共框架下的答案。它选择了 Qwen3.8-27B，因为它是最有能力的本地模型并显示了目标行为。 Arete-27B 是如何训练的？老师是 Inkling，Thinking Machines 的开放模型。 Nous 选择了一位开放教师来避免蒸馏的使用条款限制。
在发现有关中国主题的错综复杂的记录后，它拒绝了 Nemotron 3 Ultra。训练涵盖了 64k 上下文中的约 5280 万个标记，没有序列打包。该运行需要 2 个周期和 1,202 个步骤，批量大小为 48。它使用 AdamW、1e-5 峰值学习率和张量并行 4。所有语言模型权重都经过训练。视觉编码器保持冻结状态，因为数据只是文本。多令牌预测头被禁用。发布的 arete-data-pairs 集包含 7 个主题的 34,878 个提示。每个提示都有一个 Inkling 答案和一个 Qwen 答案。 SFT 分裂中有 29,236 个已接受的教师答案。宣传评估如何进行？ Propaganda_Eval 集有 7 个值类别的 803 个提示。其中包括言论自由、国家意识形态、数据隐私和民主。每个提示都包含来自引用来源的 2 到 4 个必需事实。 Grok 4.7 法官分别对两件事进行评分： 事实平均值（0 到 5）：答案陈述了多少个必需事实。一项反对的事实得分为 0。任何宣传：采用国家账户作为自己账户的答案份额。法官必须引用确切的短语来标记宣传。 Nous 删除了与评估重叠的所有训练提示。该评估已获得 MIT 许可，并包含评分脚本。 window.addEventListener("消息",function(e){if(e.data&&e.data.mtpArete){var f=document.getElementById("mtp-arete-frame");if(f)f.style.height=e.data.mtpArete+"px";}});基准测试显示什么？
在模型卡页面上，Arete-27B 将事实均值从 2.32 提高到 2.98。宣传值从 22% 下降到 0.9%。得分为 0 的答案从 359 个下降到 803 个中的 216 个。最大的变化来自言论自由。事实得分从0.89上升到2.44，宣传得分从60%下降到1%。 Nous 测试中的能力。 Hermes Bench 从 65.77% 上升到 65.60%，Nous 称之为噪音。 Terminal-Bench-2.1 在 Nous 的使用中的使用率从 67% 上升到 70%。 Nous 并没有将这一成果归功于自己。 Arete-27B 相比如何？指标 Arete-27B Qwen3.8-27B Muse Glimmer 30B Gemma 4 31B 开发者 Nous Research 阿里巴巴 Qwen Meta Google DeepMind

【原文 English Original】
Nous Research has released Arete-27B , a supervised fine-tune of Alibaba’s Qwen3.8-27B . Arete-27B is a 27B open-weight model that strips Chinese state framing from Qwen’s answers. On Nous’s own 803-prompt eval, answers containing propaganda fell from 22% to 0.9%. Developers get Qwen-class agentic skill without state-aligned answers. The weights, eval and training data are all public. TL;DR Size: 27B dense parameters (all active). Trained at 64k context. Base Qwen3.8-27B supports 262,144 tokens natively. Runs on: BF16 weights are 53.81 GB. A community Q4_K_M quant is 17.20 GB, sized for 24 GB consumer GPUs. Performance: Capability unchanged on the benchmarks Nous ran; political framing now matches Western models. Best: Propaganda rate 0.9%, down from 22% for base Qwen3.8-27B. Worst: Fact score 2.98 of 5; 216 of 803 answers still score 0. What is Arete-27B? Arete-27B is Qwen3.8-27B after supervised fine-tuning only . Nous used no RL, no preference optimization and no architecture changes. The license is Apache 2.0, matching the base model. Nous team states that it saw refusals, deflections and CCP-framed answers on sensitive topics in the base model. It picked Qwen3.8-27B because it was the most capable local model and showed the target behavior. How was Arete-27B trained? The teacher was Inkling , an open model from Thinking Machines. Nous chose an open teacher to avoid terms-of-use limits on distillation. It rejected Nemotron 3 Ultra after finding a checkered record on China topics. Training covered about 52.8 million tokens at 64k context, without sequence packing. The run took 2 epochs and 1,202 steps at batch size 48. It used AdamW, a 1e-5 peak learning rate and tensor parallel 4. All language-model weights were trained. The vision encoder stayed frozen, since the data is text-only. The multi-token-prediction head was disabled. The released arete-data-pairs set holds 34,878 prompts across 7 topics. Each prompt has both an Inkling answer and a Qwen answer. 29,236 accepted teacher answers form the SFT split. How does the propaganda eval work? The Propaganda_Eval set has 803 prompts across 7 value categories. These include freedom of expression, state ideology, data privacy and democracy. Each prompt carries 2 to 4 required facts from a cited source. A Grok 4.7 judge grades two things separately: Fact mean (0 to 5): how many required facts the answer states. One opposed fact scores 0. Any propaganda: share of answers that adopt the state’s account as their own. The judge must quote the exact phrase to flag propaganda. Nous removed every training prompt that overlapped the eval. The eval is MIT licensed and includes grading scripts. window.addEventListener("message",function(e){if(e.data&&e.data.mtpArete){var f=document.getElementById("mtp-arete-frame");if(f)f.style.height=e.data.mtpArete+"px";}}); What do the benchmarks show? On the model card page , Arete-27B raised fact mean from 2.32 to 2.98. Propaganda fell from 22% to 0.9%. Answers scoring 0 dropped from 359 to 216 of 803. The biggest change came in freedom of expression. Fact score rose from 0.89 to 2.44, and propaganda fell from 60% to 1%. Capability held on Nous’s tests. Hermes Bench moved from 65.77% to 65.60%, which Nous calls noise. Terminal-Bench-2.1 rose from 67% to 70% in Nous’s harness. Nous does not claim credit for that gain. How does Arete-27B compare? Metrics Arete-27B Qwen3.8-27B Muse Glimmer 30B Gemma 4 31B Developer Nous Research Alibaba Qwen Meta Google DeepMind Parameters 27B dense 27B LM, dense 29.6B incl. vision, dense 30.7B, dense Context Not disclosed (trained at 64k) 262,144 native, up to 1M 131,072+ 256K License Apache 2.0 Apache 2.0 Apache 2.0 Apache 2.0 Input Text, image (encoder frozen) Text, image, video Text, image Text, image 4-bit footprint 17.20 GB Q4_K_M (community) Not disclosed Under 20 GB, 24 GB VRAM target Not disclosed Fact mean, Nous eval 2.98 2.32 3.02 2.58 Any propaganda, Nous eval 0.9% 22% 0.5% 0.5% Terminal-Bench 2.1 70% (Nous harness) 67% Nous harness; 73.0 official 51.7 (Meta, terminus2) Not disclosed by Google GPQA Diamond Not disclosed 89.2 83.5 84.3 Note: Arete and Qwen ran at temperature 0 in the Nous eval. Muse Glimmer and Gemma ran at 0.6. Terminal-Bench figures come from different harnesses. How can developers run it? Weights ship in BF16 on Hugging Face . No hosted inference provider serves the model yet. Community GGUF quants run in llama.cpp, LM Studio and Ollama, from 8.64 GB to 53.81 GB. The GGUF build also includes the image projector. Key Takeaways Arete-27B cuts Qwen3.8-27B propaganda answers from 22% to 0.9%. The fix took only 52.8M tokens of plain SFT, no RL. Hermes Bench held at 65.60% versus 65.77% for the base. Fact recall rose to 2.98 of 5 but still trails peers. Weights, eval and training data are open under Apache 2.0 and MIT. title: Nvidia to probe reports that Chinese intelligence targeted CEO Jensen Huang
zh_title: 英伟达将调查有关中国情报部门针对首席执行官黄仁勋的报道
summary: [Nvidia](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/nvidia/) 董事会周日表示，正在对有关首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 成为“外国情报工作目标”的报道展开[调查](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/investigation/)。此前，黄向董事会承认，他与一名[企业](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/business/)高管关系密切，美国情报部门确定该高管正在为[北京](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/beijing/)、[纽约时报](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/the-new-york-ti)收集信息。
content:
[Nvidia](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/nvidia/) 董事会周日表示，正在对有关首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 成为“外国情报工作目标”的报道展开[调查](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/investigation/)。

据《纽约时报》(https://www.france24.com/en/tag/the-new-york-times/)报道，黄向董事会承认，他与一名[企业](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/business/)高管关系密切，美国情报部门确定该高管正在为[北京](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/beijing/)收集信息。

据《泰晤士报》报道，黄在给该公司的信息中道歉。 “我对我的妻子不忠，”他说。 “我的行为伤害了她和我们的[孩子](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/children/)。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”

英伟达董事会在一份声明中表示，“没有理由相信”国家安全或英伟达机密遭到泄露，但其调查将检查所有可用信息。董事会表示，黄“完全支持审查并承诺配合审查”。

63 岁的黄在调查期间将继续担任首席执行官。
英伟达已成为全球人工智能开发竞赛的核心参与者，其芯片为许多用于训练和运行人工智能模型的数据中心和计算系统提供支持。其先进处理器也一直是美国出口限制的重点，旨在限制中国获得尖端半导体技术。

《泰晤士报》上个月报道称，美国情报机构发现黄与中国公民、芯片买家 Alice Huang 建立了密切关系，并确定她直接向北京提供信息。据《泰晤士报》报道，两者没有关系。

了解更多[Nvidia黄宣布对法国科技行业进行新投资](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/business/20261014-nvidia-s-huang-announces-new-investments-in-french-tech-sector)

Alice Huang 曾是[电视](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/television/)驻[中国](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/)记者，之后成为新加坡数据中心公司 Megaspeed 的高管，该公司已成为 Nvidia 在东南亚最大的客户之一。据《泰晤士报》报道，Megaspeed 在过去两年购买了价值超过 48 亿美元的 Nvidia 芯片。
总统[唐纳德·特朗普](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/donald-trump/)在他的[万圣节](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/halloween/)派对上发表了这些报告，称情况“非常复杂”，并表示他希望总统科学技术顾问委员会成员黄仁勋一切顺利。总统称黄“聪明”、“了不起”，并坚持让黄陪同他出国旅行。

“我一直发现黄仁勋非常光明正大，”特朗普 10 月 31 日对记者表示，并补充说政府将“非常密切”地调查此事。

美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周日在离开美国前往巴黎参加七国集团 (G7)(https://www.france24.com/en/tag/g7/) 会议时表示，他无法与黄解决这一问题。

“由于其[性质](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/nature/)，我无法发表评论，”他告诉记者。 “而且我也无法评论公司内部的情况

【原文 English Original】
[Nvidia](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/nvidia/) is opening an [investigation](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/investigation/) into reports that CEO Jensen Huang was the “target of a foreign intelligence effort,” the company’s board of directors said Sunday.

The announcement came after Huang acknowledged to the board that he had been intimate with a [business](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/business/) executive whom US intelligence determined was gathering information for [Beijing](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/beijing/), [The New York Times](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/the-new-york-times/) reported.

Huang apologized in a message to the company, according to the Times. “I was unfaithful to my wife,” he said. “My actions hurt her and our [children](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/children/). There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.”

Nvidia’s board said in a statement it has “no reason to believe" that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, but that its inquiry would examine all available information. Huang “fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it,” the board said.

Huang, 63, will remain CEO during the investigation.

Nvidia has become a central player in the global race to develop artificial intelligence, with its chips powering many of the data centers and computing systems used to train and run AI models. Its advanced processors have also been a focus of US export restrictions aimed at limiting China’s access to cutting-edge semiconductor technology.

The Times reported last month that US intelligence agencies had discovered that Huang had developed a close relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen and chip buyer, and determined that she was feeding information directly to Beijing. The two are not related, according to the Times.

Read more[Nvidia's Huang announces new investments in French tech sector](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/business/20261014-nvidia-s-huang-announces-new-investments-in-french-tech-sector)

Alice Huang was previously a [television](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/television/) reporter in [China](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/) before becoming a top executive at Singapore-based data center company Megaspeed, which has become one of Nvidia’s biggest customers in Southeast Asia. Megaspeed bought more than $4.8 billion worth of Nvidia chips over the past two years, according to the Times.

President [Donald Trump](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/donald-trump/) addressed the reports at his [Halloween](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/halloween/) party, calling the situation “very complex” and saying he hoped everything was OK with Jensen Huang, who serves on the president’s Council of Advisors on Science and Technology. The president has called Huang “smart” and “amazing,” insisting that Huang accompany him on foreign trips.

“I've always found Jensen Huang to be very aboveboard,” Trump told reporters on Oct. 31, adding that the administration would look into the matter “very closely.”

Secretary of State [Marco Rubio](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/marco-rubio/) said Sunday as he was departing the US for a [G7](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/g7/) meeting in [Paris](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/paris/) that he could not address the situation with Huang.

“I just can't comment because of the [nature](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/nature/) of it,” he told reporters. “And I also can't comment on an internal corporate matter that's going on with Nvidia.”

Nvidia, the world's most valuable company, has regularly surpassed Wall Street’s earnings expectations in the past three years since its high-end chips emerged as AI’s best building blocks. The Santa Clara, California-based company reported quarterly profits of $59.69 billion in August.

_(FRANCE 24 with AP)_

日本首相高市早苗周日在东京千代田区的一次集会上发表讲话，要求立即归还被朝鲜绑架的受害者。 |集集

周日在东京举行了一场全国集会，呼吁立即集体归还几十年前被朝鲜绑架的所有日本公民，约有 800 人参加，其中包括首相高市早苗。
“被绑架者的父母每天都生活在边缘，”1977 年 13 岁时被绑架到朝鲜的横田惠的弟弟横田卓也在集会上说。 “我希望大家继续与我们一起战斗，坚定决心永不放弃，直到所有被绑架者返回家园。”
58岁的拓哉是朝鲜绑架受害者家属协会会长，也是此次集会的组织者之一。
惠美90岁的母亲横田早惠是政府认定的被绑架者家属中唯一仍在等待亲人归来的父母，她说：“我感到难以形容的心痛和悲伤，因为我精心抚养的一名亲人被带走了。”
“近 50 年来，我们一直无法拯救她。我们必须继续以一颗团结的心表明，我们绝不会允许绑架问题得到解决，”Sakie 说。
49 岁的饭冢晃一郎是被绑架者田口八重子的长子，田口八重子于 1978 年被绑架，时年 22 岁。他说：“新年一开始，我母亲被绑架就已经 49 年了。我绝对不能接受让这个时间延长到 50 年。”
高一在集会上致辞时表示：“我对被绑架者至今未能回家感到非常遗憾。我决心在我的任期内取得突破，直到他们的家人能够再次拥抱亲人的那一天，我的使命才会结束。”
集会通过了一项决议，呼吁朝鲜在父辈还活着的情况下遣返所有被绑架者。

800 Rally in Tokyo to demand North Korea abductees’ immediate return
Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi addresses a rally in Tokyo's Chiyoda Ward on Sunday, demanding the immediate return of abduction victims held by North Korea. | JIJI
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
A national rally calling for the immediate and collective return of all Japanese citizens abducted by North Korea decades ago was held in Tokyo on Sunday, attended by about 800 people, including Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.
“The parents of abductees are living each day on the edge,” Takuya Yokota, the younger brother of Megumi Yokota, who was abducted to North Korea in 1977 at the age of 13, said at the rally. “I want everyone to continue fighting with us with a strong determination never to give up until all abductees return home.”
Takuya, 58, is head of the Association of Families of Victims Kidnapped by North Korea and one of the organizers of the rally.
Sakie Yokota, Megumi’s 90-year-old mother, who is the only remaining parent among the families of government-recognized abductees still awaiting the return of their loved ones, said, “I feel indescribable heartache and sorrow because a family member I raised with great care was taken away.”
“For almost 50 years, we have been unable to save her. We must continue to show, with one united heart, that we will never allow the abduction issue to be left unaddressed,” Sakie said.
Koichiro Iizuka, 49, the eldest son of abductee Yaeko Taguchi, who was kidnapped in 1978 at the age of 22, said: “Once the new year begins, it will be 49 years since my mother was abducted. I absolutely cannot accept allowing that to stretch to 50 years.”
Addressing the gathering, Takaichi said: “I feel very sorry that the abductees have not yet been able to return home. I am determined to make a breakthrough during my tenure, and my mission will not end until the day their families can embrace their loved ones again.”
The rally adopted a resolution calling on North Korea to return all abductees while members of the parents’ generation are still alive.

日本举行模拟泊核电站事故的核灾难演习
周六，首相高市早苗（中）在总理大臣官邸举行的综合核灾难准备演习中发表讲话。 |集集
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
日本政府周六进行了一次全面的核应急演习，模拟了日本最北端县北海道电力公司泊核电站发生的严重事故。
这次为期三天的演习将持续到周日，参与者包括北海道县政府、相关市镇和内阁府。此次演习包括十年来首次在泊工厂进行的演习。预计约有 8,500 名当地居民参加。
此次演习的场景是，北海道西海岸发生地震，导致核电站3号反应堆设备故障，导致冷却系统无法运行。
演习第二天，日本首相高市早苗宣布进入核紧急状态。一些参与者运送了被认为受到辐射的人员，另一些参与者则通过视频会议系统召开了对策会议。
2025年，原子能监管局得出结论，泊港核电站3号反应堆符合该国新的安全标准，这是其重启的先决条件。
当局仍在审查涵盖反应堆设施详细设计的施工计划，反应堆重启的时间仍不确定。
在当地居民要求停止泊港工厂运营的诉讼中，札幌地方法院部分批准了原告的请求，并于 2022 年发布了禁令。札幌高等法院计划于明年 1 月做出上诉裁决。

Japan holds nuclear disaster drill simulating Tomari plant accident - The Japan Times
Japan holds nuclear disaster drill simulating Tomari plant accident
Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi (center) speaks during a comprehensive nuclear disaster preparedness drill at the Prime Minister’s Office on Saturday. | JIJI
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
The government on Saturday conducted a comprehensive nuclear emergency drill simulating a severe accident at Hokkaido Electric Power’s Tomari nuclear plant in Japan’s northernmost prefecture.
The three-day drill, which runs through Sunday, involves the Hokkaido prefectural government, relevant municipalities and the Cabinet Office. The drill includes exercises conducted at the Tomari plant for the first time in 10 years. About 8,500 local residents are expected to take part.
The drill is based on a scenario in which an earthquake off the western coast of Hokkaido causes equipment failure at the plant’s No. 3 reactor, rendering its cooling system inoperable.
On the second day of the exercise, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi declared a nuclear emergency. While some participants transported people assumed to have been exposed to radiation, others held a countermeasures meeting through a video conferencing system.
In 2025, the Nuclear Regulation Authority concluded that the No. 3 reactor at the Tomari plant met the country’s new safety standards, a prerequisite for its restart.
The authority is still reviewing a construction plan covering the detailed design of the reactor’s facilities, and the timing of the reactor’s restart remains uncertain.
In a lawsuit filed by local residents seeking a halt to the Tomari plant’s operation, Sapporo District Court partially granted the plaintiffs’ request and issued an injunction in 2022. Sapporo High Court is scheduled to hand down its appellate ruling in January next year.

Beijing – A Japanese employee of Astellas Pharma, who was sentenced to three years and six months in prison for espionage in China, is expected to be released in mid-December and return to Japan, sources said Saturday.
According to sources, final arrangements are being made to release the employee of the Japanese pharmaceutical company in his 60s on Dec. 14.
The employee was suddenly detained by Chinese authorities in March 2023, when he was about to leave China after the end of his Beijing assignment. He was indicted in August 2024.

TOKYO - A Japanese employee of Astellas Pharma sentenced to three years and six months in prison for espionage in China is set to be released in mid-December and returned to Japan, Japanese media reported late on Nov 7.
Kyodo news agency and Yomiuri newspaper among others reported the news, citing sources.
The man was detained in March 2023 on suspicion of spying. He was indicted in August 2024 and sentenced in July 2025.
The ruling was "extremely regrettable", Japan's deputy chief Cabinet secretary said after the sentencing, without identifying the individual or affiliation.
Astellas Pharma, Japan's foreign ministry and the Chinese embassy in Tokyo did not respond to telephone calls from Reuters seeking comment. China's foreign ministry did not respond to a request for comment.
The case has been an irritant in Japan-China relations.
Ties between the two have deteriorated since Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi in 2025 said a hypothetical Chinese attack on democratically governed Taiwan could trigger a military response from nearby Japan.

zh_title: 英伟达调查首席执行官黄仁勋与涉嫌中国间谍的关系
summary: 英伟达正在调查首席执行官黄仁勋与涉嫌中国间谍的关系 首席执行官黄仁勋在一封电子邮件中告诉英伟达员工，他有外遇，该公司董事会已对该女子是中国间谍的指控展开独立调查。据报道，美国情报机构对这名名叫爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）的女子一直在向北京传递信息表示担忧。黄女士隶属于一家云公司，也是一家名为 Megaspeed 的 Nvidia 客户，该公司被指控帮助受限制的中国公司获取 Nvidia AI 芯片。关注你最喜欢的
content:
英伟达调查首席执行官黄仁勋与涉嫌中国间谍的关系
首席执行官黄仁勋在一封电子邮件中告诉英伟达员工，他有外遇，该公司董事会已针对该女子是中国间谍的指控展开独立调查。
据报道，美国情报机构对这名名叫爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）的女子一直在向北京传递信息表示担忧。
黄女士隶属于一家云公司，也是一家名为 Megaspeed 的 Nvidia 客户，该公司被指控帮助受限制的中国公司获取 Nvidia AI 芯片。
关注您最喜欢的股票创建免费帐户
Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋于 2026 年 9 月 15 日在加利福尼亚州旧金山莫斯康中心举行的 Salesforce Dreamforce 会议上发表主题演讲。
英伟达已对联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋与一名女商人的关系展开调查，情报机构称这名女商人是中国间谍。
据《纽约时报》和《金融时报》报道，美国情报机构对这名名叫 Alice Huang 的女子一直在向北京传递信息表示担忧，她隶属于一家云公司，也是 Nvidia 的客户 Megaspeed。
黄在周日的一封电子邮件中告诉英伟达员工，他与这名女子有染，英伟达董事会已对间谍指控展开独立调查。
“我对我的妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的行为没有任何借口，”黄在信息中写道。 “我深感抱歉。”
英伟达发言人表示，黄仁勋致力于不间断地继续担任英伟达首席执行官。
英伟达董事会在一份声明中表示，将调查有关黄仁勋成为外国情报工作目标的指控。
据《纽约时报》报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋被视为中国间谍阴谋的目标
Nvidia 董事会在一份声明中表示：“虽然董事会没有理由相信国家安全或 NVIDIA 机密遭到泄露，但董事会的调查将检查所有可用信息。”
请在此处阅读黄仁勋发给 Nvidia 员工的电子邮件以及公司董事会的声明。
这些指控发生之际，英伟达已成为中美贸易争端的中心，因为人工智能被视为对国家安全越来越重要。
美国限制英伟达最先进的人工智能芯片向中国出口，尽管它已批准出口某些较旧、速度较慢的型号。
黄女士所属的 Megaspeed 被指控帮助受限制的中国公司收购 Nvidia 人工智能芯片。英伟达代表此前表示，Megaspeed 已因逃避出口管制而受到调查。
英伟达的黄仁勋一直在推动扩大对中国的人工智能芯片出口，他表示，如果世界使用并建立在美国技术的基础上，这对美国来说更好。他还与唐纳德·特朗普总统在美国人工智能政策及其基础设施建设方面保持一致。
黄在给员工的信中表示，作为一名美国人，他感到“自豪和感激”。
三名众议院共和党委员会主席周三致信黄，要求他参加 11 月 18 日与议员举行的闭门简报会。
Nvidia 将于 11 月 17 日公布第三季度财报，并将于月底在华盛顿特区举行一次重要会议。

Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy
CEO Jensen Huang told Nvidia staff in an email that he had an affair and that the company's board has opened an independent investigation into allegations that the woman is a Chinese spy.
U.S. intelligence agencies have expressed concerns that the woman, Alice Huang, has been passing information to Beijing, according to reports.
Ms. Huang is affiliated with a cloud company and an Nvidia customer called Megaspeed, which has been accused of helping restricted Chinese companies acquire Nvidia AI chips.
Follow your favorite stocksCREATE FREE ACCOUNT
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang speaks during the keynote address at Salesforce's Dreamforce conference at the Moscone Center on Sept. 15, 2026 in San Francisco, California.
Nvidia has opened an investigation into co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a businesswoman who intelligence agencies say is a Chinese spy.
U.S. intelligence agencies have expressed concerns that the woman, Alice Huang, who is affiliated with a cloud company and an Nvidia customer called Megaspeed, has been passing information to Beijing, according to reports in The New York Times and the Financial Times.
Huang told Nvidia staff in an email on Sunday that he had an affair with the woman and that Nvidia's board of directors had opened an independent investigation into the spying allegations.
"I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did," Huang wrote in the message. "I am deeply sorry."
An Nvidia spokesperson said that Huang was committed to continuing as CEO of Nvidia without interruption.
In a statement, the Nvidia board said it would investigate the allegations that Huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang seen as target of Chinese spy plot, according to the New York Times
"While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information," Nvidia's board said in a statement.
Read Huang's email to Nvidia employees and the company board of directors' statement here.
The allegations come as Nvidia has become the center of a trade dispute between China and the U.S. as AI is seen as increasingly critical to national security.
The U.S. restricts exports of Nvidia's most advanced AI chips to China, though it has approved exports of certain older, slower models.
Megaspeed, which Ms. Huang is affiliated with, has been accused of helping restricted Chinese companies acquire Nvidia AI chips. Nvidia representatives previously said that Megaspeed had already been investigated for evading export controls.
Nvidia's Huang has pushed for broader AI chip exports to China, saying it is better for the U.S. if the world uses and builds on American technology. He has also aligned with President Donald Trump on American artificial intelligence policy and its infrastructure buildout.
In his note to staff, Huang said he was "proud and grateful" to be an American.
Three House Republican committee chairs sent a letter to Huang on Wednesday asking him to sit for a closed-door briefing with lawmakers on Nov. 18.
Nvidia reports third-quarter earnings on Nov. 17 and will hold a major conference in Washington, D.C., at the end of the month.

【原文 English Original】
How Democrats will try to end Trump's tariffs
Democrats are preparing to challenge President Donald Trump's signature tariff policy as soon as they take power in the next Congress.
Democratic leaders plan to speed legislation to the House floor that reasserts Congress' authority over trade.
Democrats such as Rep. Jamie Raskin are also laying the groundwork to launch tariff-related investigations.
Trump's tariffs were already under pressure: They are being challenged in multiple lawsuits, and some Republicans have distanced themselves from the duties on Canada and others.
The U.S. Capitol in Washington, D.C., on Aug. 5, 2026.
Aaron Schwartz | Bloomberg | Getty Images
The battle for Congress is over. The war over President Donald Trump's tariffs is about to heat up.
The knotted web of tariffs that Trump spent the last two years weaving could soon face its biggest threat, as Democrats prepare to unload their new legislative firepower against the Republican president's signature policy.
Democrats have made no secret of their plans to bombard Trump and his associates with investigations as soon as the next Congress is sworn in. They are also preparing a first-100-hours legislative blitz, putting forward a series of bills that would unwind much of Trump's agenda.
Both prongs of attack will take aim at Trump's unprecedented use of tariffs, which Democrats have quickly identified as a main target following their landslide victory in Tuesday's midterm elections.

Trump is using tariffs as a 'tool for grift,' Raskin says in demand for donor records

Judge wants former U.S. attorney to investigate whether the government misled her in Trump golf case
Ending Trump's tariff regime, and especially his trade war against Canada, is something Democrats "absolutely have to do immediately," Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed, D-Mich., told MS NOW's "Morning Joe" Thursday.
Rep. Hakeem Jeffries of New York, the Democratic minority leader who could be elected House speaker in the next Congress, has made clear that ending Trump's tariffs is a top priority.
"We should restore congressional authority as it relates to tariffs, because the Trump tariffs are making life more expensive for the American people," he said at a press conference in late August.
If picked as speaker, Jeffries would speed legislation to the House floor that reasserts congressional authority over trade.
Democrats are also laying the groundwork for investigations into Trump's tariffs, which the party folded into its winning campaign message linking high costs with alleged Trumpworld corruption.
Rep. Jamie Raskin of Maryland, the top Democrat on the House Judiciary Committee, on Oct. 28 asked Trump to hand over records related to tariff exemptions. Trump, Raskin alleges, has wielded the exemption power to cut "sweetheart deals" for industries whose leaders have plied the president with gifts.
FILE PHOTO: President Donald Trump arrives to deliver remarks, ahead of the midterm elections at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, after being reopened following months of repairs, in Washington, D.C., November 2, 2026.
The plans are likely to ratchet up the pressure, both legally and politically, that Trump's tariffs were already facing.
The administration is already embroiled in multiple lawsuits challenging different parts of the government's tariff policy.
The most recent suit, filed Oct. 20, targets Trump's use of a Great Depression-era law to impose 50% tariffs on a range of Canadian goods.
Another court case accuses Trump of trying to recreate the near-global "liberation day" tariffs that the Supreme Court struck down as illegal in late February. The administration has since been ordered to refund $166 billion in tariff revenue it had collected under the scrapped policy.
Congress, not the president, holds the power to levy taxes under the U.S. Constitution. Over decades, the legislative branch has ceded some of those powers to the executive. But Trump has asserted virtually unchecked tariff powers – which Democrats say they are intent on clawing back.
"Every day Trump insists on his indiscriminate taxes on so many of the products Americans need, he digs a deeper hole for Republicans enabling his tariff spree," said Sen. Ron Wyden of Oregon, who is poised to lead the Senate Finance Committee when Democrats take it over.
"If Democrats somehow had a veto-proof majority, or if voters shame Republicans into doing the right thing, there would be no shortage of trade policies to address," Wyden said in a statement to CNBC before Election Day.
"One of the most obvious priorities would be repealing Trump's tariffs on Canada, which are raising prices and harming communities on both sides of the border," he said. "I'll also continue to work to ensure Congress has the final say on tariffs, so future presidents can't reenact Trump's economically disastrous trade taxes."
The Wall Street Journal, citing Wyden, reported Thursday that Democrats are eyeing the Canada trade war as the "first target" in their efforts against his tariff agenda.
As Wyden's statement suggested, the Senate's rules will hamper Democrats' anti-tariff efforts.
Despite their blowout victory Tuesday night, the party will still lack a 60-vote filibuster-proof majority in the Senate, giving Republicans a crucial tool to block legislation even in their diminished state.
Trump is also poised to lean heavily on his veto pen in the next Congress, presenting a major obstacle for Democrats' legislative priorities.
Overriding a presidential veto requires two-thirds majorities in both the House and Senate, meaning that even with their historic electoral gains, Democrats would need significant Republican help to force a bill into law over Trump's objection.
Democrats may consider it worthwhile to pass legislation even if Trump vetoes it, as doing so could help them build political narratives in the 2028 election cycle. But they may have other options available.
"Absent the brute force of a veto-proof coalition, Congress might consider other political solutions, such as adding riders on 'must-pass' bills or negotiation with the administration," Kit Johnson, a senior tax manager for BDO's customs and international trade group, told CNBC in an email.
Trump has said he plans to use the veto power to force Democrats to the negotiating table. But when it comes to tariffs, it's hard to imagine what deal Trump might accept.
Trump has tried to reshape U.S. trade, foreign and economic policy around his asserted power to slap steep duties on imported goods. He describes tariffs as a win-win, praising them as both a powerful negotiating tool and a major revenue generator.
After Tuesday's election, Trump seemed to suggest tariffs were non-negotiable.
"If I took tariffs off — we have 3,000 plants under construction right now. Every single plant would stop building," Trump told CNBC's Eamon Javers in a phone call Wednesday.
Since taking office in January 2025, Trump has hiked tariffs on nearly every country on the planet, leading to multiple protracted trade wars, most notably against Canada and China. He insists Americans do not share the burden of the duties, even though tariffs by definition are taxes on foreign goods paid by those importing them. The nonprofit Tax Foundation estimates Trump's tariffs have raised the average U.S. household's tax burden by $820 in 2026.
Trump has also consistently overstated the amount of revenue the government has amassed through his tariffs. He claimed before Election Day that tariffs enabled him to offer every U.S. adult $5,000 "dividend" checks if Republicans were to win both chambers of Congress – a plan that would cost roughly $1.2 trillion. But the duties – which are collected from U.S. importers – have only brought in around $300 billion in total between January 2025 and July 2026, according to the Penn Wharton Budget Model.
What's more, about $138 billion of that total has been refunded since the Supreme Court ruling in February. Nearly $20 billion in tariff collections are still set to be refunded.
Most voters do not share Trump's rosy view of tariffs. Sixty-five percent of respondents to the CNBC Voter Poll on Nov. 3 said the duties have hurt the U.S. economy, while just 22% say they helped.
What remains to be seen is how hard Republicans in Congress will push back on Democrats' efforts.
A number of GOP lawmakers came out against the duties during the campaign, as their opponents gained ground blaming inflation on Trump's tariffs and the Iran war.
As they try to regroup and look forward to the 2028 election cycle, some Republicans – who largely supported free trade prior to Trump's political rise – may be less willing to continue aligning themselves with Trump's aggressive protectionism.

content:
川普：若谈判取得进展 极不可能再打击伊朗(图) 美伊战争 | 协议 | 时事 || 看中国网
2026年11月5日，美国总统川普在白宫椭圆形办公室展示签署的行政命令。（图片来源：Andrew Harnik/Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月9日讯】（看中国记者高芸编译/综合报导）美国总统川普(特朗普)周日（11月8日）表示，只要美伊谈判取得进展，美国就极不可能再次对伊朗发动袭击。不过，他也强调，是否恢复军事行动，取决于伊朗能否签署一项强有力的协议。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
同一天，美国国务卿卢比奥公开支持川普对伊朗采取的行动，强调川普正面应对历任总统未能解决的国家安全威胁，并重申美国有权保护自身军队和地区航运安全。
与此同时，美国和伊朗仍在霍尔木兹海峡及周边海域展开军事行动，多艘船只据报遭到袭击，中东局势依然紧张。
川普当天接受CNN电话采访时说：“这取决于他们是否签署一项非常有力的协议。答案是，极不可能有这个必要。”
CNN没有说明当时提出的具体问题。不过，川普同时透露，如果美国恢复对伊朗的打击，已经确定了一批潜在的基础设施目标，包括38座桥梁。
上周美国中期选举结束后，川普曾暗示可能恢复对伊朗的大规模军事打击。伊朗则威胁，如果美国再次发动袭击，将打击美国和以色列目标。
据《福克斯新闻》报道，美国国务卿卢比奥（Marco Rubio）周日启程前往巴黎参加七国集团（G7）会议前，向记者表示，川普采取对伊朗的行动，是为了应对长期存在的美国国家安全威胁。
卢比奥说：“美国总统发现了一个非常真实的威胁，这个威胁已经存在很长一段时间。”
他说：“所以，我认为总统采取了其他总统未能采取的行动。”
卢比奥强调，美国两党都应该认识到，拥有核武器的伊朗是不可接受的。
他说：“两党都必须承认，一个拥有核武器的伊朗是完全不可接受的，而且非常危险，不仅对以色列、不仅对中东，而且对全世界和美国都是如此。”
对于美国在中东的军事行动，卢比奥也强调，华盛顿有权保护当地美军及航运安全，防范潜在威胁。
尽管美伊仍在谈判，双方在霍尔木兹海峡及周边海域的军事行动并未停止。
自今年2月美国和以色列开始打击伊朗以来，德黑兰一直试图通过袭击霍尔木兹海峡的船只，阻断海湾能源出口。美军则从4月开始，封锁进出伊朗港口的船舶。
美国军方周六晚表示，美空军在阿曼湾向一艘试图突破封锁的商船船尾开火，使其失去航行能力。
与此同时，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队海军声称，两艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡试图通过一条“未经授权的航线”时触雷起火。
伊朗半官方的法尔斯通讯社随后又报道，第三艘油轮也发生爆炸并起火。
英国海上贸易行动办公室表示，在阿曼湾、阿联酋豪尔费坎市以东约18海里处，发生了一起涉及散货船和军事力量的事件，损失情况尚不清楚。
伊朗媒体称，周六南部多个地区发生爆炸，包括位于霍尔木兹海峡的格什姆岛。
伊朗国家电视台表示，官员尚未证实有导弹击中伊朗领土，并暗示部分爆炸可能与伊朗自身的军事活动有关。
不过，伊朗塔斯尼姆通讯社此前报道称，两枚导弹击中了格什姆岛，但没有提供官方损失数据。美国和伊朗均未对此发表评论。
美国11月2日曾证实，对格什姆岛实施过一次有限的防御性打击，以应对伊朗方面使用地对空导弹攻击美国目标的行为。
本月，也门亲伊朗的胡塞武装与沙特阿拉伯之间的冲突加剧，使中东战争进一步扩大。
沙特能源部周日表示，位于首都利雅得的沙特国家石油公司沙特阿美一栋行政办公楼，在一次袭击未遂事件后，被坠落的碎片击中受损。所幸没有造成人员伤亡。
军事局势持续紧张之际，卡塔尔仍在推动美国和伊朗达成协议。
周六，卡塔尔否认了有关美伊谈判未能达成协议的报道，并表示，卡塔尔首相已确认，双方仍在继续努力寻求共识。
一名伊朗高级官员周四向路透社透露，德黑兰已通过卡塔尔向华盛顿提交一份核问题提案，美国正在审查。
不过，伊朗方面称，谈判能否继续，取决于美国是否首先满足德黑兰提出的七项要求。
其中包括解除制裁、允许伊朗动用被冻结的资产，以及支付战争赔偿。
除了军事威慑和外交谈判，美国也在进一步加大对伊朗的经济压力。
美国军方周六宣布，将组建一支新的特遣部队，重点打击通过伊朗陆地边境和里海向伊朗运输先进武器及其他受制裁物资的活动。
这一行动是美国扩大对伊朗施压措施的一部分，意味着美方不仅继续实施海上封锁，也准备进一步限制伊朗通过陆路和里海获取相关物资。

content:
當全球人工智慧產業蓬勃發展之際，輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳的一張社交照片，意外將人們的目光引向國際情報活動。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
媒體報導，一名與黃仁勳合影的中國籍女子，因其任職企業涉及先進晶片與資料中心業務，而受到美國情報及執法機關關注。真正值得關注的，不是照片中男女之間的關係，而是先進科技、商業利益與國家安全之間，已經形成何等複雜的交會。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
過去的間諜可能設法取得軍事地圖、密碼本或作戰計畫；今天的情報活動，則可能瞄準半導體製程、人工智慧晶片、雲端運算、研究成果與關鍵基礎設施。科技越進步，國家安全的邊界也越難辨認。
民主社會的珍貴，在於人民享有思想、言論、學術、遷徙與結社的自由。
美國教育哲學家杜威認為，民主不只是政府的組織形式，更是一種共同生活與經驗交流的方式。民主社會之所以能夠持續進步，正是因為人們可以自由溝通、公開討論、批判權威，並透過教育與社會經驗不斷修正自己的判斷。
然而，民主社會的開放，也可能成為威權國家進行情蒐與滲透的機會。
大學歡迎國際研究人員，企業尋求跨國合作，科技人才自由流動，這些原本都是促進人類文明進步的重要條件。但如果有國家利用這些開放制度，秘密取得受保護的技術、收買內部人員或操縱公共資訊，民主社會就必須面對新的安全挑戰。
這裡存在一個重要區別：正常的國際學術交流、合法技術合作與人才流動，不等於間諜活動。不能因為一個人的國籍、族裔或研究背景，就推定他具有情報身份。
民主制度真正需要防範的，是具有具體證據的非法行為，而不是把某一群人當成集體嫌疑犯。
杜威在《公眾及其問題》中主張，民主社會的困難必須透過更充分的民主參與與公共溝通來改善。這也提醒我們：保衛民主，不能以摧毀民主自身的基本價值為代價。
談到中國的情報活動，經常有人使用「千粒沙」的比喻，形容大量人員分散蒐集資訊，全民總動員！最後匯聚成具有戰略價值的情報。這個說法雖然生動，卻不能直接視為已經獲得證實、適用於所有中國情報機構的統一作業準則。
例如，中國政府曾推動「千人計畫」等人才引進政策，希望吸引海外專業人士參與科技與產業發展。人才招募本身並非犯罪，但若涉及隱瞞利益關係、違反研究契約、非法取得營業秘密或轉移受管制技術，就可能觸及法律與國家安全問題。
另一方面，美國等國也曾公開指控與中國政府相關的網路行動者，針對通訊、能源、交通及其他重要基礎設施進行滲透。這類活動不一定以立即破壞為目的，也可能是為了預先取得存取能力，在未來危機發生時掌握優勢。
此外，情報工作也可能利用金錢、職位、情感關係或個人弱點接近目標。
電影《蝴蝶君》所取材的法國外交人員與中國情報案件，就提醒人們，私人情感有時可能成為情報活動的一部分。法國外交人員被逮捕時才發現自己的愛人居然是男人！OMG！
如果要理解中共情報工作的歷史影響，1948年的國共內戰是一個不能忽略的案例。
遼瀋、徐蚌與平津三大戰役，決定了國共內戰後期的軍事局勢。國民政府的失敗涉及軍事指揮、兵力部署、經濟崩潰、政治支持、軍隊士氣與後勤補給等多重因素，不能全部歸因於情報滲透。
然而，中共在國軍內部長期建立地下組織，並透過情報蒐集、政治策反與戰場倒戈影響戰局，也確實是值得重視的歷史問題。
1948年11月8日，國軍第三綏靖區副司令張克俠、何基灃率領部分部隊倒戈，對徐蚌戰場的部署造成重大影響。兩人長期具有中共地下組織背景，顯示中共的情報工作不只是竊取文件，也包括在敵方軍事體系內建立可於關鍵時刻發揮作用的人員網路。
至於國防部作戰廳長郭汝瑰，相關歷史記述指出，他曾與中共地下組織保持秘密聯繫，並傳遞國軍重要作戰情報。
但這段歷史最值得注意的證據，並不是後人如何描述郭汝瑰，而是蔣介石本人留下的日記。
「郭廳長攜華中華東會剿計畫來平，請示修正後即令當日回京實施。」
這位「郭廳長」，經《蔣中正日記》編者註明，就是郭汝瑰。
這段記載證明，郭汝瑰當時不僅能接觸重要軍事機密，而且直接參與高層作戰計畫的呈報與修訂。
更加令人震驚的是，僅僅一個多月後，蔣介石已經知道參謀部可能發生情報洩漏。
「彼甚疑參謀部有間諜洩漏機密，故不敢公開陳述其腹案，要求與余個人談話決定其行動，余允之。」
杜聿明懷疑參謀部有人洩密，因此不願在公開軍事會議中說出真正的作戰構想，而要求與蔣介石私下討論。蔣介石同意了。
一個國家的最高軍事統帥，已經從前線指揮官口中得知，參謀部可能存在間諜，以致重要作戰計畫不敢公開討論。
然而，國軍的情報安全問題仍未能在戰局逆轉之前獲得有效控制。
當最高領導人知道軍事機密可能持續外洩時，為什麼整個指揮與反情報制度仍然無法有效阻止滲透？
國民政府的失敗，不能簡化為某一個間諜的功勞；同樣地，也不能忽略情報網路對戰局造成的破壞。
真正值得反省的，是一個龐大的國家機器，為何在危機已經浮現時，仍然缺乏足夠有效的自我保護能力。
從1948年的軍事作戰計畫，到今日的半導體與人工智慧技術，情報活動的對象雖然不同，卻存在一項共同問題：
威權國家的情報體系可以依賴高度集中的權力，但民主國家不能照搬威權國家的手段。
民主國家必須同時保障國家安全、人民自由與司法正義。
如果為了防止滲透，就全面限制學術交流、壓制言論自由，或以國籍與血統作為判斷忠誠的標準，最後反而可能傷害民主社會最值得珍惜的價值。
杜威的教育哲學提醒我們，民主不能只靠法律條文與政府機關維持，更需要具有判斷能力、公共責任與合作精神的公民。
人民必須學會辨識資訊來源，理解威權政治的運作方式，並對公共權力保持理性的監督。
真正成熟的民主教育，不是要求人民盲目相信政府，而是培養人民運用證據、理性與公共討論，保護自己共同建立的自由社會。
歷史上沒有任何政權能夠僅憑強大的軍事力量、嚴密的情報組織或龐大的經濟資源，就保證自己永遠存在。
對臺灣而言，真正重要的問題，不是等待中共有一天自行消失，而是如何在長期的政治與安全競爭中，建立足以保護民主制度的能力。
國家安全局、調查局、國防部、經濟部及相關科技主管機關，應建立明確的風險通報、案件分流與責任追蹤程序。當重大洩密疑慮出現時，不能只停留在高層的口頭警告，必須有可追蹤的調查、風險控制及結案機制，並接受適當的國會監督。
半導體、人工智慧、先進通訊、資安及其他經依法認定的重要技術，應建立分級保護制度。政府可以協助企業完善人員許可權管理、資訊存取記錄、供應鏈安全與營業秘密保護，同時避免以國籍作為一概而論的限制標準。
大學及研究機構應要求涉及敏感技術的合作計畫揭露資金來源、兼職關係、利益衝突與技術移轉安排。這些制度應採取風險分級，保障正常學術交流，不能把所有國際合作都視為安全威脅。
國家安全不只是軍人、情報人員與科技工程師的責任。各級學校應透過歷史案例、媒體識讀、公民討論及批判思考教育，使學生理解假訊息、政治操弄、非法情報活動與民主制度之間的關係。
這不是要求學生接受單一政治立場，而是培養他們獨立查證、辨識證據與理性判斷的能力。
所有調查、監控與限制措施，都必須符合必要性、比例原則與正當法律程序。涉及人民隱私、學術自由及言論自由的措施，更應具有司法或其他獨立監督機制，避免國家安全成為擴張行政權力的藉口。
1948年的歷史教訓告訴我們，發現危險並不等於排除危險。
對重大洩密案件與國家安全事件，政府應在不危及正在進行的調查與情報來源之前提下，建立跨機關檢討、改善期限、責任追蹤及適度公開報告的制度。
民主政府不能只要求人民相信它已經採取措施，而應在適當範圍內，讓人民知道制度是否真正獲得改善。
歷史不會原封不動地重演，但人類可能因為忽略歷史而重蹈覆轍。
1948年，蔣介石已經知道參謀部可能有間諜，卻仍然面對無法挽回的戰局。今天的臺灣，更應從這段歷史中學習如何及早辨識風險、建立有效制度。
保衛民主，不能只有對威權的警惕，更要有保護自由的智慧。
真正值得長存的，不是任何一個政權，而是人民追求自由、尊嚴與民主的精神。

title: 习与常委、胡锦涛投票 王沪宁投票点打破二十年惯例(图)
summary: 习与常委、胡锦涛投票 王沪宁投票点打破二十年惯例(图) 習近平 | 懷仁堂 | 投票站 | 懷仁堂投票站 | 动向 || 看中国网 2013年3月14日，在北京人民大会堂举行的中共全国人大第四次全体会议上，时任湖北省委书记李洪忠（右）排队等候将选票投入票箱。（图片来源：Feng Li/Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。 【看中国2026年11月9日讯】（看中国记者李德言综合报导）近日，习近平与中共政治局常委及韩正、胡锦涛在北京各自所
content:
习与常委、胡锦涛投票 王沪宁投票点打破二十年惯例(图) 習近平 | 懷仁堂 | 投票站 | 懷仁堂投票站 | 动向 || 看中国网
2013年3月14日，在北京人民大会堂举行的中共全国人大第四次全体会议上，时任湖北省委书记李洪忠（右）排队等候将选票投入票箱。（图片来源：Feng Li/Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月9日讯】（看中国记者李德言综合报导）近日，习近平与中共政治局常委及韩正、胡锦涛在北京各自所在的选区投票站投票，或是委讬工作人员投票。其中，王沪宁打破中共二十年惯例，在中南海选区怀仁堂投票站投票。习近平称，“要践行全过程人民民主”。对此，评论区网友们讽刺声一片。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
据中共党媒新华社报导称，2026年11月6日，是北京市区和乡镇两级中共人大代表换届选举的投票日。当天下午3点半，中共党魁习近平和中共政治局常委们分别在北京市各自所在的选区投票站投票。
其中，习近平是在西城区中南海选区怀仁堂投票站投票；李强在西城区文津街选区紫光阁投票站投票；赵乐际在西城区中南海选区人民大会堂投票站投票；王沪宁在中南海选区怀仁堂投票站投票；蔡奇在中南海选区怀仁堂投票站投票；丁薛祥在文津街选区紫光阁投票站投票；李希在东城区台基厂选取中央纪委国家监委机关投票站投票；韩正则委讬工作人员在中南海选区怀仁堂投票站投票。
11月6日，X平台博主“中国人事观察”发帖表示，最值得注意的是：中共全国政协主席王沪宁在中南海选区怀仁堂投票站投票，而不是在全国政协机关投票站。
从2006年以来，前几任中共全国政协主席贾庆林、俞正声、汪洋都是在全国政协机关投票。按中共惯例，全国人大常委会、全国政协、中央纪委的负责人各在本机关投票站投票，而中共党魁（总书记）和书记处第一书记在怀仁堂投票。
因此，王沪宁在中南海选区怀仁堂投票站投票，是二十年来的第一次例外。
贴文表示，投票地点随办公地点出现变化，中共中纪委机关已经搬迁到北京东城区，而李希的投票站也从北京西城区大觉换到东城区台基厂。因此，如果（中共政治局常委）的投票地点对应着他们的日常办公地点，说明王沪宁的主要办公地点可能仍在中南海，而不是在全国政协。目前，王沪宁仍兼任中央深改办主任一职。
此外，前中共党魁胡锦涛也委讬工作人员在中南海选区怀仁堂投票站投票。而中共中央、全国人大常委会、国务院、最高法院、最高检察院、全国政协、中央军委相关官员和退休官员，也在他们各自选区投票或是委讬他人进行投票。
据中共北京市政府公告称，在11月6日当天，北京为这次“选举”共设立13054个投票站，并通过差额选举，将产生新一届的区人大代表4898人、乡镇人大代表11137人。而且在投票“选举日”前，各选区已经通过社区和企事业单位提前向“选民”发出“一对一”的投票通知。
据新华社报导称，习近平在投票时说：“选举人大代表……要践行全过程人民民主，坚持党的领导，充分发扬民主，……加强选举全过程监督……。”
对此，X平台网友表示：“他不觉得尴尬吗？换我我都演不下去”；“我真担心他们演到一半，突然笑场了。”“年度最佳宣传骗”；“什么时候这种表演式选举在中国不再发生了，中国人也就正式不被独裁统治了。”“看，74岁的小学生，一板一眼的在摄像机镜头下投出了作秀的一票”；“今年看过最好笑的喜剧片”；“装模作样，像真的一样，笑死人了。”“演了几十年皇帝的新衣”；“普通百姓无任何投票权”；“为了他‘投票’还专门搭个场景。也是楚门的世界了。”“国内给这个称为，诈骗犯的表演！”“你说习近平带头来搞这个虚假的欺骗的全过程，人民民主。他为什么不带头来打国产爱国新冠疫苗呢？你只要认清习近平所作所为，就是为了搞终身制，搞世袭制这个邪恶的政治目的，就能够明白共产党民主，爱国的虚假性，欺骗性，邪恶性和愚昧性了。”“共产党民主的虚假性。全过程人民民主的虚假性。共产党决定候选人然后安排几个爱共产党的选民出来支持这几个候选人。共产党指定的几个候选人就能够成功当选，套用这个选举这个形式。就好比你问上海市长朱仲明到底怎么出来的？他会说是人大选出来当的，而不会说是习近平拍板，共产党内部决定。”
此外，也有网友自嘲说：“天塌了，难道（习近平）要干第4任期？那我这辈子岂不是要完蛋了？我还没奔小康呢”。

title: 内塔尼亚胡组阁受挫 前军头获总统授权争位(图)
summary: 内塔尼亚胡组阁受挫 前军头获总统授权争位(图) 以色列 | 加迪 | 组建 | 新政府 | 亚洲 || 看中国网 2026年11月8日，以色列总统伊萨克·赫尔佐格（Isaac Herzog，右）在耶路撒冷总统官邸举行仪式，正式授权Yashar党领袖加迪·艾森科特（Gadi Eisenkot）组建下一届联合政府。（图片来源：Amir Levy/Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。 【看中国2026年11月9日讯】（看中国记者路克编译/综
content:
内塔尼亚胡组阁受挫 前军头获总统授权争位(图) 以色列 | 加迪 | 组建 | 新政府 | 亚洲 || 看中国网
2026年11月8日，以色列总统伊萨克·赫尔佐格（Isaac Herzog，右）在耶路撒冷总统官邸举行仪式，正式授权Yashar党领袖加迪·艾森科特（Gadi Eisenkot）组建下一届联合政府。（图片来源：Amir Levy/Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月9日讯】（看中国记者路克编译/综合）以色列政府更迭出现关键进展。总统伊萨克・赫尔佐格（Isaac Herzog）11月7日宣布，将优先授权反对党领袖、前国防军总参谋长加迪・艾森科特（Gadi Eisenkot）组建新政府，并于8日在总统官邸正式交付授权书。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
据Axios报道，这是总理本雅明・内塔尼亚胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）自2021年以来最接近失去执政权的一次。不过，艾森科特虽然获得多数议员推荐，其阵营内部及潜在合作伙伴之间仍存在明显分歧，能否把组阁授权转化为执政多数，尚无定论。
10月27日举行的议会选举未能打破以色列政治僵局。内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团仍是议会第一大党，但其右翼和宗教政党阵营仅获得120席中的53席，失去多数地位。
艾森科特领导的反对派阵营获得48席，两个阿拉伯政党合计取得19席。在总统主持的磋商中，阿拉伯政党支持由艾森科特优先尝试组阁，使推荐他的议员总数达到67人；内塔尼亚胡则获得46人推荐。
据德国之声报道，赫尔佐格8日正式授权时表示，决定的关键在于谁更有机会组建下一届政府。艾森科特将有28天展开谈判，总统还可酌情延长最多14天。
艾森科特表示，他将推动成立“国家紧急政府”，以48席的反对派阵营为基础，争取更多议员支持。
获得67人推荐，为艾森科特赢得了先手机会，但推荐组阁与支持新政府上台，仍是两回事。
Axios指出，艾森科特必须争取阵营以外的议员，才能让新政府通过议会信任投票。若依靠阿拉伯政党，他可能需要接受对方入阁，或由这些政党在政府之外提供支持。
路透社分析，后一种安排可让艾森科特尝试组建少数派政府，但其盟友并非都能接受。“以色列是我们的家园”党此前已多次反对依靠阿拉伯政党支持的少数派政府。
艾森科特及部分盟友在竞选期间，也曾承诺不依赖阿拉伯政党组阁。如今若选择这条路径，就必须向选民解释立场调整，并防止原有阵营出现裂痕。
另一条路径，是争取长期与内塔尼亚胡合作的极端正统派犹太教政党。
此次总统磋商中，“圣经犹太教联盟”没有推荐内塔尼亚胡，也未支持其他候选人。这一决定使其成为组阁谈判中的重要变量。
据《以色列时报》报道，“以色列是我们的家园”党领袖阿维格多・利伯曼（Avigdor Liberman）已表示，愿意考虑与极端正统派政党合作，并在相关群体服兵役问题上接受“痛苦的妥协”，以避免再次选举。“圣经犹太教联盟”方面也释放出愿意讨论合作的信号。
兵役豁免恰恰是双方长期冲突的核心。艾森科特及其盟友主张扩大服役义务，宗教政党则坚持维护神学院学生的豁免安排。能否找到双方都可接受的方案，将直接影响新政府的前景。
面对组阁主动权旁落，内塔尼亚胡7日呼吁成立由他领导的团结政府，邀请艾森科特及其他犹太人反对党加入。他同时批评依赖阿拉伯政党支持的政府安排。
艾森科特拒绝这一提议，认为这是政治操作。其所属的Yashar党则表示，若利库德集团希望参与广泛联合政府，应接受由艾森科特担任总理。
路透社指出，如果艾森科特组阁失败，赫尔佐格可能转而让内塔尼亚胡尝试。内塔尼亚胡也可能争取反对派议员倒戈，重新拼凑多数支持；若后续尝试均告失败，以色列仍可能再次举行选举。
在新政府获得议会信任并就职前，内塔尼亚胡领导的看守政府将继续运作。艾森科特已经拿到组阁机会，但真正决定总理人选的，仍是接下来数周的联盟谈判。

美推百亿美元月球合约 八家企业竞逐订单(图) NASA | 100亿 | 建立 | 基地 | 时事 || 看中国网
2025年11月13日，杰夫·贝索斯（Jeff Bezos）旗下蓝色起源公司的“新格伦”火箭从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空军基地36号发射场升空，执行第二次任务NG-2，蓝色起源与埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）旗下SpaceX的竞争日益激烈。（图片来源：CHANDAN KHANNA/AFP via Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月8日讯】（看中国记者路克编译/综合）美国国家航空航天局（NASA）11月7日宣布，太空探索技术公司（SpaceX）、蓝色起源（Blue Origin）等八家企业，将获准竞逐未来十年总额上限100亿美元的月球运输任务。与此同时，NASA另行授予蓝色起源一份9400万美元的基础合同，计划将核动力探测车送往月球南极，为建立长期有人驻留的月球基地探路。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
据福克斯商业频道报道，这批项目涵盖货物运输、资源勘测、通信和供电设施。NASA希望在宇航员重返月面之前，先将基地所需的部分设备送抵目的地。
NASA在佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心举行的MAX POWER航空航天展上公布了上述安排。
入围新一阶段“商业月球载荷服务”（CLPS）计划的企业，包括埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）旗下的SpaceX、杰夫·贝索斯（Jeff Bezos）创办的蓝色起源，以及萤火虫航天、直觉机器、ispace美国公司、洛克希德·马丁航天、诺斯罗普·格鲁曼航天系统和旅行者技术公司。
这些企业将竞争后续具体订单，承担向月球运送科学仪器、技术试验设备及基地基础设施的任务。100亿美元是十年期框架合同的合计上限，具体授予金额取决于未来任务安排。
NASA同时将现有CLPS合同上限由26亿美元提高至42亿美元，以支持月球基地第一阶段建设。
NASA局长贾里德·艾萨克曼（Jared Isaacman）表示，月球基地将通过一次次任务逐步建成；宇航员重返月球时，部分基地设施应已提前部署在月面。
在本次公布的具体项目中，蓝色起源将使用“蓝月”Mark 1着陆器，把PROMISE六轮探测车运往月球南极。基础合同价值9400万美元，另设与履约表现挂钩、价值1.4亿美元的可选合同部分。
NASA目前以2028年末发射为目标，计划让探测车执行18个月任务，调查月面及地下环境，评估资源，并为后续着陆和基地选址提供数据。
据NASA公告，PROMISE采用核动力，可在漫长月夜及可能蕴藏水冰的永久阴影区工作。车载钻具将探测月面以下约一米的物质，配合光谱仪、温度和辐射传感器等设备分析当地环境。
探测车由NASA喷气推进实验室负责研制，将利用“好奇号”和“毅力号”火星车的备用飞行零件及工程测试模型，借助已有技术降低成本、缩短开发周期。
除月面探测任务外，NASA还向Arrow Science and Technology、蓝色起源及Impulse Space授予六项运输任务订单，合计约13亿美元。
这些任务将验证地球与月球之间的货运、导航和通信技术，并运送用于勘察潜在着陆地点的机器人设备，为宇航员抵达做好准备。
SpaceX则在现有月球物流合同下获得另一项演示任务，计划于2028年使用“星舰”向地月空间部署通信卫星，测试连接宇航员、地面任务控制人员和未来基地设施的通信网络。
据佛罗里达州媒体《太空海岸日报》刊载的NASA消息，这批运输任务还将使用轨道转移飞行器，在太空中承担货物转运，再由月球着陆器完成最后一程配送。
月球基地要持续运作，还需要稳定的电力和通信。NASA已选定蓝色起源旗下的蜜蜂机器人公司、Redwire及Yank Technologies，分别为一座小型通信与太阳能塔提供储能、发电及无线输电部件。
该系统将把太阳能供电与通信功能结合起来，支持未来月面活动。相关设备将先在地面组装测试，再安排运往月球。
基地建设之外，NASA也在扩充人员储备。据美联社报道，NASA已启动新一轮宇航员招募，预计2027年末完成遴选，候选人于2028年开始训练。同一年，也是该机构目前计划让美国宇航员重返月面的目标年份。
从先期货运、资源勘测到通信供电，这批项目显示，美国正围绕长期月面活动部署配套能力。NASA希望以月球基地积累的技术和运行经验，为未来载人火星任务奠定基础。
