Department of Commerce International Trade Administration
Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration, Department of Commerce.
Applicable November 4, 2026.
Kayden Jenson, Office II, AD/CVD Operations, Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration, U.S. Department of Commerce, 1401 Constitution Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20230; telephone: (202) 482-0967.
On October 15, 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) received a countervailing duty (CVD) petition concerning imports of seamless carbon and alloy steel standard, line, and pressure pipe (seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe) from India, filed in proper form on behalf of Tenaris USA (Tenaris), Vallourec Star LP (Vallourec), and the United Steel, Paper and Forestry, Rubber, Manufacturing, Energy, Allied Industrial and Service Workers International Union, AFL-CIO, CLC (USW) (collectively, the petitioners), domestic producers of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe and a certified union, which represents workers engaged in the production of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe in the United States.[1] The CVD Petition was accompanied by antidumping duty (AD) petitions concerning imports of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from Georgia and India.[2]
Between October 20 and 26, 2026, Commerce requested supplemental information pertaining to certain aspects of the Petition in supplemental questionnaires.[3] Between October 22 and 28, 2026, the petitioners filed timely responses to these requests for additional information.[4]
In accordance with section 702(b)(1) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended (the Act), the petitioners allege that the Government of India (GOI) is providing countervailable subsidies, within the meaning of sections 701 and 771(5) of the Act, to producers of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India, and that such imports are materially injuring, or threatening material injury to, the domestic industry producing seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe in the United States. Consistent with section 702(b)(1) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.202(b), for those alleged programs on which we are initiating a CVD investigation, the Petition was accompanied by information reasonably available to the petitioners supporting their allegations.
Commerce finds that the petitioners filed the Petition on behalf of the domestic industry, because the petitioners are interested parties, as defined in sections 771(9)(C) and (D) of the Act.[5] Commerce also finds that the petitioners demonstrated sufficient industry support with respect to the initiation of the requested CVD investigation.[6]
Because the Petition was filed on October 15, 2026, the POI is January 1, 2025, through December 31, 2025.[7]
The product covered by this investigation is seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India. For a full description of the scope of this investigation, see the appendix to this notice.
Comments on the Scope of the Investigation
On October 20 and 26, 2026, Commerce requested information and clarification from the petitioners regarding the proposed scope to ensure that the scope language in the Petition is an accurate reflection of the products for which the domestic industry is seeking relief.[8] On October 22 and 28, 2026, the petitioners provided clarifications and revised the scope.[9] The description of merchandise covered by this investigation, as described in the appendix to this notice, reflects these clarifications.
As discussed in the Preamble to Commerce's regulations, we are setting ( printed page 70848) aside a period for interested parties to raise issues regarding product coverage ( i.e., scope).[10] Commerce will consider all scope comments received from interested parties and, if necessary, will consult with interested parties prior to the issuance of the preliminary determination. If scope comments include factual information, all such factual information should be limited to public information.[11] Commerce requests that interested parties provide at the beginning of their scope comments a public executive summary for each comment or issue raised in their submission. Commerce further requests that interested parties limit their public executive summary of each comment or issue to no more than 450 words, not including citations. Commerce intends to use the public executive summaries as the basis of the comment summaries included in the analysis of scope comments. To facilitate preparation of its questionnaires, Commerce requests that scope comments be submitted by 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time (ET) on November 24, 2026, which is 20 calendar days from the signature date of this notice. Any rebuttal comments, which may include factual information, and should also be limited to public information, must be filed by 5:00 p.m. ET on December 4, 2026, which is 10 calendar days from the initial comment deadline.
Commerce requests that any factual information that parties consider relevant to the scope of this investigation be submitted during that period. However, if a party subsequently finds that additional factual information pertaining to the scope of the investigation may be relevant, the party must contact Commerce and request permission to submit the additional information. All scope comments must be filed simultaneously on the records of the concurrent AD and CVD investigations.
All submissions to Commerce must be filed electronically via Enforcement and Compliance's Antidumping Duty and Countervailing Duty Centralized Electronic Service System (ACCESS), unless an exception applies.[12] An electronically filed document must be received successfully in its entirety by the time and date it is due.
Pursuant to sections 702(b)(4)(A)(i) and (ii) of the Act, Commerce notified the GOI of the receipt of the Petition and provided an opportunity for consultations with respect to the Petition.[13] Commerce held consultations with the GOI on November 3, 2026.[14]
Determination of Industry Support for the Petition
Section 702(b)(1) of the Act requires that a petition be filed on behalf of the domestic industry. Section 702(c)(4)(A) of the Act provides that a petition meets this requirement if the domestic producers or workers who support the petition account for: (i) at least 25 percent of the total production of the domestic like product; and (ii) more than 50 percent of the production of the domestic like product produced by that portion of the industry expressing support for, or opposition to, the petition. Moreover, section 702(c)(4)(D) of the Act provides that, if the petition does not establish support of domestic producers or workers accounting for more than 50 percent of the total production of the domestic like product, Commerce shall: (i) poll the industry or rely on other information in order to determine if there is support for the petition, as required by subparagraph (A); or (ii) determine industry support using a statistically valid sampling method to poll the “industry.”
Section 771(4)(A) of the Act defines the “industry” as the producers as a whole of a domestic like product. Thus, to determine whether a petition has the requisite industry support, the statute directs Commerce to look to producers and workers who produce the domestic like product. The U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC), which is responsible for determining whether “the domestic industry” has been injured, must also determine what constitutes a domestic like product in order to define the industry. While both Commerce and the ITC apply the same statutory definition regarding the domestic like product,[15] they do so for different purposes and pursuant to a separate and distinct authority. In addition, Commerce's determination is subject to limitations of time and information. Although this may result in different definitions of the like product, such differences do not render the decision of either agency contrary to law.[16]
Section 771(10) of the Act defines the domestic like product as “a product which is like, or in the absence of like, most similar in characteristics and uses with, the article subject to an investigation under this title.” Thus, the reference point from which the domestic like product analysis begins is “the article subject to an investigation” ( i.e., the class or kind of merchandise to be investigated, which normally will be the scope as defined in the petition).
With regard to the domestic like product, the petitioners do not offer a definition of the domestic like product distinct from the scope of the investigation.[17] Based on our analysis of the information submitted on the record, we have determined that seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe, as defined in the scope, constitutes a single domestic like product, and we have analyzed industry support in terms of that domestic like product.[18]
In determining whether the petitioners have standing under section 702(c)(4)(A) of the Act, we considered the industry support data contained in the Petition with reference to the domestic like product as defined in the “Scope of the Investigation,” in the appendix to this notice. To establish industry support, the petitioners provided the 2025 shipments of the domestic like product for the U.S. producers that support the Petitions, and compared this to the estimated total 2025 shipments of the domestic like ( printed page 70849) product for the entire domestic industry.[19] Because total production data for the domestic like product for 2025 are not reasonably available to the petitioners, and the petitioners have established that shipments are a reasonable proxy for production data,[20] we relied on data provided by the petitioners for purposes of measuring industry support.[21]
Our review of the data provided in the Petition, the First General Issues Supplement, and other information readily available to Commerce indicates that the petitioners have established industry support for the Petition.[22] First, the Petition established support from domestic producers and supporters accounting for more than 50 percent of the total production of the domestic like product and, as such, Commerce is not required to take further action in order to evaluate industry support ( e.g., polling).[23] Second, the domestic producers and supporters have met the statutory criteria for industry support under section 702(c)(4)(A)(i) of the Act because the domestic producers and supporters who support the Petition account for at least 25 percent of the total production of the domestic like product.[24] Finally, the domestic producers and supporters have met the statutory criteria for industry support under section 702(c)(4)(A)(ii) of the Act because the domestic producers and supporters who support the Petition account for more than 50 percent of the production of the domestic like product produced by that portion of the industry expressing support for, or opposition to, the Petition.[25] Accordingly, Commerce determines that the Petition was filed on behalf of the domestic industry within the meaning of section 702(b)(1) of the Act.[26]
Because India is a “Subsidies Agreement Country” within the meaning of section 701(b) of the Act, section 701(a)(2) of the Act applies to this investigation. Accordingly, the ITC must determine whether imports of the subject merchandise from India materially injure, or threaten material injury to, a U.S. industry.
Allegations and Evidence of Material Injury and Causation
The petitioners allege that imports of the subject merchandise are benefiting from countervailable subsidies and that such imports are causing, or threaten to cause, material injury to the U.S. industry producing the domestic like product. In addition, the petitioners allege that subject imports exceed the negligibility threshold provided for under section 771(24)(A) of the Act.[27]
The petitioners contend that the industry's injured condition is illustrated by a significant increase in the volume of subject imports; underselling and price depression and/or suppression; negative impact on financial performance; and declines in production, U.S. shipments, and employment variables.[28] We assessed the allegations and supporting evidence regarding material injury, threat of material injury, causation, as well as negligibility, and we have determined that these allegations are properly supported by adequate evidence, and meet the statutory requirements for initiation.[29]
Based upon the examination of the Petition and supplemental responses, we find that they meet the requirements of section 702 of the Act. Therefore, we are initiating a CVD investigation to determine whether imports of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India benefit from countervailable subsidies conferred by the GOI. In accordance with section 703(b)(1) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.205(b)(1), unless postponed, we will make our preliminary determination no later than 65 days after the date of this initiation.
Based on our review of the Petition, we find that there is sufficient information to initiate a CVD investigation on 24 programs alleged by the petitioners. For a full discussion of the basis for our decision to initiate on each program, see the India CVD Initiation Checklist. A public version of the initiation checklist for this investigation is available on ACCESS.
In the Petition, the petitioners identified 16 companies in India.[30] Commerce intends to follow its standard practice in CVD investigations and calculate company-specific subsidy rates in this investigation. In the event that Commerce determines that the number of companies is large and it cannot individually examine each company based on Commerce's resources, where appropriate, Commerce intends to select mandatory respondents based on quantity and value (Q&V) questionnaires issued to the potential respondents. Commerce normally selects mandatory respondents in CVD investigations using U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) entry data for U.S. imports under the appropriate Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) subheadings listed in the “Scope of the Investigation,” in the appendix. However, for this investigation, some of the main HTSUS subheadings under which the subject merchandise would enter (7304.19.1020, 7304.19.1030, 7304.19.1045, 7304.19.1060, 7304.19.5020, 7304.19.5050, 7304.31.6050, 7304.39.0016, 7304.39.0020, 7304.39.0024, 7304.39.0028, 7304.39.0032, 7304.39.0036, 7304.39.0040, 7304.39.0044, 7304.39.0048, 7304.39.0052, 7304.39.0056, 7304.39.0062, 7304.39.0068, 7304.39.0072, 7304.51.5005, 7304.51.5060, 7304.59.6000) are basket categories under which non-subject merchandise may also enter. Therefore, instead of relying on CBP entry data in selecting respondents, we intend to issue Q&V questionnaires to each potential respondent for which there is complete address information on the record.
Commerce will post the Q&V questionnaire along with filing instructions on Commerce's website at https://www.trade.gov/​ec-adcvd-qv-questionnaire. Producers/exporters of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India that do not receive Q&V questionnaires may still submit a response to the Q&V questionnaire and can obtain a copy of the Q&V questionnaire from Commerce's website. Responses to the Q&V questionnaire must be submitted by the relevant Indian producers/exporters no later than 5:00 p.m. ET on November 18, 2026, which is two weeks from the signature date of this notice. All Q&V questionnaire responses must be filed electronically via ACCESS. An ( printed page 70850) electronically filed document must be received successfully, in its entirety, by ACCESS no later than 5:00 p.m. ET on the deadline noted above.
Interested parties must submit applications for disclosure under administrative protective order (APO) in accordance with 19 CFR 351.305(b). Instructions for filing such applications may be found on Commerce's website at https://www.trade.gov/​administrative-protective-orders.
In accordance with section 702(b)(4)(A) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.202(f), a copy of the public version of the Petition has been provided to the GOI via ACCESS. To the extent practicable, we will attempt to provide a copy of the public version of the Petition to each exporter named in the Petition, as provided under 19 CFR 351.203(c)(2).
Commerce will notify the ITC of its initiation, as required by section 702(d) of the Act.
The ITC will preliminarily determine, within 45 days after the date on which the Petition was filed, whether there is a reasonable indication that imports of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India are materially injuring, or threatening material injury to, a U.S. industry.[31] A negative ITC determination will result in the investigation being terminated.[32] Otherwise, this CVD investigation will proceed according to statutory and regulatory time limits.
Factual information is defined in 19 CFR 351.102(b)(21) as: (i) evidence submitted in response to questionnaires; (ii) evidence submitted in support of allegations; (iii) publicly available information to value factors of production under 19 CFR 351.408(c) or to measure the adequacy of remuneration under 19 CFR 351.511(a)(2); (iv) evidence placed on the record by Commerce; and (v) evidence other than factual information described in (i)-(iv). Section 351.301(b) of Commerce's regulations requires any party, when submitting factual information, to specify under which subsection of 19 CFR 351.102(b)(21) the information is being submitted [33] and, if the information is submitted to rebut, clarify, or correct factual information already on the record, to provide an explanation identifying the information already on the record that the factual information seeks to rebut, clarify, or correct.[34] Time limits for the submission of factual information are addressed in 19 CFR 351.301, which provides specific time limits based on the type of factual information being submitted. Interested parties should review the regulations prior to submitting factual information in this investigation.
Parties may request an extension of time limits before the expiration of a time limit established under 19 CFR 351.301, or as otherwise specified by Commerce. In general, an extension request will be considered untimely if it is filed after the expiration of the time limit established under 19 CFR 351.301, or as otherwise specified by Commerce.[35] For submissions that are due from multiple parties simultaneously, an extension request will be considered untimely if it is filed after 10:00 a.m. ET on the due date. Under certain circumstances, Commerce may elect to specify a different time limit by which extension requests will be considered untimely for submissions which are due from multiple parties simultaneously. In such a case, we will inform parties in a letter or memorandum of the deadline (including a specified time) by which extension requests must be filed to be considered timely. An extension request must be made in a separate, standalone submission; under limited circumstances we will grant untimely filed requests for the extension of time limits, where we determine, based on 19 CFR 351.302, that extraordinary circumstances exist. Parties should review Commerce's regulations concerning the extension of time limits and the Time Limits Final Rule prior to submitting factual information in this investigation.[36]
Any party submitting factual information in an AD or CVD proceeding must certify to the accuracy and completeness of that information.[37] Parties must use the certification formats provided in 19 CFR 351.303(g).[38] Commerce intends to reject factual submissions if the submitting party does not comply with the applicable certification requirements.
Interested parties must submit applications for disclosure under APO in accordance with 19 CFR 351.305. Parties wishing to participate in this investigation should ensure that they meet the requirements of 19 CFR 351.103(d) ( e.g., by filing the required letters of appearance). Note that Commerce has amended certain of its requirements pertaining to the service of documents in 19 CFR 351.303(f).[39]
This notice is issued and published pursuant to sections 702 and 777(i) of the Act, and 19 CFR 351.203(c).
Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary for Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Operations.
The merchandise covered by this investigation is seamless carbon and alloy steel (other than stainless steel) pipes and redraw hollows, less than or equal to 16 inches (406.4 mm) in nominal outside diameter, regardless of wall-thickness, manufacturing process ( e.g., hot finished or cold-drawn), end finish ( e.g., plain end, beveled end, upset end, threaded, or threaded and coupled), or surface finish ( e.g., bare, lacquered or coated). Redraw hollows are any unfinished carbon or alloy steel (other than stainless steel) pipe or “hollow profiles” suitable for cold finishing operations, such as cold drawing, to meet the American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) or American Petroleum Institute (API) specifications referenced below, or comparable specifications. Specifically included within the scope are seamless carbon and alloy steel (other than stainless steel) standard, line, and pressure pipes produced to the ASTM A-53, ASTM A-106, ASTM A-333, ASTM A-334, ASTM A-589, ASTM A-795, ASTM A-1024, and the API 5L specifications, or comparable specifications, and meeting the physical parameters described above, regardless of application, with the exception of the exclusions discussed below.
Specifically excluded from the scope of this investigation are: (1) all pipes meeting ( printed page 70851) aerospace, hydraulic, and bearing tubing specifications, including: (a) aerospace tubing produced to SAE Aerospace Material Specifications (AMS) 6360, 6361, and 6362; (b) hydraulic tubing produced to ASTM A-822, SAE J524, and EN 10305-4 specifications; and (c) bearing tubing produced to the SAE AMS 6440 specification, including bearing tubing manufactured from steel meeting the chemical and metallurgical requirements of ASTM A-295; (2) all pipes meeting the chemical requirements of ASTM A-335, whether finished or unfinished; (3) unattached couplings; (4) all mechanical, boiler, condenser and heat exchange tubing, except when such products conform to the dimensional requirements, i.e., outside diameter and wall thickness, of ASTM A-53, ASTM A-106 or API 5L specifications; (5) oil country tubular goods consisting of drill pipe, casing, tubing, and coupling stock; and (6) all pipes meeting the chemical requirements of ASTM A-335 regardless of their conformity to the dimensional requirements of ASTM A-53, ASTM A-106 or API 5L.
Subject seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe are normally entered under Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) subheadings 7304.19.1020, 7304.19.1030, 7304.19.1045, 7304.19.1060, 7304.19.5020, 7304.19.5050, 7304.31.6050, 7304.39.0016, 7304.39.0020, 7304.39.0024, 7304.39.0028, 7304.39.0032, 7304.39.0036, 7304.39.0040, 7304.39.0044, 7304.39.0048, 7304.39.0052, 7304.39.0056, 7304.39.0062, 7304.39.0068, 7304.39.0072, 7304.51.5005, 7304.51.5060, 7304.59.6000, 7304.59.8010, 7304.59.8015, 7304.59.8020, 7304.59.8025, 7304.59.8030, 7304.59.8035, 7304.59.8040, 7304.59.8045, 7304.59.8050, 7304.59.8055, 7304.59.8060, 7304.59.8065, and 7304.59.8070. Subject merchandise may also enter under HTSUS subheadings 7304.31.6010, 7304.39.0002, 7304.39.0004, 7304.39.0006, 7304.39.0008, 7304.51.5015, 7304.51.5045, 7304.59.2030, 7304.59.2040, 7304.59.2045, 7304.59.2055, and 7304.59.2060. The HTSUS subheadings and specifications are provided for convenience and customs purposes; the written description of the scope is dispositive.

content:
美国战争部长皮特·海格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)将前往菲律宾，出席本星期晚些时候在菲律宾宿务举行的东盟防长扩大会议(ADMM-Plus)。美国战争部说，海格塞斯将重申，在太平洋地区，美国致力于以实力求和平战略。
根据战争部星期天(10月25日)发布的新闻稿，海格塞斯在会议期间将举行双边和多边会谈，以“加强威慑、推进关键联盟和伙伴关系，并扩大在该地区的责任分担”。
美国在2026年防务战略在谈到美国在亚太的政策时，明确地将盟友间强调“责任分担”列为核心支柱之一。
战争部的新闻稿没有具体说明海格塞斯将与何人会晤，但菲律宾和日本媒体报道说，菲律宾国防部长吉尔伯托·特奥多罗(Gilberto Teodoro Jr.)和日本防卫大臣小泉进次郎(Shinjirō Koizumi)预计都将与海格塞斯举行双边会晤。
菲律宾通讯社星期一援引特奥多罗的话说，他与海格塞斯一定会在东盟防长扩大会议期间举行双边会晤。“我肯定会与海格塞斯举行双边会晤和小组会议，而且我几乎会与所有相关方举行双边会晤。”
特奥多罗表示，他将与海格塞斯讨论“加强防务关系”等议题，目标是“(探讨)我们是否需要增加现有工作，是否需要加快、放缓或其他方面的进展”。
第13届东盟防长扩大会议(ADMM-Plus)和第20届东盟防长会议(ADMM)将于10月28日至29日在菲律宾宿务省拉普拉普市举行。东盟防长会议(ADMM)成立于2006年，是东盟最高级别的防务磋商与合作机制，而东盟防长扩大会议(ADMM-Plus)则于2010年启动，旨在扩大东盟成员国与美国、澳大利亚、印度、日本、新西兰、韩国、俄罗斯和中国等八国之间的区域防务对话与合作。
值得一提的是，星期一，在中国外交部的例行记者会上，在被问到中方是否会派高级别官员或代表团出席本周三在马尼拉举行的东盟防长扩大会时，中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆没有直接回答，却表示，“东盟防长扩大会理应为地区国家加强对话、增进互信、推动合作发挥积极作用。我们反对任何势力公器私用，绑架东盟，搅局生事。”
郭嘉昆没有说明谁可能会“公器私用、搅局生事”。菲律宾是2026年东盟的轮值主席国，特奥多罗上星期五公开表示，如果中国采取武力拖走非法“坐滩”在第二托马斯礁(中国称仁爱礁，菲律宾称阿云津礁)的“马德雷山”号军舰，或对该军舰采取武力行动，将构成针对菲律宾的“战争行为”。
特奥多罗还表示，在东盟防长会议期间，各国国防部长还将讨论区域安全、人道主义援助和灾害应对等问题。
特奥多罗在星期一还提到，菲律宾有可能与志同道合的国家扩大其访问部队地位协定(SOVFA)，以加强国际维和合作，提升军事互操作性，并在联合国的主持下推进集体安全努力。
“这也让我看到了加强关系的可能性，或许可以与那些与我们基本价值观一致的国家签署访问部队地位协定。”他说道。迄今为止，菲律宾已与五个国家签署了访问部队地位协定，分别是法国、加拿大、澳大利亚、日本和新西兰。
另一方面，日本防卫大臣小泉进次郎星期五表示，他正在安排下星期与美国战争部长海格塞斯会面，因为他正在考虑是否出席在菲律宾举行的东盟防长扩大会议。
《今日日本》报道援引消息人士的话说，如果小泉进次郎与海格塞斯会面，两人预计将讨论如何应对近期一名驻冲绳县美军士兵因涉嫌抢劫和谋杀被捕一事。日本媒体报道，日本冲绳县那霸地方检察厅星期天已经以抢劫杀人罪起诉驻日美国海军陆战队士兵德文·雅各布·巴拉德(Devin Jacob Ballard)。

content:
黄仁勋婚外情：Nvidia调查其与疑似中国间谍的关系 - BBC News 中文
图像加注文字，黄仁勋承认有婚外情，并表示将配合这家科技巨头发起的安全调查。
Author, 内森·威廉斯（Nathan Williams）
Author, 佐伊·克莱曼（Zoe Kleinman）
美国科技巨头英伟达（Nvidia；辉达）将就公司行政总裁黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）与一名疑似中国间谍的婚外情展开独立调查。
英伟达是全球市值最高的公司之一。公司表示，董事会没有理由相信英伟达的商业机密或美国国家安全受到损害，并补充指黄仁勋承诺会继续领导公司。
另一方面，黄仁勋承认自己对妻子“不忠”，并就伤害妻子及子女一事道歉。
《纽约时报》报导，美国情报官员认为，与黄仁勋关系密切的中国商人黄乐（Alice Huang）是北京间谍。
黄仁勋表示，自己会为所做的一切“承担全部责任”，并承认自己的行为辜负了英伟达的员工、董事会及股东。
Play video, "Watch: Jensen Huang is a 'fine person' who has done 'an incredible job', says Trump", 节目全长 0,32
视频加注文字，特朗普称黄仁勋是“一个好人”，而且“工作做得非常出色”。（英语影片）
英伟达是全球最大的企业之一，在新兴人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI；人工智慧）技术所需的硬件制造领域扮演核心角色。黄仁勋掌舵公司超过30年。
他在声明中表示：“我对妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我所做的事没有任何藉口。我深感抱歉。”
他续称：“关于新闻报导提到的国家安全疑虑，英伟达董事会已启动独立调查。我支持这项调查并会全力配合。”
“我热爱我们的国家，也热爱我们的公司。我承诺会保护英伟达，并支持美国国家安全。我以身为美国人为荣，也心存感激。”
英伟达董事会另行发表声明，指鉴于近期有报导指，“公司创办人兼行政总裁黄仁勋成为外国情报机关的目标”，董事会将展开调查。
声明续称：“董事会将美国的国家安全及经济安全放在首位，这对英伟达及其股东的利益至关重要。”
“尽管董事会目前没有理由相信美国国家安全或英伟达的机密资料曾遭泄露，但董事会的调查将审视所有可取得的资料。”
美国总统特朗普表示，自调查消息曝光以来，他未与英伟达行政总裁黄仁勋交谈。
特朗普向记者表示：“我只知道他是个很好的人，但你永远不知道实际发生甚么事。”他又补充指，黄仁勋“为我们的国家作出了了不起的贡献”。
黄仁勋曾多次在英伟达几乎濒临破产之际力挽狂澜，而且早在全球其他人看好人工智能之前，便已决定押注这个领域。
他当年决定将原本为游戏用途设计的英伟达晶片，发展成业界最适合用于AI开发的产品。如今此举已取得巨大回报，公司市值更达数万亿美元。
这次事件对黄仁勋而言是重大打击。他以工作狂及完美主义者见称，对员工的工作表现亦有极高要求。
与黄仁勋没有亲属关系的黄乐，据报与总部设于新加坡的数据中心公司超速国际（Megaspeed）有关联。
该公司上月向《纽约时报》表示，现任管理层认真看待有关指控，并已委任外部法律顾问进行内部调查。
英伟达是AI基础设施领域的核心企业，向多家领先的AI模型开发商供应晶片，包括OpenAI及Meta。
这家晶片制造商市值约达4.5万亿美元，是历来市值最高的公司之一。
中国此前曾否认有关当局针对英伟达行政总裁进行间谍活动的指控，形容有关说法是“捕风捉影，纯属对华污蔑抹黑”。
《纽约时报》引述匿名消息人士报导，美国情报机构一直监视黄乐，并结论认为她正代表中国政府行事。
据报，监视行动发现黄乐与一名美国公民之间的通讯。美国当局其后透过一项称为“揭露身份”（unmasking）的程序，确认该名美国公民就是黄仁勋。
目前仍不清楚黄乐据称向北京传递了甚么资料、这些资料的价值有多大，以及她被指何时开始蒐集情报。
上星期，多名美国国会议员致函黄仁勋，要求他就有关报导提及的关系出席国会听证。
三名众议院共和党籍委员会主席要求黄仁勋于本月稍后出席听证会，就有报导指他与黄乐关系密切，讨论英伟达“防范外国敌对势力间谍活动的安全措施”。
信中指出：“近期的报导引起重大国家安全疑虑，涉及PRC（中华人民共和国）取得美国敏感技术及资讯的问题。”
“本届国会期间，中国渗透美国及取得尖端技术的问题，是我们三个委员会调查工作的核心议题。”
英伟达的AI晶片一直是美中竞争的焦点之一。华盛顿此前曾实施出口管制，限制其先进产品可销往哪些地方。
当中因为担心令中国科技产业取得相对于美国的优势，美国政府曾限制英伟达第二先进的半导体产品H200出口。
今年1月，特朗普政府表示将有条件批准英伟达向中国客户出售H200晶片。

微短剧：为何愈来愈多英国人观看源自中国的“碎片化”剧集？ - BBC News 中文
图像加注文字，Spare Arrow 今年稍早在社交媒体上推出了首部微短剧《Glen's Boutique》，这是一部喜剧冒险作品。
Author, 格蕾丝·迪恩（Grace Dean）
每天晚上，希瑟·夏罗克（Heather Sharrock）都会坐下来观看自己最喜爱的剧集。
但那不是在网飞（Netflix）、BBC iPlayer，甚至不是在电视上播放，而是在她的手机里。
我们之中有些人或许每晚能看完几集最新追看的剧集，Heather 却能一口气追看几十集，因为这位来自苏格兰、55岁的女子迷上了微短剧（microdrama）。
Heather 说：“现在世界上有太多乱七八糟的事情在发生，能够暂时放空，不去想那些事情，感觉很好。”
微短剧在中国早已大受欢迎，如今在英国也愈来愈流行，可在 ReelShort、CandyJar 和 DramaBox 等应用程式上观看。上星期，制作方宣布将经典肥皂剧《家有芳邻》（Neighbours）的故事线重新剪辑成超短的直式剧集，这是这种形式正逐步走向主流的最新迹象之一。
微短剧由节奏明快、张力十足的短篇集数组成，每集通常长60至90秒。许多作品聚焦于禁忌之恋、家族纷争和隐藏身份的亿万富豪等主题，而几乎每一集都会以戏剧性的悬念作结。每部作品通常有50集或以上，因此总时长与一部长篇电影相若。
来自苏格兰、45岁的影迷黛安·艾特肯（Diane Aitken）将她喜爱的狼人与吸血鬼题材微短剧形容为1980年代美国肥皂剧《家族风云》（Dallas；《朱门恩怨》／《豪门恩怨》）或《王朝》（Dynasty；《朝代》／《锦绣豪门》）的“加强版”。
图像加注文字，Diane 和 Sarah-Jayne 都表示，她们是在社交媒体上看到广告后开始接触微短剧的。
出生于中国的电影制作人孙慧明（Samantha Sun）表示，这类剧集于2010年代末在中国出现，最初是由网络小说改编而成，制作成本低廉且拍摄快捷；对许多观众而言，它们是一种逃避现实的方式。
来自唐卡斯特、46岁的莎拉—简·伦恩（Sarah-Jayne Lunn）表示，微短剧帮助她度过人生中的艰难时期。她说：“我立刻就上瘾了。我不用想太多。”
珍·库珀（Jen Cooper）是微短剧观众，现时则担任业界顾问。她对此表示认同。她说，微短剧最初主要受到寻找爱情题材内容的中年女性欢迎，许多 BookTok 和浪漫奇幻（romantasy）爱好者都会观看，但如今已吸引更广泛的观众群。
图像加注文字，中国观众已被微短剧戏剧性的情节和快节奏的特点深深吸引。
根据中国国家广播电视总局数据，去年中国微短剧市场规模超过1000亿元人民币（138.9亿美元；4200亿元新台币），观众人数突破8亿。但微短剧在韩国（南韩）、印度和美国同样受欢迎，而亚马逊 Prime、Peacock 和 Disney+ 等串流平台都已宣布计划在服务中加入微短剧。
在英国，自称全国首个专门微短剧应用程式的 TattleTV 于今年稍早推出；而皇家电视学会（Royal Television Society, RTS）则于今夏举办有关微短剧的业界座谈会。
各家公司亦希望把握微短剧热潮，为社交媒体制作品牌短片广告，其中包括杰米·奥利弗（Jamie Oliver）、合作社（Co-op），以及第四频道电视台（Channel 4）与 Sol de Janeiro 合作推出的作品。
威尔士制作公司 Spare Arrow 的夏洛特·布罗肯布罗（Charlotte Brokenbrow）表示，微短剧必须节奏明快，才能留住观众注意力。该公司于今年制作首部微短剧系列。
她说：“如果剧本和影片留白太多，观众就会觉得无聊，然后滑走。”
除了节奏飞快之外，微短剧受欢迎的原因之一是观众可以利用零碎时间观看，因此有分析人士形容它们为“零食式内容”（snackable；碎片化内容）。
安格利亚鲁斯金大学（Anglia Ruskin University, ARU）电影与媒体副教授蒂娜·肯德尔博士（Dr Tina Kendall）表示，微短剧亦迎合了观众转向“随意、低投入、可以随时开始和停止观看”的趋势。
有受访者向BBC表示，他们会在接孩子放学时于车内观看；也有人表示，会一边处理家务或行政工作，一边把微短剧当作背景播放。
Sarah-Jayne 说，由于剧情走向通常“太容易预料”，她甚至可以一边工作一边看。
专门的微短剧应用程式通常先让用户免费观看头几集，之后则要求付费订阅。CandyJar 年费49英镑（66美元；475元人民币；1960元新台币），DramaBox 则收费110英镑。不过，大部分微短剧平台都允许追剧观众购买按周计算的订阅服务，或透过观看广告换取免费集数。
当你浏览这些应用程式时，黑帮头目、欢喜冤家变情人，以及牛仔等主题一再出现。
孙慧明表示，中国制作公司经常复制成功公式，只作微小改动，而 Heather 对此亦深有同感。
她说：“很多其实都是同一个故事，只是换了不同背景设定。”又说自己已经“看腻了”亿万富豪行政总裁题材。
较为离奇的剧名包括《我领养了被偷走的孩子》（I Adopted My Stolen Baby）、《迷恋我的英国牛仔》（Craving My British Cowboy），以及《我在圣诞节找到一位无家可归的亿万富翁丈夫》（Found a Homeless Billionaire Husband for Christmas）。
一些观众表示，部分剧情有贬低女性之嫌，其中某些作品粗糙地描绘暴力和性侵情节。曾于2024年出演首部微短剧的演员可可·泰勒（Coco Taylor）说：“这甚至变成了一个笑话，女演员在吃午饭之前就已经遭遇了无数可怕的事情，哭喊了上千万次。”
泰勒表示，她曾拒绝接演某些作品，因为她认为那些剧集过于厌女。不过，她与许多微短剧爱好者都表示，故事质素已经有所提升，他们认为这是因为现在有更多剧情由美国和英国团队编写；他们亦热切谈论微短剧正逐步拓展至喜剧、惊悚和恐怖等类型。
图像加注文字，Coco Taylor 正在主演一部由威尔士制作公司拍摄的谋杀悬疑微短剧。
制作公司 Black Swan 创办人海顿·韦克林（Haydn Wakeling）于今年稍早透过电影业界人士首次听闻微短剧。他说：“快转到现在，已经变成所有人都在谈论的话题。”
韦克林表示，从财务角度来看，微短剧对导演与制作人非常有吸引力。拍摄一部时长介乎60至90分钟的微短剧通常不足两星期，因此能有效降低成本。
导演丹·勒文斯坦Dan Löwenstein）于2024年2月执导首部微短剧《黑帮情人》（Mafia Lover），如今他已拍摄到第38部。他最初参与的是由中国应用程式平台委托制作的作品，但表示随着中国业界转向人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI；人工智慧）制作，他现正与美国平台、全球串流媒体和英国公司合作。
图像加注文字，制作公司 Black Swan 的电影制作人正在为他们首部微短剧进行最后修饰。这部作品是一套于7月拍摄、共50集的谋杀悬疑剧。
英国现已成为欧洲最大的微短剧观众市场。虽然许多观众与业界制作人都对这种形式的未来感到兴奋，但它亦不乏批评者。
有人讥讽微短剧是低质内容，会破坏人们的专注力。《卫报》（The Guardian）一篇评论文章的作者便形容这类剧集“愚蠢得近乎灾难性，而且客观而言品质低劣”。
但正如由观众转型成顾问的珍·库珀所说：“没有人会说这是甚么深刻作品，但如果它能让人产生情感共鸣、令某人展露笑容，或让艰难的一天变得稍微容易一些，那肯定是一件值得庆祝的美好事情。”

summary: “臣妾要告发……”——这是横店游客版甄嬛传的拍摄现场图像来源: Go Nakamura/REUTERS （德国之声中文网）在浙江横店影视城的一座仿造的宫殿里，一位身穿古装的年轻女孩怒目圆睁，抬手给跪在地上的“嫔妃”一记耳光。导演喊停，围观游客举起手机拍摄，现场爆发出一阵笑声。 主角只是一群专程来到横店体验“当演员”的普通游客。 曾经被称为“中国好莱坞”的横店，如今正在经历一场身份转变：一边是越来越冷清的影视产业，一边是越来越火爆的“人人都能当主角”体验经济。 Clare Hu
content:
“臣妾要告发……”——这是横店游客版甄嬛传的拍摄现场图像来源: Go Nakamura/REUTERS
（德国之声中文网）在浙江横店影视城的一座仿造的宫殿里，一位身穿古装的年轻女孩怒目圆睁，抬手给跪在地上的“嫔妃”一记耳光。导演喊停，围观游客举起手机拍摄，现场爆发出一阵笑声。
主角只是一群专程来到横店体验“当演员”的普通游客。
曾经被称为“中国好莱坞”的横店，如今正在经历一场身份转变：一边是越来越冷清的影视产业，一边是越来越火爆的“人人都能当主角”体验经济。
Clare Huang和女友们专程从1500多公里外来到横店，就是为了体验一把当主角的乐趣。
被誉为“中国好莱坞”的横店，是许多中国古装电视剧的拍摄地。
不过如今这里正在在拓展“体验式旅游”业务，允许游客在专业影视拍摄场景中亲自出演戏份。这些场景包括仿造北京故宫建造的宫殿，以及曾被专业剧组用于拍摄的老上海街景。
几百块钱就能当上自己的短剧大女主图像来源: Go Nakamura/REUTERS
像Clare Huang选择的“微短剧体验”项目，游客只需支付388元人民币，就能获得服装、化妆、导演指导、专业拍摄和后期剪辑服务，最终拿到一段属于自己的90秒短剧视频。
有人扮演皇帝，有人出演皇后，还有人体验“霸道总裁爱上保洁阿姨”式的狗血剧情。
自8月推出这一体验项目以来，横店方面表示已有超过2000人参与。大多数日期的预约都已满额，尤其是在周末和节假日期间。
曾经从事影视拍摄工作的导演王伟力表示：“国庆假期期间，我从早拍到晚，但还是有很多客人排不上档期。”
路透社指出，这一项目的火爆，反映出中国消费者支出模式正在发生更广泛的变化。
房地产长期低迷、经济增长放缓后，人们在房屋装修、奢侈品等大额消费上变得谨慎，但在旅游、娱乐、情绪价值和个性化体验上的支出却保持增长。
沉浸式体验成为中国人更愿意买单的消费项目图像来源: Go Nakamura/REUTERS
尤其是在短视频时代，每个人都希望成为镜头里的主角。
在横店负责游客微短剧体验项目的导演吴艺卓对法新社表示，微短剧受欢迎的原因，是因为其内容往往带有浓厚的幻想色彩。
不管是保安被美女总裁追求，或者清洁工被英俊霸道总裁爱上之类的故事。“这些本质上都是一种逃离现实的幻想。”
他说：“即便我们明明知道自己看到的是虚构故事，我们的情绪依然会随着剧情起伏，从而得到某种压力释放。”
横店积极增加微短剧体验业务，与近年来传统传统影视剧开拍项目减少密切相关，也是横店在影视寒冬与文旅转型双重压力下的一种自救与商业模式转型。
近年来，短剧制作公司越来越多地利用人工智能，用算法取代演员和编剧，以大幅降低制作成本。
中国中央电视台（CCTV）今年6月报道称，2026年第一季度全国上线的12.8万部微短剧中，95%的作品都包含AI生成内容。
据央视报道，今年横店从业人员能够获得的演出机会也明显减少。
随着剧组对拍摄场景需求的下降，横店的经营侧重点向旅游业倾斜图像来源: Go Nakamura/REUTERS
过去，一些群众演员每天最多可赚取600元人民币；而今年，他们的日收入已下降到过去的大约一半。
表演专业学生高赛菲（音）对法新社表示，AI确实能够以更低成本制作出更加宏大壮观的场景。
但与此同时，对于学习表演的人来说，这也是一把“双刃剑”。
“我们这些表演专业的学生，未来可能会发现自己失业了。”
据《联合早报》报道，横店一向是中国古装影视剧的生产摇篮与行业景气风向标，往年盛夏，各大剧组的开机仪式热闹非凡。然而在AI技术冲击、项目资金短缺等因素的影响之下，今年暑期在横店开机的古装长剧只有两部。
随着中国影视行业陷入“断崖式减产”，也许横店会从“中国好莱坞”转型为“大型体验乐园”？

summary: 澳门前民主派立法会议员区锦新被澳门初级法院以“颠覆国家政权罪”等罪名判处12年6个月徒刑图像来源: Eduardo Leal/AFP （德国之声中文网）现年69岁的澳门前民主派立法会议员区锦新去年7月30日被澳门警方以涉嫌向“境外反华组织”提供资料等理由拘捕。区锦新是澳门民主派组织新澳门学社创会成员，曾担任澳门立法会议员20年，至2021年不再参选。离开议会后，区锦新仍持续关注澳门政府的施政、民主发展、劳工权益及社会议题，多年来参与及举办悼念六四活动。 本周五，澳门初级法院宣
content:
澳门前民主派立法会议员区锦新被澳门初级法院以“颠覆国家政权罪”等罪名判处12年6个月徒刑图像来源: Eduardo Leal/AFP
（德国之声中文网）现年69岁的澳门前民主派立法会议员区锦新去年7月30日被澳门警方以涉嫌向“境外反华组织”提供资料等理由拘捕。区锦新是澳门民主派组织新澳门学社创会成员，曾担任澳门立法会议员20年，至2021年不再参选。离开议会后，区锦新仍持续关注澳门政府的施政、民主发展、劳工权益及社会议题，多年来参与及举办悼念六四活动。
本周五，澳门初级法院宣判，区锦新“颠覆国家政权罪”、“与澳门特别行政区以外的组织、团体或个人建立联系作出危害国家安全的行为罪”和一项“违反保密罪”罪成，分别判监11年3个月、3年9个月及9个月。按照澳门《刑法典》数罪并罚规定，法院最后决定判处区锦新入狱12年半。
法院在判决新闻稿中称，区锦新在早前的闭门庭审中，对大部分基础事实没有异议，并称他“承认勾结和串通多个境外组织的事实行为构成犯罪” ，“并认同辩护律师为其辩护的意见”。法院还称，尽管嫌犯为初犯，且承认作出相当部分的犯罪事实，“惟其故意程度极高，有关犯罪的不法性程度及可能造成的后果均十分严重。“
判决新闻稿中称，“区锦新长期亲身协助和配合境外敌对组织收集、预备及公然散布诸多明显充斥属于颠覆国家政权的政治主张以及属于虚假且明显有所歪曲的图片及资讯，借此勾连境外敌对组织的非法手段共谋煽动本澳居民对中央人民政府的仇恨，以图推翻、破坏《中华人民共和国宪法》所确立的国家根本制度，相关颠覆行为即使在《维护国家安全法》于2023年修订生效后仍然持续。” 此外，判决新闻稿指区锦新在2021年担任立法会议员期间，将涉及澳门赌牌续期的闭门会议秘密内容泄露予境外组织，符合“违反保密罪”。
澳门特区政府在法院宣判后发表声明，表示尊重及支持法院裁决，呼吁社会各界尊重法院裁决。
区锦新的妻子郑妙珊（Virginia Cheang）表示裁决不可接受并在一封公开信中谴责该案是政治审判。信中写道：“从闭门审判到公开宣判，这到底算什么？这是一场政治审判，是一场旨在羞辱人格、毫无根据的迫害。”
现居伦敦的区锦新的女儿区汉儿（Au Hon I）此前曾向美联社透露，家属聘请的律师无法在狱中会见区锦新，且家人已近一年无法与他进行任何交流。但法院表示，在法律程序进行期间，已指派一名经区锦新本人认可的律师为其提供代理，且他已行使了辩护权。法院还称准许其家属定期探视。
区锦新的国际法律顾问迈克尔·波拉克（Michael Polak）指出，作为葡萄牙公民的区锦新本不应因其非暴力的信念而遭到拘留；他敦促葡萄牙和欧盟要求允许区锦新离开澳门。
波拉克表示：“针对区先生的这些捏造指控所引发的一系列事件，根本称不上是真正意义上的审判或定罪；这让澳门无异于世界上那些最压迫的国家。”
人权观察（Human Rights Watch）在裁决后发表声明，指“澳门政府对民主派领袖区锦新的不公正检控和严厉判刑，对澳门所有和平批评政府的人士造成寒蝉效应。澳门打压民主派声音，是中国政府更广泛打压异议及基本自由的一环。”现任人权观察亚洲区副主任王松莲表示，区锦新遭受长时间审前羁押丶闭门审讯，以及选择代表律师的权利受到限制，显示案件的司法程序存在违反正当法律程序及公平审讯权利的问题。
由于区锦新拥有葡萄牙国籍（欧盟公民），欧盟对外行动署及欧洲议会去年8月发表决议谴责澳门当局的逮捕行动，称此举加剧了对中国澳门地区“政治多元化持续遭到侵蚀”的担忧。欧盟还重申，尊重人权和基本自由是《澳门基本法》和前葡萄牙殖民地所建立的“一国两制”原则的核心要素。
澳门曾是葡萄牙殖民地，1999年回归中国成为特别行政区。澳门拥有独立的政治和法律体系，也是中国境内唯一博彩业合法的城市。澳门当局于2009年为澳门基本法第23条完成立法，并于2023年完成修订。该法律条文规定，“澳门特别行政区应自行立法禁止任何叛国、分裂国家、煽动叛乱、颠覆中央人民政府及窃取国家机密的行为，禁止外国的政治性组织或团体在澳门特别行政区进行政治活动，禁止澳门特别行政区的政治性组织或团体与外国的政治性组织或团体建立联系。”

特朗普称他认为他将在中国APEC峰会上与习近平和普京会面
美国总统表示“有趣”的会议将讨论无核化问题
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普还表示，他、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将讨论结束伊朗战争。 ©路透社
2026 年 11 月 9 日 09:46 日本标准时间
（路透社）——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周日表示，他认为他将于下周在中国举行的亚太经合组织领导人峰会上会见中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，讨论结束伊朗战争和无核化问题。
特朗普在从佛罗里达州飞回华盛顿之前告诉记者，他将前往中国参加定于 11 月 18 日至 19 日在南部科技中心深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会。
“我认为，其中一次会议将是与普京总统和习主席举行，那会很有趣。我们谈论了很多事情，包括无核化，但我们会谈论很多事情。我们正在努力结束伊朗战争，”他说。
特朗普10月表示，他对与习近平和普京进行三方军控谈判持开放态度，他表示会谈重点将是无核化。
《华尔街日报》后来报道称，普京已提议利用三边会议来讨论结束俄罗斯在乌克兰的长期战争。
特朗普在接受哥伦比亚广播公司《60 分钟》节目采访时表示，“我相信我们非常接近达成协议”，以结束俄罗斯与乌克兰的战争，这将导致“乌克兰的面貌略有不同”，但他没有提供具体细节。

November 9, 2026 09:46 JST
(Reuters) -- President Donald Trump said on Sunday he thinks he will meet Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin at an APEC leaders' summit in China next week and discuss ending the war in Iran and denuclearization.
Trump told reporters before flying back to Washington from Florida that he will travel to China for the APEC summit, set for November 18-19 in the southern tech hub of Shenzhen.
"One of the meetings, I think, will be with President Putin and President Xi, and that'll be interesting. We're talking a lot of things, including denuclearization, but we'll be talking a lot of things. We're trying to end the war in Iran," he said.
Trump said in October that he was open to three-way arms control talks with Xi and Putin, which he said would focus on denuclearization.
The Wall Street Journal later reported that Putin has pitched using a trilateral meeting to discuss an end to Russia's long-running war in Ukraine.
Trump said in an interview with CBS' 60 Minutes program that "I believe we're very close to making a deal" to end the Russia-Ukraine war that would result in a "little bit different shape Ukraine," without offering specifics.

title: China extends suspension of 24% US tariff for two months
zh_title: 中国将暂停对美国加征24%关税延长两个月
summary: 中国将暂停对美国加征24%关税延长两个月中国劳工布告栏 Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 中国将暂停对美国进口产品加征 24% 关税的期限延长两个月 中国将从 11 月 10 日 13:01 起继续对美国进口产品暂停加征 24% 的报复性关税两个月，维持 10% 的关税，以落实两国领导人在华盛顿峰会上达成的共识。中国国务院关税税则委员会11月9日宣布，继续对进口商品暂停加征24%的报复性关税。
content:
中国将暂停对美国加征24%关税延长两个月中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
中国将暂停对美国加征24%关税延长两个月
中方将从11月10日13时01分起继续对美国进口产品暂停加征24%的报复性关税两个月，维持10%的关税，以落实两国领导人华盛顿峰会共识。
中国国务院关税税则委员会11月9日宣布，自11月10日13时01分起，继续对原产于美国的进口商品暂停加征24%的报复性关税两个月，同时保留10%的关税。此举是落实中美领导人华盛顿峰会共识的一部分。
商务部表示，继续部分暂停对美商品加征关税，旨在为双边经贸合作提供相对稳定、可预期的政策环境，促进中美经贸关系持续健康发展。
声明补充说，中方注意到美方多次声明以301条款关税取代根据国际紧急经济权力法案（IEEPA）征收的关税，该法案已被裁定无效。中方将密切关注美方后续行动，并适时调整关税反制措施。
官方广播机构香港电台（RTHK）于 11 月 9 日发布了该公告。

China extends suspension of 24% US tariff for two months | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
China extends suspension of 24% US tariff for two months
China will continue suspending the 24% retaliatory tariff on US imports for two months from 13:01 on 10 November, keeping a 10% tariff in place, as part of efforts to implement the consensus reached at the Washington summit between the two countries' leaders.
China’s State Council Tariff Commission on 9 November announced it will continue suspending the 24% retaliatory tariff on US-origin imports for two months, starting from 13:01 on 10 November, while retaining a 10% tariff. The move is part of efforts to implement the consensus reached at the Washington summit between the Chinese and US leaders, according to a commission statement.
The commission said the continued partial suspension of additional tariffs on US goods aims to provide a relatively stable and predictable policy environment for bilateral business cooperation, and to promote the sustained and healthy development of Sino-US economic and trade relations.
It added that China has noted repeated US statements about replacing the tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA), which have been ruled invalid, with Section 301 tariffs. China will closely monitor subsequent US actions and adjust its tariff countermeasures as appropriate.
The announcement was published by state broadcaster Radio Television Hong Kong (RTHK) on 9 November.

title: China's Vice Finance Minister Guo Tingting: Uphold openness, support Hong Kong's role in global accounting governance
zh_title: 财政部副部长郭婷婷：坚持开放，支持香港在全球会计治理中的作用
summary: 财政部副部长郭婷婷：坚持开放，支持香港在全球会计治理中的作用中国劳工布告栏 星期一, 2026 年 11 月 9 日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 中国财政部副部长郭婷婷：坚持开放，支持香港在全球会计治理中的作用 中国财政部副部长郭婷婷表示，北京将继续致力于高标准的开放，并将支持香港的会计行业及其作为国际金融中心的地位。她在香港的一个论坛上发表讲话时概述了四个优先事项
content:
财政部副部长郭婷婷：坚持开放，支持香港在全球会计治理中的作用中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
财政部副部长郭婷婷：坚持开放，支持香港在全球会计治理中的作用
中国财政部副部长郭婷婷表示，北京将继续致力于高标准的开放，并将支持香港的会计行业及其作为国际金融中心的地位。她在香港的一个论坛上发表讲话时概述了四个优先事项，包括人工智能监管、反欺诈措施
中国财政部副部长郭婷婷表示，中国将继续致力于扩大高水平对外开放，积极参与全球经济治理，包括会计和审计治理。她补充说，国内当局平等对待所有在中国运营的机构。财政部将继续支持香港会计及审计业的繁荣，协助巩固香港国际金融中心的地位。
郭文贵在香港会计及财务报告委员会区域监管论坛上发表讲话时指出，新一轮科技革命和产业变革正在加速，全球经济格局正在深度调整。跨境投融资活动持续活跃，数字化、智能化、绿色发展成为重要方向和动力。新的生产方式、生活方式和商业模式不断涌现，为全球会计审计行业在ESG可持续披露、数字化审计等领域带来了机遇和挑战。
针对新形势，郭总提出四点建议。首先，她呼吁共同努力应对新的监管挑战，特别是在人工智能、大数据和区块链等新兴领域。她表示，监管必须平衡发展和安全，既要避免僵化套用扼杀创新的旧规则，又要避免出现监管漏洞，导致算法黑匣子和数据垄断等风险。
其次，郭说，今年中国在《注册会计师法》中增加了监督管理一章，建立了从教育、警告到行政处罚的分级监管制度。初步建立了全国统一的会计评估行业监督检查平台，提高风险识别和预警能力。
第三，郭强调要加强公司治理。她表示，财务欺诈和审计失败的根本原因往往在于无效的公司治理，而不仅仅是审计流程。如果监管部门只关注会计师事务所而忽视企业的主体责任，就很难从源头上遏制欺诈行为。完善企业责任全链条财务监管体系，开展审计质量、企业财务信息质量、内控有效性双向检查。
最后，郭呼吁提高跨境财务报告的透明度。她表示，国内要通过行政监管和行业监管，加大对财务造假和审计违法行为的打击力度。

China's Vice Finance Minister Guo Tingting: Uphold openness, support Hong Kong's role in global accounting governance | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
China's Vice Finance Minister Guo Tingting: Uphold openness, support Hong Kong's role in global accounting governance
China's Vice Finance Minister Guo Tingting said Beijing remains committed to high-standard openness and will support Hong Kong's accounting sector and its status as an international financial hub. Speaking at a forum in Hong Kong, she outlined four priorities including AI regulation, anti-fraud meas
China's Vice Finance Minister Guo Tingting said the country remains committed to expanding high-standard openness to the outside world and actively participates in global economic governance, including accounting and auditing governance. She added that domestic authorities treat all institutions operating in China equally. The finance ministry will continue to support the prosperity of Hong Kong's accounting and auditing industry and help consolidate the city's status as an international financial centre.
Speaking at the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council Regional Regulatory Forum in Hong Kong, Guo noted that a new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation is accelerating, with the global economic landscape undergoing deep adjustment. Cross-border investment and financing activities remain active, while digitalisation, intelligence and green development have become key directions and drivers. New forms of production, lifestyles and business models are emerging, presenting opportunities and challenges for the global accounting and auditing industry in areas such as ESG sustainable disclosure and digital auditing.
Guo proposed four points to address the new situation. First, she called for joint efforts to tackle new regulatory challenges, particularly regarding emerging fields such as artificial intelligence, big data and blockchain. She said regulation must balance development and security, avoiding both the rigid application of old rules that stifle innovation and regulatory gaps that allow risks such as algorithm black boxes and data monopolies.
Second, Guo said China this year added a chapter on supervision and management to its Certified Public Accountants Law, establishing a tiered regulatory system from education and warnings to administrative penalties. A national unified supervision and inspection platform for the accounting and appraisal industries has been initially set up to improve risk identification and early warning capabilities.
Third, Guo stressed the need to strengthen corporate governance. She said the root cause of financial fraud and audit failures often lies in ineffective corporate governance rather than just the audit process. If regulators focus only on accounting firms while ignoring the primary responsibility of companies, it will be difficult to curb fraud at its source. China has been improving its full-chain financial supervision system to hold companies accountable, conducting two-way inspections that check both audit quality and corporate financial information quality, as well as internal control effectiveness.
Finally, Guo called for greater transparency in cross-border financial reporting. She said efforts to crack down on financial fraud and audit violations should be intensified, both domestically through administrative regulation and industry self-discipline, and internationally through deepened cross-border regulatory cooperation to build interdependent accounting and auditing oversight mechanisms.
Guo also expressed concern about some accounting firms that prioritise scale and revenue over quality control, with partner evaluations and compensation overly tied to business income, weakening independence and leading to declining professional standards. She described integrity as the lifeline of the industry, urging a culture of honesty, professional ethics and adherence to standards, and rejecting a "revenue-first" evaluation approach. She stressed zero tolerance for financial fraud and audit violations, vowing strict regulation to create a clean professional environment.

content:
香港财政司长敦促供应链多元化以应对人工智能风险中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港财政司长敦促供应链多元化以应对人工智能风险
财政司司长陈茂波表示，由于全球地缘政治的不确定性，企业正在加速供应链多元化和投资分散。他强调了包括文件伪造在内的人工智能风险，并概述了三个优先事项：诚信、成为“人工智能原生者”以及对人员的持续投资。
香港财政司司长陈茂波11月9日表示，在全球地缘政治不确定性的背景下，企业加速供应链多元化和投资分散，区域经济联系日益紧密，带动跨境可信金融信息需求激增。贸易、技术和绿色转型的发展创造了机遇，但也对信任和问责提出了新的要求。
陈在会计和财务报告局区域监管论坛上发表讲话时表示，多元化和开放意味着更多的融资和跨境投资流动。他表示，今年首十个月，香港新上市公司有121只，集资总额超过4000亿港元，比去年全年增长40%。约60%的新发行人拥有国际业务，部分发行人在招股说明书中明确表示募集资金将用于海外扩张。越来越多来自东南亚、中东和中亚的国际企业选择在香港上市或发行债券。
陈表示，人工智能可以有效地处理日常任务，但其局限性及其基本假设的有效性需要严格的专业审查。他还指出了人工智能生成的文件伪造的风险。他说，该行业必须找到履行职责的方法，同时提高管理人员和员工的技能。
陈先生提出了三点重点：第一，把诚信放在工作的核心，在质量和诚信上决不妥协。其次，不仅要培养人工智能技能，还要成为“人工智能原生者”，因为企业将越来越重视能够使用人工智能来转变或重塑商业模式的人才。第三，持续对人的投资；尽管人工智能可能会减少一些日常工作，但企业仍然必须为年轻专业人员提供培训和经验，以培养具有技术和商业理解、正确判断、诚信以及跨市场和文化协作能力的人才。

Hong Kong finance chief urges supply chain diversification amid AI risks
Financial Secretary Paul Chan says firms are accelerating supply chain diversification and investment dispersal due to global geopolitical uncertainty. He highlights AI risks including document forgery, and outlines three priorities: integrity, becoming 'AI native', and continued investment in peopl
Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan said on 9 November that amid global geopolitical uncertainty, enterprises are accelerating supply chain diversification and investment dispersal, while regional economic ties are tightening, driving a surge in demand for cross-border trustworthy financial information. Developments in trade, technology and green transition create opportunities but also raise new demands for trust and accountability.
Speaking at the Accounting and Financial Reporting Authority Regional Regulatory Forum, Chan said diversity and openness mean more financing and cross-border investment flows. He noted that in the first ten months of this year, Hong Kong had 121 new listings with total fundraising exceeding HK$400 billion, a 40 per cent increase over the whole of last year. About 60 per cent of new issuers have international business operations, and some explicitly stated in their prospectuses that proceeds would be used for overseas expansion. More international companies from Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Central Asia are choosing to list or issue bonds in Hong Kong.
Chan said artificial intelligence can efficiently handle routine tasks, but its limitations and the validity of its underlying assumptions require rigorous professional scrutiny. He also flagged the risk of AI-generated document forgery. The industry, he said, must find ways to fulfil its duties while upgrading the skills of management and staff.
Chan set out three priorities: first, placing integrity at the core of work and never compromising on quality and integrity. Second, building not just AI skills but becoming 'AI native', as firms will increasingly value people who can use AI to transform or reshape business models. Third, continuing to invest in people; although AI may reduce some routine work, firms must still provide training and experience for young professionals to cultivate talent with technological and commercial understanding, sound judgement, integrity, and the ability to collaborate across markets and cultures.

香港秋季最低气温录得23.2°C |中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港秋季最低气温23.2℃
由于冷锋带来天气转凉，香港于11月9日录得秋季最低气温23.2摄氏度。香港天文台警告，到11月10日早上，市区气温可能降至16度左右，新界地区的气温甚至更低。
根据香港天文台的数据，11月9日早上，香港录得今秋最低气温23.2摄氏度，全区气温普遍较前一天下降约两度。
天文台表示，一股与冷锋相关的强烈东北季候风正影响广东沿岸，为本港带来凉爽及多风的天气。预计夜间气温将进一步下降，城市地区将达到 19 度左右。
11月10日早上，市区最低气温将骤降至约16度，新界地区则低1至2度。 11月12日早上，新界区天气持续凉爽，昼夜温差较大。
天文台提醒市民留意天气变化并注意保暖。

Hong Kong records lowest autumn temperature at 23.2°C
Hong Kong recorded its lowest autumn temperature at 23.2 degrees Celsius on 9 November as a cold front brought cooler weather. The Hong Kong Observatory warned temperatures could drop to around 16 degrees in urban areas by 10 November morning, with New Territories districts even cooler.
Hong Kong recorded its lowest temperature this autumn at 23.2 degrees Celsius on the morning of 9 November, with regional temperatures generally dropping by about two degrees compared to the previous day, according to the Hong Kong Observatory.
The Observatory stated that an intense northeast monsoon associated with a cold front is affecting the coast of Guangdong, bringing cooler and windy conditions to the territory. Temperatures are expected to fall further overnight, reaching around 19 degrees in urban areas.
The minimum temperature in urban areas will plunge to approximately 16 degrees on the morning of 10 November, while districts in the New Territories will be one to two degrees lower. The weather will remain rather cool in the New Territories on the morning of 12 November, with a significant temperature difference between day and night.
The Observatory has reminded the public to stay tuned to the weather changes and keep warm.

Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
RelyEZ shares surge 129% on Hong Kong debut after HK$563m IPO
Chinese energy storage firm RelyEZ Energy Storage Technology soared 129% on its Hong Kong stock market debut on 9 November, closing at HK$22.40 after an IPO that raised HK$562.7 million. The retail tranche was oversubscribed nearly 1,389 times.
Chinese energy storage company RelyEZ Energy Storage Technology jumped in its Hong Kong market debut on Monday, with shares closing at HK$22.40, up 129 per cent from the offer price of HK$9.78. The stock opened at HK$21.00. The Hang Seng Index rose 1 per cent on the day.
RelyEZ raised HK$562.7 million in its initial public offering, pricing 57.54 million shares at HK$9.78 each, near the middle of the marketed range. Demand was strong: the retail portion was oversubscribed nearly 1,389 times, while the international offering was 1.3 times covered.
The company plans to use the proceeds to develop its energy storage hardware and software, expand overseas, build a factory in Wuzhen in eastern China, and fund working capital.
Cornerstone investor CDH Global Frontier Ventures was allocated 3.21 million shares, worth about HK$31.4 million at the offer price.

屯门区议会今日举行会议，讨论政府重新规划洪水潮/厦村新发展区的建议。该提案占地约98.5公顷，规划部门将很快启动法定城市规划程序。如果城市规划委员会批准拟议的修订，分区计划大纲草案将进行两个月的公众咨询。
根据向区议会提交的政府文件，拟建的港深西铁线厦村站和流浮山站以及智能绿色公共交通系统车站附近的六个地块被指定为“住宅（甲级）”区域。这些用地的最大容积率为6.5或6.8倍，最大建筑高度为主要基准面以上140或160米。这些地区将通过人行道和自行车道与周边地区相连，一些住宅开发项目还提供政府、机构和社区设施。
天水围河附近两块占地约19公顷的地块拟改划为“火车站及车厂及住宅及商业发展区”。这些区域将被细分为更小的区域，并通过行人天桥、地下通道和人行横道与新发展区的其他部分和天水围河以西的区域相连。沿着天水围河及天心河，将建设一个“天水围河滨公园”。
文件指出，这些住宅用地连接至规划中的港深西铁厦村站及智慧绿色公共交通系统，方便洪水潮／厦村新发展区、流浮山新发展区及天水围新市镇内的出行。该铁路线还将提供通往深圳湾和前海的跨境通道。
此外，靠近铁路线厦村站和流浮山站的五幅地块被指定作“政府、机构或社区”用途，包括一间体育馆、三所小学和两所中学。其他规划的设施包括社区礼堂、诊所、变电站、垃圾收集站和污水泵站。另外两块土地被保留为政府土地储备。
邻近天水围河、铁路流浮山站和厦村“乡村式发展”区东南部的几块地块被建议划为“休憩用地”区。一幅靠近天水围河的地块，占地约3.8公顷，拟改划为「智能绿色公共交通系统车厂及住宅及商业发展」，下层为车厂，上层为住宅及商业用途。

Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Tuen Mun district council to discuss rezoning for Hung Shui Chiu/Ha Tsuen development
Tuen Mun District Council will discuss a government proposal to rezone about 98.5 hectares in the Hung Shui Chiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area. Plans include residential, railway depot, and community uses near the proposed Hong Kong-Shenzhen Western Rail Link and smart green transit stations.
Tuen Mun District Council will meet today to discuss the government's rezoning proposal for the Hung Shui Chiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area. The proposal covers about 98.5 hectares of land, with the Planning Department set to initiate statutory town planning procedures shortly. If the Town Planning Board approves the proposed amendments, a draft outline zoning plan will be exhibited for two months of public consultation.
According to government documents submitted to the district council, six plots adjacent to the proposed Hong Kong-Shenzhen Western Rail Link's Ha Tsuen and Lau Fau Shan stations, as well as smart green mass transit system stops, are designated as "Residential (Class A)" zones. These sites would have a maximum plot ratio of 6.5 or 6.8 times, and a maximum building height of 140 or 160 metres above Principal Datum. The areas will be connected to surrounding districts via pedestrian and cycle paths, with some residential developments also providing government, institutional, and community facilities.
Two plots covering about 19 hectares near the Tin Shui Wai River are proposed for rezoning as "Railway station and depot with residential and commercial development" zones. These will be subdivided into smaller areas, linked to other parts of the new development area and areas west of the Tin Shui Wai River by footbridges, underpasses, and pedestrian crossings. Along the Tin Shui Wai River and Tin Sam River, a "Tin Shui Wai Riverside Park" will be created.
The documents state that these residential sites are connected to the planned Hong Kong-Shenzhen Western Rail Link's Ha Tsuen station and the smart green mass transit system, facilitating travel within the Hung Shui Chiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area, the Lau Fau Shan New Development Area, and Tin Shui Wai New Town. The rail link will also provide cross-border access to Shenzhen Bay and Qianhai.
Additionally, five plots near the rail link's Ha Tsuen and Lau Fau Shan stations are designated for "Government, institution or community" use, including one sports hall, three primary schools, and two secondary schools. Other planned facilities include a community hall, clinic, substations, refuse collection points, and sewage pumping stations. Two further plots are reserved as government land reserves.
Several plots near the Tin Shui Wai River, the rail link's Lau Fau Shan station, and southeast of the Ha Tsuen "Village-type development" zone are proposed as "Open space" zones. One plot near the Tin Shui Wai River, covering about 3.8 hectares, is proposed for rezoning as "Smart green mass transit system depot with residential and commercial development", with the depot on the lower levels and residential and commercial uses above.

黄承认婚外情后，英伟达股价下跌；香港股市因科技股上涨而上涨中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
黄承认婚外情后，英伟达股价下跌；港股因科技股上涨而上涨
在首席执行官黄仁勋承认不忠后，英伟达在美国盘后交易中下跌 3.7%。香港股市周一高开，恒生指数上涨 0.59%，科技股普遍上涨。
据《标准报》报道，在首席执行官黄仁勋在给员工的信息中承认他对妻子不忠后，英伟达在美国盘后交易中下跌了 3.7%。英伟达董事会还准备对黄仁勋成为中国间谍目标的说法展开独立调查。
与此同时，香港股市周一开盘走高，科技股普遍上涨。基准恒生指数开盘上涨 143 点，或 0.59%，至 23,625 点；恒生科技指数上涨 1.02%，至 4,119 点。
主要科技股大多上涨。阿里巴巴和腾讯分别上涨2.2%和1.3%，美团上涨0.3%。蓝筹股中，药明生物领涨，上涨2.9%。
有报道称，小米电动汽车部门成立了新的国际业务部门，涵盖国际市场、进入市场战略、销售、网络开发、交付和物流、用户服务、综合管理和海外地区，小米开盘上涨2%。
受周五美国费城半导体指数上涨 4.21% 的支撑，本地芯片制造商也上涨。中芯国际上涨2.2%，华虹半导体上涨2.6%。

Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Nvidia falls after Huang admits affair; Hong Kong stocks rise on tech gains
Nvidia dropped 3.7 per cent in US after-hours trading after CEO Jensen Huang admitted infidelity. Hong Kong stocks opened higher Monday, with the Hang Seng Index up 0.59 per cent and tech shares broadly advancing.
Nvidia fell 3.7 per cent in US after-hours trading after chief executive Jensen Huang admitted in a message to employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife, according to a report by The Standard. Nvidia’s board is also set to launch an independent investigation into claims that Huang had been targeted by Chinese spies.
Meanwhile, Hong Kong stocks opened higher on Monday on broad gains in technology shares. The benchmark Hang Seng Index rose 143 points, or 0.59 per cent, to 23,625 at the open, and the Hang Seng Tech Index advanced 1.02 per cent to 4,119.
Major tech stocks mostly gained. Alibaba and Tencent rose 2.2 per cent and 1.3 per cent respectively, while Meituan advanced 0.3 per cent. Among blue chips, Wuxi Biologics led the gains with a 2.9 per cent rise.
Xiaomi opened 2 per cent higher after reports that its electric vehicle unit had established a new international business department, covering international markets, go-to-market strategy, sales, network development, delivery and logistics, user services, general management and overseas regions.
Local chipmakers also advanced, supported by a 4.21 per cent gain in the US Philadelphia Semiconductor Index on Friday. Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation rose 2.2 per cent, while Hua Hong Semiconductor climbed 2.6 per cent.

content:
中共十一届三中全会反腐决定被视为党的运作和人事的关键中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
中共十一届三中全会的反腐决定被视为党的运作和人事的关键
一位政治学家表示，在全球变化和国内挑战的背景下，中国共产党五中全会关于党纪的决定对于行动和人事选拔至关重要。 《决定》强调正确的人员引导和中央与地方的协调配合。
一位政治学家表示，中共五中全会关于持续推进全面从严治党的决定，对于党的执政和选人用人至关重要。香港城市大学公共及国际事务系系主任曾景涵在接受香港电台《看中国》节目采访时表示，党组织在中国的政治体系中发挥着至关重要的作用，直接影响国家的长远发展。
曾庆红表示，当今世界正经历百年未有之大变局，中国经济和科技发展面临诸多挑战。他表示，只有严明党纪，才能更好应对国内国际挑战。在深入学习贯彻习近平建党思想时，曾培炎说，习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想是习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的重要组成部分。他认为，只有建设好党、管好党，建立高效的党的组织体系，才能实现政治任务和经济发展。
决定强调坚持正确选人方向，保证党的路线、政策和中央决策的贯彻落实。曾庆红表示，各地情况不同，加强约束和管理，有利于中央与地方的协调配合，有利于中央政策的执行和权威。
对于这次全会选举军委副主席张生民为政治局委员，以及对多名军人的纪律处分，曾培炎表示，国家需要一支能打、能打胜仗的军队，才能最好地维护国家利益。他说，这体现了中央领导层从严治党从严治军的决心，并建议张军的中央职务要与其军队职责相呼应，更好地实现党军协同。
曾庆红指出，这次全会共对34名高级官员进行了纪律处分，发出了一个非常重要的信号，即在党的规定和国家法律面前，“老虎和苍蝇”应该一起打，这意味着任何腐败官员都不能太大或太小。

Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
CPC plenum's anti-graft decision seen as key to party operations and personnel
A political scientist says the Chinese Communist Party's fifth plenum decision on party discipline is vital for operations and personnel selection, amid global changes and domestic challenges. The decision stresses correct personnel direction and coordination between central and local authorities.
A political scientist has said the Chinese Communist Party's (CPC) fifth plenum decision on persistently advancing comprehensive party discipline is vital for the party's operations and personnel selection. Zeng Jinghan, head of the Department of Public and International Affairs at City University of Hong Kong, told RTHK's Look at China programme that party organisations play a crucial role in China's political system, directly affecting the country's long-term development.
Zeng noted the world is undergoing profound changes unseen in a century, while China's economy and technology development face many challenges. He said only strict party discipline could help better address domestic and international challenges. On the call to deeply study and implement Xi Jinping's party-building thought, Zeng described it as an important part of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. He argued that only by building and managing the party well, and establishing an efficient party organisational system, could political tasks and economic development be achieved.
The decision emphasises adhering to the correct direction in personnel selection to ensure implementation of the party's line, policies and central decisions. Zeng said different localities have varying conditions, and stronger constraints and management would greatly help coordination between central and local authorities, as well as the execution and authority of central policies.
Regarding the plenum's election of Zhang Shengmin, vice chairman of the Military Commission, as a Political Bureau member, and disciplinary actions against multiple military personnel, Zeng said the country needs an army that can fight and win to best protect national interests. He said this reflects the central leadership's determination for strict discipline in both the party and the military, and suggested Zhang's central posts should echo his military role to enable better party-military coordination.
Zeng noted the plenum disciplined a total of 34 senior officials, sending a very important signal that before party rules and national laws, both 'tigers and flies' should be swatted together, meaning no corrupt official is too big or too small to be punished.

商会会长郑毅在上海中国国际进口博览会将于11月10日闭幕之际表示，美国企业连续九届参加进博会，体现了他们对中国市场的重视。他承认，近年来中美关系出现波动，去年爆发贸易战，严重影响了大豆销售。他表示希望中国再次大量采购美国大豆。
美国中期选举，民主党控制参众两院。郑毅表示，外交政策由国家主席主导，基于两国元首建立稳定关系的愿望，相信这将有利于企业经营。
商会调查显示，会员企业对未来五年在华业务前景的乐观程度有所上升。在华美国企业现在将国内市场的激烈竞争视为其最大的挑战，而不是双边关系的不确定性。
郑毅预测，未来几年中美贸易不平衡仍将持续，他将此归因于两国经济的结构性因素。他表示，只要两国保持互补关系，就符合双方利益。
预计中美领导人下周将在深圳亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议期间再次会面，贸易预计将成为关键议题。

Shanghai American Chamber sees stable China-US ties despite midterm results | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Shanghai American Chamber sees stable China-US ties despite midterm results
Shanghai American Chamber of Commerce says China-US relations are stabilising, with member optimism rising. GOP loss in US midterms not expected to affect bilateral ties. Competition in China's domestic market now a bigger concern for US firms than geopolitical uncertainty.
The Shanghai American Chamber of Commerce has said that the loss of the US midterm elections by President Donald Trump's Republican Party is not expected to harm the prospects for building a stable relationship between China and the United States.
Speaking as the China International Import Expo in Shanghai was due to end on 10 November, chamber president Zheng Yi noted that American companies have participated in the expo for all nine editions, reflecting the importance they place on the Chinese market. He acknowledged that China-US relations have experienced fluctuations in recent years, with a trade war erupting last year that severely affected soybean sales. He expressed hope that China would again purchase large quantities of American soybeans.
The US midterm elections saw the Democratic Party take control of both chambers of Congress. Zheng Yi said foreign policy is led by the president, and based on the desire of both heads of state to build stable relations, he believed this would be beneficial for business operations.
According to a chamber survey, member companies' optimism about their business prospects in China over the next five years has risen. US firms in China now see the intense competition of the domestic market as their biggest challenge, rather than uncertainty in the bilateral relationship.
Zheng Yi forecast that the trade imbalance between China and the US would continue in the coming years, which he attributed to structural factors in both economies. He said that as long as the two countries maintain a complementary relationship, it would serve the interests of both.
The Chinese and US leaders are expected to meet again next week on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation leaders' informal meeting in Shenzhen, with trade expected to be a key topic.

Nvidia 董事会调查首席执行官黄承认外遇后外国情报针对他中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
英伟达董事会调查首席执行官黄承认外遇后外国情报针对他的目标
在有报道称首席执行官黄仁勋与一名中国女商人的关系后，英伟达董事会正在调查他是否成为外国情报的目标。黄某承认了恋情。在人工智能市场的不确定性和股价下跌的背景下，这项调查给这家芯片制造商带来了更大的压力。
英伟达周日表示，其董事会正在调查首席执行官黄仁勋是否成为外国情报活动的目标，此前有媒体报道称，黄仁勋与一名向北京传递信息的中国女商人关系密切。英伟达股价在美国盘后交易中下跌 3.7%。
黄仁勋在给员工的信息中表示，他对妻子不忠，并为自己的行为承担“全部责任”，而英伟达则表示，首席执行官致力于继续领导公司，不受干扰。分析师表示，这些事态发展可能会给这家芯片制造商的股价带来压力，因为人们担心人工智能热潮的可持续性，该公司的股价已经大幅下跌，而且还可能引发人们对黄仁勋领导这家他共同创立的公司的未来产生疑问。
《纽约时报》上个月报道称，黄与新加坡公司 Megaspeed 的一位无关的前高管 Alice Huang 有关系，美国当局调查后得出结论，她是中国情报人员。美国当局对从英伟达购买人工智能芯片的 Megaspeed 进行了审查，怀疑它帮助北京获得了被禁止运往中国的先进人工智能芯片。
“鉴于最近有报道称创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋已成为外国情报机构的目标，NVIDIA 董事会正在启动独立调查。英伟达表示，一个由独立董事组成的委员会将在外部独立顾问的协助下监督调查。该公司周日表示，虽然其董事会没有理由相信美国国家安全或英伟达的机密受到损害，但其调查将检查所有可用信息。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周日表示，他没有与黄谈论这些指控，但称他是一个好人。 “我希望一切都好。他做了如此令人难以置信的工作，”他补充道。当被问及在听取简报后是否认为自己应该根据情报采取行动时，特朗普说：“不，我不这么认为。”我认为他是一个值得尊敬的人。我想他可能有一个借口。你必须听到它。
Yorkville Ives & Co 合伙人兼高级董事总经理丹·艾夫斯 (Dan Ives) 表示：“根据董事会的调查，詹森显然有可能被解除首席执行官职务的风险，这将增加股票的风险，因为他对英伟达的故事和全球战略非常重要。”黄承认对妻子不忠，他说：“我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。

Nvidia board probes foreign intel targeting of CEO Huang as he admits affair | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Nvidia board probes foreign intel targeting of CEO Huang as he admits affair
Nvidia's board is investigating whether CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by foreign intelligence after reports of his relationship with a Chinese businesswoman. Huang admitted to an affair. The probe adds pressure on the chipmaker amid AI market uncertainty and falling shares.
Nvidia said on Sunday its board was probing whether CEO Jensen Huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence effort, after a media report alleged he had a close relationship with a Chinese businesswoman who passed information to Beijing. Nvidia's shares fell 3.7 per cent in US after-hours trading.
Huang said in a message to employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife and took 'full responsibility' for his actions, while Nvidia said the CEO was committed to continuing to lead the company without interruption. The developments are likely to pressure the chipmaker's stock, which has already fallen sharply amid worries about the AI boom's sustainability, and may also raise questions about Huang's future at the helm of the company he co-founded, analysts said.
The New York Times reported last month that Huang had a relationship with Alice Huang, an unrelated former executive of Singapore-based company Megaspeed, who US authorities investigated and concluded was a Chinese intelligence asset. US authorities have scrutinized Megaspeed, which buys AI chips from Nvidia, over suspicions it helped Beijing gain access to advanced AI chips that are barred from shipment to China.
'The NVIDIA Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation,' Nvidia said. The company said on Sunday that while its board had no reason to believe that either US national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, its inquiry would examine all available information.
US President Donald Trump said on Sunday he had not spoken to Huang about the allegations, but called him a fine person. 'I hope everything's fine. He's done such an incredible job,' he added. When asked if he believed he should have acted on intelligence when he was briefed about it, Trump said: 'No, I don't think so. I think he's an honorable guy. I think he probably has an excuse for it. You have to hear it.'
Dan Ives, partner and senior managing director at Yorkville Ives & Co, said: 'There is clearly risk that Jensen could be removed as CEO depending on the Board investigation and this will add risk to the stock as he is so important to the Nvidia story and strategy globally.' Huang admitted to having been unfaithful to his wife, saying: 'My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.'

title: 川普：將在中國會晤習近平與普京 談非核化

content:
2026年10月27日，美國總統唐納德·川普在德克薩斯州科珀斯克里斯蒂國際機場走下空軍一號專機後，站在停機坪上面向記者。(Kent Nishimura/AFP via Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月09日訊】（大紀元記者陳霆綜合報導）美國總統川普週日（11月8日）表示，他預計在中國深圳舉行的亞太經濟合作組織（APEC）領導人峰會期間，與中共黨魁習近平及俄羅斯總統普京會面，討論包括非核化在內的多項議題。川普同時表示，美國正努力結束伊朗戰爭。
目前，三國領導人會晤的具體安排尚未敲定。APEC峰會定於11月18日至19日在深圳舉行。若三方會面成行，將是一次罕見的外交活動。
川普週日從佛羅里達州登機返回華盛頓前，接受記者聯訪。被問及是否預期與習近平、普京舉行三方會晤時，他表示：「我將前往中國⋯⋯我想，其中一場會面將是與普京總統和習近平主席的會面，那會很有意思。」
他接著說：「我們會討論很多事情，包括非核化問題。」
此前，中共外交部發言人毛寧11月4日證實，中方正就三國領導人會晤與美俄保持溝通。
路透社指出，川普10月曾表示，願意與習近平、普京展開三方軍備控制談判，聚焦非核化。《華爾街日報》隨後報導，普京曾提議利用三方會晤，討論如何結束俄烏戰爭。
在週日播出的哥倫比亞廣播公司（CBS）《60分鐘》專訪中，川普表示，他認為俄烏雙方距離達成和平協議已經不遠。
當主持人追問烏克蘭能否維持自由與獨立時，川普回答：「我認為我們會把這件事談成，事情會實現，而烏克蘭的版圖最終會有些不同。」不過，他沒有進一步說明細節。
川普週日在佛州接受記者聯訪時還表示，美方週末就俄烏問題進行了「非常好的會談」。阿布扎比的相關會議也已展開，主要日程安排在週一及週二（11月9日至10日）。他表示，美方正努力結束俄烏戰爭。
美聯社引述曾在奧巴馬政府任職的美國前高級外交官丹尼‧拉塞爾（Danny Russel）表示，普京可能是三方會晤的最大受益者。他認為，俄羅斯顯然正積極推動這場會面，若能成行，將為莫斯科帶來一場外交勝利。
史汀生中心中國項目主任孫韻（Yun Sun）也認為，三方會面可能成行，但形式與內容仍不確定。
孫韻認為，俄羅斯可能藉機促使美中在烏克蘭問題上靠近莫斯科的立場，而北京可能不願深入參與軍控、烏克蘭或伊朗問題的討論。
保衛民主基金會中國項目資深主任辛格爾頓（Craig Singleton）則認為，這場會晤可能僅是一次合影機會，讓普京得以與美中領導人同台，卻未必產生重大實質成果。
在佛州受訪時，川普還表示：「我們正努力結束伊朗戰爭。」他說，美方已採取陸路及海上封鎖措施，對伊朗施加壓力。
川普指出，美國有能力立即攻擊伊朗的橋梁和發電廠，但這些設施一旦遭到摧毀，重建可能耗時多年。
「現在，我可以立刻進去，把他們炸掉。但問題在於，如果這麼做，他們就永遠無法重建。」川普進一步指出，伊朗地形多山，許多地區仰賴大型橋梁連接，一旦遭到破壞，重建可能需要10至15年，發電廠也很難重建。
他表示，這將使民眾承受沉重負擔，「我不喜歡這樣」。

中共早已被曝有紅色娘子軍計劃，而中共以謀取科技發展為目的的色誘，也在1990年代就已開始。示意圖。(China Photos/Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月09日訊】英偉達執行長黃仁勳已承認對妻子不忠，中國女商人黃樂（Alice Huang）被指是中共間諜。中共早已被曝有紅色娘子軍計劃，中共以謀取科技發展為目的的色誘布局，也在1990年代就已開始。如今紅色娘子軍入侵硅谷，只是被揭冰山一角。
現年63歲的黃仁勳在發給員工的一份備忘錄中表示：「我對妻子不忠。我的行為傷害了她和我們的孩子，我的所作所為沒有任何藉口。」他還向同事、董事會、合作夥伴和股東道歉，表示自己辜負了大家的信任，將努力重新贏得大家的信任。
外界媒體此前已報導黃仁勳與中國商人黃樂（Alice Huang）的曖昧關係，後者被網民稱為「燕子」。「燕子」最初是指前蘇聯克格勃在冷戰期間對女性色情間諜的內部代號，現在廣泛成為中共色情間諜的代稱。
黃樂所在的新加坡數據中心公司Megaspeed是英偉達的大客戶，過去兩年購買了逾48億美元的芯片。美國情報機構對黃樂進行監控，發現她被中共國安部招募。
黃仁勳此前曾為與黃樂的交往辯護。他在上月接受彭博新聞社（Bloomberg News）採訪時說，雙方的交往與Megaspeed有關，完全正常。英偉達也曾對此辯解說，黃仁勳每年會見數千名客戶高管。而在中國這邊，中共外交部此前回應稱，相關報導捕風捉影，純屬抹黑。
美國總統川普似乎幫助黃仁勳渡過難關，但美國政府同時也在調查事件。美國政府早已知情卻按兵不動，或許就是要黃本人自己承認。另外也有特別原因。因為中共做的許多齷齪事，其實許多人都心知肚明。但在民主國家什麼都講證據，中共又故意將其間諜行徑弄成灰色。如果川普不真的下決心去防範、打擊，確實很難辦。
之前連串事件，均指向中共的女間諜入侵美國，特別是政商界、科技界，硅谷已是攻擊的重點。
比如多年前曾轟動美國的「中國女間諜方芳案」，她同樣以留學生、美女名媛身分進入加州灣區，透過戀愛或發生性關係，成功滲透了多位加州當地的中產階級官員及科技圈人士，最後在FBI調查前連夜逃回中國。
西方反情報官員一直警告，中共與俄羅斯等外國勢力正利用外表出眾的女性對西方科技從業人員發動「美色陷阱」或「蜜罐」經濟間諜戰。
近年隨著AI應用快速發展，硅谷的AI工程師身價也水漲船高，成為中國及美國華裔女性擇偶的熱門人選。據《紐約郵報》報導，自稱北美最大華人婚戀交友網站的「2RedBeans」（兩顆紅豆）創辦人趙清華（Qinghua Zhao）表示，Anthropic和OpenAI的員工，已被來自中國的女性列為擇偶的「第一梯隊」。
在中美大打情報戰之際，這背後恐怕不只是AI從業人員財富飆升這麼簡單。最近OpenAI在反間諜培訓中提醒員工，外部人員可能用戀愛或性關係作誘餌，接近他們，獲取公司機密。
如果回顧中共的歷史，不難看出，今天硅谷被女諜入侵，是有完整脈絡的。
獨立評論人杜政曾在《上報》發表題為「中共性賄賂輸出國際，揭祕紅色娘子軍計劃」的文章，主要講中共在1980年代開放國門之後，為了適應所謂「改革開放」的情報需要，曾有一個「紅色娘子軍計劃」，培訓了一批準備派往海外的女子特務軍團。之後中共國安系統到相關高校挑選人員成為慣例，這個計劃與近三十年中共官商界泛濫成災的性賄賂結合，正成為國際社會的巨大威脅。
筆者在1990年代也了解到，中共將美色用在招商引資和科技竊密上。
1990年代是中共地方政府招商引資全面加速、從「被動等待」走向「主動出擊」的關鍵轉折期。招商引資成為推動地方經濟增長的核心引擎。
當時中國的科學技術委員會採取的是「國家、省、市、縣」四級垂直對應的架構（後來改為科技部、科技廳、科技局）。地方科委手握地方科技經費的分配權。負責科技成果轉化、項目審批與資助，是高新區建設的幕後推手，負責高新技術企業的認定初審、高新技術產品的評定，還有科技人才的管理。
1990年代國家引進外資的終極目的是「市場換技術」。外企進來後，市科委的一大任務就是當「紅娘」，舉辦「外資企業配套產品對接會」，介紹本地的國企、民營科技企業給外企當供應商。
當年市科委和省科委會帶著外企的工程師，一家一家去跑本地的配套鄉鎮企業和國企，逼著外企把圖紙和質量標準交給大陸供應商，指導大陸企業進行技術改造。這實質上是強迫外資向大陸本土供應商進行「技術轉移」。
近日特斯拉首席執行官埃隆·馬斯克（Elon Musk）透露了特斯拉當年在中國建廠前的談判內幕。他直言，中共官員衝他吼，唾沫橫飛，非要特斯拉找個中國夥伴「結婚」（指合資），不過，他以幽默的方式直接回拒中共的「結婚」要求，成功使特斯拉上海超級工廠成為中國首家外資獨資汽車工廠。
但即便是外資獨資，實際上也必須有中方人員安插進來，主要是為了監控所謂的「國家安全」。
馬斯克到中國已是2018年了。而筆者早在1990年代在體制內時，就知道有些地方的官員，動用各種辦法拉攏這些外企老闆，包括台灣老闆。除了強迫，地方官員通常也用軟辦法，方法之一是用女色。這些被派上用場的女子，其實許多是廉價的風塵女子，但也應屬於杜政所稱的「紅色娘子軍」。
中共拉攏外國商人，後來更多是讓各級統戰部統籌各種資源進行，特別是中方合作企業，以及高校有眾多美女資源。高校往往以更冠冕堂皇的「科研」名義與外企合作。這類合作遍及全國。在習時代主動出擊的「戰狼風」下，「紅色娘子軍」如洪水猛獸。
一個最典型的例子是，清華大學經濟管理學院顧問委員會每年都在北京舉行年度會議。該機構匯聚了眾多全球及西方科技、商界與金融領袖。這些全球頂尖的精英們，齊齊為正在加速擴張的紅色中國的所謂發展出謀獻策，確實不是好事。而到底中共對他們使用了什麼手段，不得而知。

title: 黄仁勋承认婚外情对象系中国间谍 英伟达启动调查
source: 新闻汇总 - 茉莉花新闻网

content:
黄仁勋承认婚外情对象系中国间谍 英伟达启动调查 · 茉莉花新闻网 在新标签页中打开
原文链接cn.nytimes.com/technology/20261109/nvidia-investigation-jensen-huang-china/
英伟达周日表示，已对公司首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋展开调查。此前，黄仁勋向公司董事会承认，他曾与一名企业高管发生亲密关系，而美国情报部门认定，该女子是中国间谍。
这名女子名叫黄乐(音，其英文名为Alice Huang)。美国政府的监控发现，她一直直接向北京提供情报，此后，黄仁勋与她的关系引起了美国政府的关注。这一发现引发了令人不安的种种可能性，因为黄仁勋不仅是人工智能革命中最有影响力的人物之一，也是特朗普总统的重要盟友。
黄仁勋在给公司的情况说明中道歉说：“我对妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”
英伟达董事会表示，“没有理由认为国家安全或英伟达的商业机密受到了损害”，但“董事会的调查将审查所有可获得的信息”。董事会表示，黄仁勋“完全支持此次审查，并承诺予以配合”。董事会没有透露调查的更多细节，也没有说明调查将持续多长时间。
董事会表示，63岁的黄仁勋将在调查期间继续领导公司。作为联合创始人，他在英伟达建立了一套独特的管理架构，掌控公司业务的方方面面，并直接管理约60名向他汇报的员工。
“今天的新闻不会拖慢英伟达的步伐，”公司发言人约翰·里佐说。“黄仁勋将继续不受干扰地履行首席执行官职责，领导英伟达。”
《纽约时报》上个月报道，美国情报机构发现，黄仁勋与一名中国公民建立了密切关系。此人从事芯片采购业务，美国官员认定她正在为北京搜集情报。
这名芯片采购商就是黄乐。据她的个人履历介绍，她曾在中国担任电视记者，之后成为一家总部位于新加坡的数据中心公司的高管。这家公司后来成为英伟达在东南亚最大的客户之一，自2024年6月以来购买了价值超过48亿美元的芯片。
这家公司名为Megaspeed。去年，《纽约时报》曾报道，美国商务部正在调查Megaspeed是否协助中国走私受到出口限制的人工智能芯片，但英伟达此后仍继续与该公司开展业务。
英伟达和黄仁勋最初坚称，他与黄乐的关系没有任何问题，也没有任何不寻常之处。上个月接受彭博新闻社采访时，黄仁勋表示，他与黄乐的往来“都与Megaspeed有关，完全正常，没有什么特别之处”。
这段关系和婚外情对黄仁勋来说是罕见的一次行差踏错。
过去三年里，黄仁勋可谓顺风顺水。他领导的芯片公司生产用于构建人工智能系统的关键技术，发展为全球市值最高的企业之一，也成为推动美国经济的数据中心建设热潮的核心力量。特朗普与他结为盟友，还邀请他乘坐“空军一号”总统专机。每逢出席活动，会有大批人群追着他索要签名。他每天穿着的黑色皮夹克也成了收藏者追捧的物品。
随着业务蓬勃发展，黄仁勋也让家人进入了公司的核心业务领域。他的儿子斯宾塞担任产品管理总监，在公司的机器人业务中发挥主导作用。女儿麦迪逊是产品营销高级总监，同样参与机器人业务，并负责公司的传播和营销工作。他的女婿尼科·卡普雷斯则在公司的业务拓展团队任职。
黄仁勋曾表示，自己创业成功离不开妻子洛丽的支持。两人于1985年结婚，最初相识时，黄仁勋还是俄勒冈州立大学一名十几岁的工程系学生。当时，在一个有250人的工程实验室里只有三名女生，洛丽就是其中之一。高中曾跳过两级的黄仁勋设法与她分到同一个实验小组，并试图用自己的聪明才智打动她。
“我知道我看起来像个孩子，所以她对我的第一印象是我很聪明，”2024年，黄仁勋在在香港科技大学谈起自己职业生涯时说。“我走到她面前说：‘你想看我的作业吗？’然后我向她承诺：‘如果你每周日都和我一起做作业，我保证，你肯定全拿A。’”
黄仁勋还向她承诺，到30岁时他会成为一家公司的首席执行官。1993年，他刚满30岁不久便联合创立了英伟达，兑现了这个承诺。
黄仁勋在播客“我是如何打造这一切的”中说：“洛丽照顾一切事情，我不记得她曾抱怨过一次。这是她送给我的礼物。”
美国政府一直在调查Megaspeed是否可能将英伟达先进人工智能芯片转运到中国，一年多前开始对黄乐进行监视。在监视过程中，他们发现她与一名被确认为黄仁勋的美国公民有通信。
看过该情报的官员说，他们确信两人之间存在恋爱关系。这削弱了英伟达过去一年向《纽约时报》和其他方面就黄仁勋与黄乐关系性质所作的最初误导性声明。
大约一年前，特朗普被告知美国情报界一直在对黄乐进行电子监视。
今年春天，国务卿鲁比奥监督起草了一份高度机密备忘录，详细说明情报显示黄乐被中国国家安全部招募来针对黄仁勋。该备忘录在今年早些时候总统访华前不久被传阅。
随着美国监视黄乐的新闻曝光，黄仁勋的回旋余地几乎消失。国会希望他作证——很可能是宣誓作证——而有关监视的报道让人更加相信，美国情报部门可能已经知晓他与黄乐关系的性质。
英伟达董事会也面临压力。上个月，马萨诸塞州民主党参议员、负责监督海外芯片销售的参议院银行委员会资深成员伊丽莎白·沃伦在社交媒体帖子中说，黄仁勋和公司董事会“有义务向国会解释”他与这名间谍之间的关系。
Megaspeed成立于2023年，当时一家中国网络游戏公司将其新加坡子公司剥离出来。不久之前，美国政府首次发布对华出售人工智能芯片的广泛禁令。公司成立时，黄乐被列为Megaspeed的董事总经理，后来她自称该公司首席执行官。
中国互联网上基本没有黄乐的背景信息，但根据一份网上简历，她曾在几家中国大型银行工作。根据WireScreen和Sayari平台汇编的公司和贸易记录，以及华盛顿非营利组织高级国防研究中心的分析，她随后加入了一家总部位于上海的基金，该基金与富有投资者和在中国有数据中心项目的科技公司有联系。
该网络中的公司帮助在上海郊外建设了一个大型数据中心，服务于中国公司腾讯。它还通过对中国电子科技集团一家网络安全子公司的投资，与中国军工体系产生了财务联系；中国电子科技集团是中国最大的军事技术制造商之一。
随着Megaspeed的芯片采购不断到来，黄仁勋和黄乐开始共处。2024年6月，在台北一场当地科技贸易展结束后，二人在台北一家酒吧见面。他们与其他人工智能高管一起喝威士忌。一年后，他们与其他高管在台北一家餐厅用餐。台湾媒体拍到她亲吻他的脸颊，以及他接受记者采访时她站在他身后的画面。
他们的关系成为华盛顿的关注焦点，此前官员们已经对Megaspeed的大量采购感到警觉。
“这是CCP惯用伎俩的典型手段——也是它为何永远不可信任的又一例证，” 得克萨斯州共和党众议员、众议院国土安全委员会副主席迈克尔·麦考尔在社交媒体上写道，他指的是中国共产党。“美国应立即暂停向中国出口先进的人工智能芯片，直到我们查明此事的真相，并确保我们的国家安全不受损害。”

title: 黄仁勋承认婚外情遭调查 分析师：恐面临解职风险
source: 新闻汇总 - 茉莉花新闻网

黄仁勋承认婚外情遭调查 分析师：恐面临解职风险 · 茉莉花新闻网 在新标签页中打开
原文链接www.cna.com.tw/news/aopl/202611090030.aspx
（中央社华盛顿8日综合外电报导）英伟达（Nvidia）今天表示，正调查首席执行官黄仁勋是否成为外国情报行动的目标。分析师认为，事态发展会持续对英伟达股价构成压力，黄仁勋也有遭解除首席执行官职务的风险。
综合路透社和法新社报导，黄仁勋在致员工的消息中坦承对妻子不忠，并表示对自己的行为负起「全部责任」。英伟达则表示，黄仁勋承诺将继续担任首席执行官，领导公司运作不受影响。
这些事态发展可能进一步对这家芯片制造商的股价构成压力。由于市场担忧人工智能（AI）产业的成长能否持续，英伟达股价近期已大幅下挫，如今这项调查也可能引发外界质疑，黄仁勋能否继续掌舵这家由他共同创办的公司。
纽约时报（The New York Times）上月报导，黄仁勋与新加坡数据中心公司Megaspeed前主管黄乐（Huang Le，音译），又名Alice Huang的中国籍女子关系密切。美国当局曾对这名女子展开调查，认定她是中国情报机关的协力人员。
英伟达表示：「鉴于近期报导指创办人兼首席执行官黄仁勋成为外国情报行动的目标，英伟达董事会正启动独立调查。调查将由独立董事组成的委员会监督，并由外部独立法律顾问协助。」
英伟达今天表示，尽管董事会目前没有理由认为美国国家安全或英伟达机密遭到危害，仍将在调查中查看所有可取得的信息。
英伟达并表示，黄仁勋全力支持这项调查，也已承诺配合。
美国国务卿卢比欧（Marco Rubio）今天晚间被记者问及黄仁勋一事时，不愿置评，说这是「企业内部事务」。
路透社报导，英伟达是AI市场的领导企业，投资人原已因市场能否持续成长的不确定性而缩手，如今这项调查又为公司增添压力。由于市场担忧AI发展的持续性，科技股全面重挫，这家市值4兆5000亿美元的芯片制造商，股价已回吐今年所有涨幅。
交易平台eToro首席分析师吉伯特（Josh Gilbert）表示，黄仁勋在英伟达崛起过程中扮演关键角色，因此，只要他的职位出现任何不确定性，都会牵动股东。
吉伯特说：「这项调查可能打击市场信心，但除非导致最高领导阶层异动，否则不会改变公司的长期前景；一旦高层换人，情况就完全不同了。」
Yorkville Ives & Co.合伙人兼资深董事总经理艾夫斯（Dan Ives）表示：「视董事会调查结果而定，黄仁勋显然有遭解除首席执行官职务的风险。他对英伟达的发展与全球策略至关重要，因此这将增加股价风险。」
艾夫斯说：「这是黄仁勋声誉受创的时刻，至少会引发多项国会调查，也会持续对股价构成压力。」他并表示，这项消息也将使英伟达对中国销售芯片一事受到更严格查看。

特朗普表示他与普京和习近平在中国的潜在会面将会很有趣
美国总统表示将讨论无核化等问题
华盛顿，11 月 9 日。/塔斯社/。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普相信，他可能于本月晚些时候在中国会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国领导人习近平，并与他们讨论无核化等问题。
此前，特朗普表示愿意参加11月18日至19日在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会。这位美国领导人在从佛罗里达飞往华盛顿之前对记者表示：“我将前往中国<……>，我认为其中一次会晤将是与普京总统和习主席的会面，这会很有趣。” “我们将讨论很多事情，包括无核化，”他补充道。
此前，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，如果俄罗斯、中国和美国领导人会面，将会发生一场非常重要的讨论，这将引起全世界的关注。他指出，俄罗斯、美国和中国正在为可能举行的三边会议的议程起草提案。

Trump says his potential meeting with Putin, Xi in China would be interesting
The US President said that denuclearization would be discussed among other things
WASHINGTON, November 9. /TASS/. US President Donald Trump believes he could meet with his Russian counterpart, Vladimir Putin, and Chinese leader Xi Jinping in China later this month and discuss denuclearization, among other things, with them.
Earlier, Trump said he would like to take part in the APEC summit in China’s Shenzhen on November 18-19. "I’m going to be going to China <…> and one of the meetings I think will be with President Putin and President Xi, and that’ll be interesting," the US leader told reporters before flying from Florida to Washington. "We’ll talk a lot of things, including denuclearization," he added.
Earlier, Kremlin Spokesman Dmitry Peskov said that If the leaders of Russia, China, and the United States meet a very important discussion will take place that would capture the world’s attention. Russia, the US, and China are drafting proposals for the agenda of a potential trilateral meeting, he noted.
